```cpp
            for (uint32_t b = 8; b + 8 <= kObj; b += 8) {
                uint64_t v;
                std::memcpy(&v, &ob[i * kObj + b], 8);
                if (dzHeap(v) && v != me) cands.push_back({{hop1[i].first, int32_t(b)}, v});
            }
        }
        std::vector<uint64_t> vt(cands.size(), 0);
        rq.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < cands.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(cands[i].obj), &vt[i], 8});
        p.readMany(rq);
        std::vector<Cand> items;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < cands.size(); ++i)
            if (cands[i].path.second < 0 || (rq[i].ok && isVt(vt[i]))) items.push_back(cands[i]);
        std::vector<uint64_t> objs;
        for (const auto& c : items) objs.push_back(c.obj);
        const auto names = dzClassNames(p, objs);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < items.size(); ++i)
            if (!names[i].empty()) out[items[i].path] = {items[i].obj, names[i]};
        return out;
    };
    auto pathStr = [](const Path& pt) {
        return "+" + hexs(pt.first) + (pt.second < 0 ? std::string() : " -> +" + hexs(uint32_t(pt.second)));
    };

    say("[*] hand item: local player " + hexs(me) + ". Hold an item in your hands now (a weapon is best).");
    const auto a = snapshot();
    {
        int shown = 0;
        for (const auto& kv : a) {
            if (shown++ >= 60) break;
            say("    before: entity " + pathStr(kv.first) + "   " + kv.second.second);
        }
    }
    say("[*] hand item: " + std::to_string(a.size()) + " named objects reachable from you. NOW put a DIFFERENT item in your hands"
        " (or holster to empty hands) - re-reading in " + std::to_string(waitSec) + " s ...");
    wait(waitSec * 1000);
    const auto b = snapshot();

    std::vector<std::string> lines;
    std::set<Path> all;
    for (const auto& kv : a) all.insert(kv.first);
    for (const auto& kv : b) all.insert(kv.first);
    for (const Path& pt : all) {
        const auto ia = a.find(pt), ib = b.find(pt);
        const uint64_t oa = ia == a.end() ? 0 : ia->second.first, ob = ib == b.end() ? 0 : ib->second.first;
        if (oa == ob) continue;
        const std::string na = ia == a.end() ? "(empty)" : ia->second.second, nb = ib == b.end() ? "(empty)" : ib->second.second;
        lines.push_back("    entity " + pathStr(pt) + "   " + na + "  ->  " + nb);
    }
    if (lines.empty()) {
        say("[*] hand item: nothing changed. Make sure the second item is really in your hands, and rerun.");
    } else {
        say("[*] hand item: paths whose item changed (the one matching your swap = HirschgangWare dz::kInventory -> kHandItem):");
        for (const auto& l : lines) say(l);
    }
}

static void pairRoster(const Process& p, const Image& img, const DiscoverConfig& cfg, uint64_t world,
                const std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>>& slotsOf, const std::vector<uint64_t>& clients, uint64_t holder,
                uint64_t arr, uint32_t nameSlot, const std::function<void(const std::string&)>& say) {
    uint64_t nc = 0;
    for (uint64_t c : clients)
        if (holder >= c && holder < c + 0x1000) nc = c;
    std::string globals;
    if (const auto it = slotsOf.find(nc); it != slotsOf.end())
        for (uint32_t r : it->second) globals += (globals.empty() ? "" : ", ") + hexs(r);
    int32_t cnt = 0;
    p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(holder + 8), cnt);
    say("[*] roster: PLAYER LIST = *(NetworkClient+" + hexs(holder - nc) + "), count at +" + hexs(holder - nc + 8) + " = " +
        std::to_string(cnt) + ", gamertag RVString at identity +" + hexs(nameSlot) + "; NetworkClient* at module RVA " + globals);
    if (cnt <= 0 || cnt > 1024) cnt = 256;

    std::vector<uint64_t> raw(static_cast<size_t>(cnt), 0);
    p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(arr), raw.data(), raw.size() * 8);
    std::vector<uint64_t> ids;
    for (uint64_t v : raw) if (dzHeap(v)) ids.push_back(v);
    constexpr uint32_t kId = 0x200, kEnt = 0x3000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> ib(ids.size() * kId, 0);
    std::vector<Process::ReadReq> rq;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(ids[i]), &ib[i * kId], kId});
    p.readMany(rq);
    std::vector<std::string> idName(ids.size());
    {
        std::vector<uint64_t> sp(ids.size(), 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) std::memcpy(&sp[i], &ib[i * kId + nameSlot], 8);
        std::vector<uint8_t> tb(ids.size() * 48, 0);
        rq.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(dzHeap(sp[i]) ? sp[i] + 0x10 : 0), &tb[i * 48], 48});
        p.readMany(rq);
        std::string all;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) {
            idName[i] = rq[i].ok ? dzText(&tb[i * 48], 48) : std::string();
            if (all.size() < 1500) all += (all.empty() ? "" : ", ") + (idName[i].empty() ? std::string("?") : idName[i]);
        }
        say("[*] roster: " + std::to_string(ids.size()) + " identities: " + all);
    }
    if (ids.empty()) return;

    std::vector<VTableInfo> vts;
    std::string err;
    if (!findVTables(img, "DayZPlayer", vts, err)) { say("[*] roster pairing: no DayZPlayer RTTI"); return; }
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, bool> playerVt;
    for (const auto& v : vts) playerVt[static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + v.rva] = v.cls.find("Infected") == std::string::npos;
    std::vector<uint64_t> cands;
    for (const auto& t : cfg.tables) {
        uint64_t hdr[2] = {};
        if (!p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(world + t.off), hdr, 16) || !dzHeap(hdr[0])) continue;
        const int32_t n = static_cast<int32_t>(hdr[1] & 0xFFFFFFFF);
        if (n <= 0 || n > 4096) continue;
        std::vector<uint64_t> more(static_cast<size_t>(n), 0);
        if (!p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(hdr[0]), more.data(), more.size() * 8)) continue;
        for (uint64_t s : more) if (dzHeap(s)) cands.push_back(s);
    }
    const uint64_t me = dzLocalPlayer(p, world);
    std::vector<uint64_t> vt(cands.size(), 0);
    rq.clear();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cands.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(cands[i]), &vt[i], 8});
    p.readMany(rq);
    std::vector<uint64_t> ents;
    std::set<uint64_t> seen;
    if (dzHeap(me)) { ents.push_back(me); seen.insert(me); }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cands.size(); ++i) {
        const auto it = playerVt.find(vt[i]);
        if (it != playerVt.end() && it->second && seen.insert(cands[i]).second) ents.push_back(cands[i]);
    }
    say("[*] roster pairing: " + std::to_string(ents.size()) + " survivor entities (" + (dzHeap(me) ? "first = you" : "own entity not found") + ")");
    if (ents.empty()) return;
    std::vector<uint8_t> eb(ents.size() * kEnt, 0);
    rq.clear();
    for (size_t e = 0; e < ents.size(); ++e)
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o < kEnt; o += 0x400) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(ents[e] + o), &eb[e * kEnt + o], 0x400});
    p.readMany(rq);
    auto q64 = [](const std::vector<uint8_t>& b, size_t at) { uint64_t v; std::memcpy(&v, &b[at], 8); return v; };
    auto d32 = [](const std::vector<uint8_t>& b, size_t at) { uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, &b[at], 4); return v; };
    auto who = [&](size_t e) { return e == 0 && dzHeap(me) ? std::string("YOU") : "ent" + std::to_string(e); };

    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, size_t> idIx, entIx;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) idIx[ids[i]] = i;
    for (size_t e = 0; e < ents.size(); ++e) entIx[ents[e]] = e;
    std::map<uint32_t, std::vector<std::string>> idToEnt, entToId;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i)
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= kId; o += 8)
            if (const auto it = entIx.find(q64(ib, i * kId + o)); it != entIx.end())
                idToEnt[o].push_back(who(it->second) + "=" + idName[i]);
    for (size_t e = 0; e < ents.size(); ++e)
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= kEnt; o += 8)
            if (const auto it = idIx.find(q64(eb, e * kEnt + o)); it != idIx.end())
                entToId[o].push_back(who(e) + "=" + idName[it->second]);
    auto list = [](const std::vector<std::string>& v) {
        std::string s;
        for (const auto& x : v) if (s.size() < 400) s += (s.empty() ? "" : ", ") + x;
        return s;
    };
    for (const auto& kv : idToEnt) say("[*] roster pairing: POINTER identity +" + hexs(kv.first) + " -> entity: " + list(kv.second));
    for (const auto& kv : entToId) say("[*] roster pairing: POINTER entity +" + hexs(kv.first) + " -> identity: " + list(kv.second));

    struct Pair { uint32_t io, eo; std::vector<std::string> hits; };
    std::vector<Pair> pairs;
    for (uint32_t io = 0; io + 4 <= kId; io += 4) {
        size_t ptrs = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) ptrs += dzHeap(q64(ib, i * kId + (io & ~7u))) && q64(ib, i * kId + (io & ~7u)) >> 32;
        if (ptrs * 2 > ids.size()) continue;
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> val;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); ++i) {
            const uint32_t v = d32(ib, i * kId + io);
            if (v >= 2 && v != 0xFFFFFFFF) val[v] = val.count(v) ? SIZE_MAX : i;
        }
        size_t uniq = 0;
        for (const auto& kv : val) uniq += kv.second != SIZE_MAX;
        if (uniq * 10 < ids.size() * 9) continue;
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<std::string>> byEo;
        for (size_t e = 0; e < ents.size(); ++e)
            for (uint32_t eo = 0; eo + 4 <= kEnt; eo += 4) {
                const auto it = val.find(d32(eb, e * kEnt + eo));
                if (it != val.end() && it->second != SIZE_MAX) byEo[eo].push_back(who(e) + "=" + idName[it->second]);
            }
        for (auto& kv : byEo) pairs.push_back({io, kv.first, std::move(kv.second)});
    }
    std::sort(pairs.begin(), pairs.end(), [](const Pair& a, const Pair& b) { return a.hits.size() > b.hits.size(); });
    int shown = 0;
    for (const auto& pr : pairs) {
        if (shown++ >= 12) break;
        say("[*] roster pairing: ID identity +" + hexs(pr.io) + " == entity +" + hexs(pr.eo) + " (" + std::to_string(pr.hits.size()) +
            " survivors): " + list(pr.hits));
    }
    if (idToEnt.empty() && entToId.empty() && pairs.empty())
        say("[*] roster pairing: no pointer or shared id between identities and survivor entities");
    else
        say("[*] roster pairing: ^ the right link names YOU with your own gamertag and the others with real players");
}

void findNetRoster(const Process& p, const Image& img, const DiscoverConfig& cfg,
                   const std::function<void(const std::string&)>& log) {
    auto say = [&](const std::string& s) { if (log) log(s); };
    if (img.ptrSize != 8) { say("[*] roster: 64-bit images only"); return; }
    uint64_t world = 0;
    if (!p.readPtr(static_cast<uintptr_t>(img.base + cfg.worldRva), 8, world) || !dzHeap(world)) {
        say("[*] roster: world pointer not resolved (in game?)");
        return;
    }
    uint64_t hub = 0, mid = 0, ident = 0, nameStr = 0;
    std::string myName;
    if (p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(world + 0x30), hub) && dzHeap(hub) && p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(hub + 0x8), mid) && dzHeap(mid) &&
        p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(mid + 0x3E8), ident) && dzHeap(ident) && p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(ident + 0xC0), nameStr) &&
        dzHeap(nameStr)) {
        uint8_t tb[64] = {};
        if (p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(nameStr + 0x10), tb, sizeof tb)) myName = dzText(tb, sizeof tb);
    }
    if (myName.empty()) {
        say("[*] roster: own identity chain (World+0x30 ...) didn't resolve; searching the NetworkClient without it");
        ident = 0;
    } else {
        say("[*] roster: you are \"" + myName + "\", identity object " + hexs(ident));
    }

    std::vector<VTableInfo> vts;
    std::string err;
    if (!findVTables(img, "NetworkClient", vts, err)) { say("[*] roster: no NetworkClient RTTI (" + err + ")"); return; }
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> ncVt;
    for (const auto& v : vts) ncVt.insert(static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + v.rva);
    std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> slotsOf;
    for (const auto& sec : img.sections) {
        if (sec.exec() || !(sec.flags & 0x80000000u)) continue;
        std::vector<uint8_t> buf(sec.vsize, 0);
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o < sec.vsize; o += 0x1000)
            p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(img.base + sec.rva + o), &buf[o], (std::min)(0x1000u, sec.vsize - o));
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= sec.vsize; o += 8) {
            uint64_t v;
            std::memcpy(&v, &buf[o], 8);
            if (dzHeap(v)) slotsOf[v].push_back(sec.rva + o);
        }
    }
    std::vector<uint64_t> vals;
    for (const auto& kv : slotsOf) vals.push_back(kv.first);
    std::vector<uint64_t> vt(vals.size(), 0);
    std::vector<Process::ReadReq> rq;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vals.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(vals[i]), &vt[i], 8});
    p.readMany(rq);
    std::vector<uint64_t> clients;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vals.size(); ++i)
        if (rq[i].ok && ncVt.count(vt[i])) clients.push_back(vals[i]);
    say("[*] roster: " + std::to_string(vals.size()) + " heap pointers in the module's data, " + std::to_string(clients.size()) +
        " point at a NetworkClient");
    if (clients.empty()) {
        say("[*] roster: no NetworkClient - offline mode has no network client. Join a server and run this again.");
        return;
    }

    if (!ident) {
        constexpr uint32_t kObj = 0x400, kSlots = 0x300, kEnt = 64, kProbe = 4;
        const uint64_t modLo = img.base, modHi = img.base + img.bytes.size();
        auto inMod = [&](uint64_t v) { return v >= modLo && v < modHi; };
        std::vector<std::string> paths;
        std::vector<uint64_t> arrs, holders;
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> seenArr;
        auto addArr = [&](uint64_t a, const std::string& path, uint64_t holder = 0) {
            if (dzHeap(a) && seenArr.insert(a).second && arrs.size() < 4096) {
                arrs.push_back(a);
                paths.push_back(path);
                holders.push_back(holder);
            }
        };
        for (uint64_t nc : clients) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> nb(kObj, 0);
            p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(nc), nb.data(), kObj);
            std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint64_t>> h1;
            for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= kObj; o += 8) {
                uint64_t v;
                std::memcpy(&v, &nb[o], 8);
                if (!dzHeap(v) || v == nc || inMod(v)) continue;
                h1.push_back({o, v});
                addArr(v, "NetworkClient+" + hexs(o), nc + o);
            }
            std::vector<uint8_t> hb(h1.size() * 0x200, 0);
            rq.clear();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < h1.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(h1[i].second), &hb[i * 0x200], 0x200});
            p.readMany(rq);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < h1.size(); ++i) {
                if (!rq[i].ok) continue;
                for (uint32_t k = 0; k + 8 <= 0x200; k += 8) {
                    uint64_t v;
                    std::memcpy(&v, &hb[i * 0x200 + k], 8);
                    if (dzHeap(v) && !inMod(v)) addArr(v, "NetworkClient+" + hexs(h1[i].first) + " -> +" + hexs(k));
                }
            }
        }
        std::vector<uint64_t> ab(arrs.size() * kEnt, 0);
        rq.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < arrs.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(arrs[i]), &ab[i * kEnt], kEnt * 8});
        p.readMany(rq);
        std::vector<uint64_t> head(arrs.size() * kProbe, 0);
        std::vector<Process::ReadReq> vq;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < arrs.size(); ++i)
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < kProbe; ++k)
                vq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(dzHeap(ab[i * kEnt + k]) ? ab[i * kEnt + k] : 0), &head[i * kProbe + k], 8});
        p.readMany(vq);
        std::vector<size_t> cand;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < arrs.size(); ++i) {
            if (!rq[i].ok) continue;
            uint64_t cls = 0;
            int same = 0;
            bool bad = false;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < kProbe; ++k) {
                const uint64_t e = ab[i * kEnt + k], v = head[i * kProbe + k];
                if (!dzHeap(e)) continue;
                if (!inMod(v)) { bad = true; break; }
                if (!cls) cls = v;
                if (v == cls) ++same; else { bad = true; break; }
            }
            if (!bad && same >= 1) cand.push_back(i);
        }
        say("[*] roster: " + std::to_string(arrs.size()) + " pointer blocks near the NetworkClient, " + std::to_string(cand.size()) +
            " hold objects of one class; probing them for names");
        int hits = 0;
        size_t best = SIZE_MAX, bestDistinct = 1;
        uint32_t bestSlot = 0;
        for (size_t i : cand) {
            std::vector<uint64_t> ents;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < kEnt; ++k)
                if (dzHeap(ab[i * kEnt + k]) && !inMod(ab[i * kEnt + k])) ents.push_back(ab[i * kEnt + k]);
            const size_t np = (std::min<size_t>)(ents.size(), kProbe);
            std::vector<uint8_t> eb(np * kSlots, 0);
            rq.clear();
            for (size_t k = 0; k < np; ++k) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(ents[k]), &eb[k * kSlots], kSlots});
            p.readMany(rq);
            std::vector<std::pair<size_t, uint32_t>> who;
            std::vector<uint8_t> tb;
            std::vector<Process::ReadReq> tq;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < np; ++k)
                for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= kSlots; o += 8) {
                    uint64_t v;
                    std::memcpy(&v, &eb[k * kSlots + o], 8);
                    if (dzHeap(v) && !inMod(v)) who.push_back({k, o});
                }
            tb.assign(who.size() * 48, 0);
            for (size_t w = 0; w < who.size(); ++w) {
                uint64_t v;
                std::memcpy(&v, &eb[who[w].first * kSlots + who[w].second], 8);
                tq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(v + 0x10), &tb[w * 48], 48});
            }
            p.readMany(tq);
            std::map<uint32_t, int> slotHits;
            for (size_t w = 0; w < who.size(); ++w) {
                const std::string s = tq[w].ok ? dzText(&tb[w * 48], 48) : std::string();
                int letters = 0;
                for (char c : s) letters += std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) ? 1 : 0;
                if (letters >= 2) ++slotHits[who[w].second];
            }
            for (const auto& sh : slotHits) {
                std::vector<uint64_t> sp(ents.size(), 0);
                rq.clear();
                for (size_t k = 0; k < ents.size(); ++k) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(ents[k] + sh.first), &sp[k], 8});
                p.readMany(rq);
                std::vector<uint8_t> nb2(ents.size() * 48, 0);
                rq.clear();
                for (size_t k = 0; k < ents.size(); ++k)
                    rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(dzHeap(sp[k]) ? sp[k] + 0x10 : 0), &nb2[k * 48], 48});
                p.readMany(rq);
                std::string names;
                int n = 0;
                std::set<std::string> distinct;
                for (size_t k = 0; k < ents.size(); ++k) {
                    const std::string nm = rq[k].ok ? dzText(&nb2[k * 48], 48) : std::string();
                    if (nm.empty()) continue;
                    ++n;
                    distinct.insert(nm);
                    if (names.size() < 600) names += (names.empty() ? "" : ", ") + nm;
                }
                if (n == 0) continue;
                ++hits;
                bool gamertags = false;
                for (const auto& d : distinct) gamertags |= !d.empty() && d.back() != '=';
                if (holders[i] && gamertags && distinct.size() > bestDistinct) {
                    bestDistinct = distinct.size();
                    best = i;
                    bestSlot = sh.first;
                }
                say("[*] roster: candidate " + paths[i] + " = " + hexs(arrs[i]) + ", " + std::to_string(ents.size()) + " entries of " +
                    classNameAt(p, img, ents[0]) + ", name slot +" + hexs(sh.first) + ": " + std::to_string(n) + " named: " + names);
            }
        }
        if (!hits) say("[*] roster: no named object array within two hops of the NetworkClient");
        if (best != SIZE_MAX) pairRoster(p, img, cfg, world, slotsOf, clients, holders[best], arrs[best], bestSlot, say);
        return;
    }

    constexpr uint32_t kNc = 0x800, kArr = 0x800, kDeep = 0x200;
    auto nameOf = [&](uint64_t id) {
        uint64_t s = 0;
        uint8_t tb[64] = {};
        if (!p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(id + 0xC0), s) || !dzHeap(s) || !p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(s + 0x10), tb, sizeof tb))
            return std::string();
        return dzText(tb, sizeof tb);
    };
    auto reportArray = [&](const std::string& path, uint64_t arr, uint32_t idx) {
        std::vector<uint64_t> ents(256, 0);
        p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(arr), ents.data(), ents.size() * 8);
        std::string names;
        int n = 0;
        for (uint64_t e : ents) {
            if (!dzHeap(e)) continue;
            const std::string nm = nameOf(e);
            if (nm.empty()) continue;
            ++n;
            if (names.size() < 600) names += (names.empty() ? "" : ", ") + nm;
        }
        say("[*] roster: FOUND your identity at " + path + " [" + std::to_string(idx) + "]; " + std::to_string(n) +
            " named entries: " + names);
    };
    int found = 0;
    for (uint64_t nc : clients) {
        std::string globals;
        for (uint32_t r : slotsOf[nc]) globals += (globals.empty() ? "" : ", ") + hexs(r);
        say("[*] roster: NetworkClient " + hexs(nc) + " (" + classNameAt(p, img, nc) + "), held by module RVA " + globals);
        std::vector<uint8_t> nb(kNc, 0);
        p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(nc), nb.data(), kNc);
        std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint64_t>> h1;
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 8 <= kNc; o += 8) {
            uint64_t v;
            std::memcpy(&v, &nb[o], 8);
            if (v == ident) {
                reportArray("NetworkClient+" + hexs(o) + " (inline)", nc + o, 0);
                ++found;
            } else if (dzHeap(v) && v != nc) {
                h1.push_back({o, v});
            }
        }
        std::vector<uint8_t> ab(h1.size() * kArr, 0);
        rq.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < h1.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(h1[i].second), &ab[i * kArr], kArr});
        p.readMany(rq);
        std::vector<std::tuple<uint32_t, uint32_t, uint64_t>> h2;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < h1.size(); ++i) {
            if (!rq[i].ok) continue;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k + 8 <= kArr; k += 8) {
                uint64_t v;
                std::memcpy(&v, &ab[i * kArr + k], 8);
                if (v == ident) {
                    uint32_t cnt = 0;
                    if (h1[i].first + 12 <= kNc) std::memcpy(&cnt, &nb[h1[i].first + 8], 4);
                    reportArray("NetworkClient+" + hexs(h1[i].first) + " -> array (+" + hexs(h1[i].first + 8) + " = " +
                                    std::to_string(cnt) + ")",
                                h1[i].second, k / 8);
                    ++found;
                } else if (dzHeap(v) && k < kDeep) {
                    h2.push_back({h1[i].first, k, v});
                }
            }
        }
        if (found) continue;
        std::vector<uint8_t> db(h2.size() * kDeep, 0);
        rq.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < h2.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(std::get<2>(h2[i])), &db[i * kDeep], kDeep});
        p.readMany(rq);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < h2.size(); ++i) {
            if (!rq[i].ok) continue;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k + 8 <= kDeep; k += 8) {
                uint64_t v;
                std::memcpy(&v, &db[i * kDeep + k], 8);
                if (v != ident) continue;
                reportArray("NetworkClient+" + hexs(std::get<0>(h2[i])) + " -> +" + hexs(std::get<1>(h2[i])) + " -> array",
                            std::get<2>(h2[i]), k / 8);
                ++found;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!found) say("[*] roster: your identity is in no array within two hops of the NetworkClient");

    const uint64_t me = dzLocalPlayer(p, world);
    if (!me) return;
    std::vector<uint8_t> ib(0x200, 0), eb(0x1800, 0);
    p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(ident), ib.data(), ib.size());
    for (uint32_t o = 0; o < eb.size(); o += 0x400) p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(me + o), &eb[o], 0x400);
    int pairs = 0;
    for (uint32_t io = 0; io + 4 <= ib.size(); io += 4) {
        uint32_t iv;
        std::memcpy(&iv, &ib[io], 4);
        if (iv < 2 || iv > 0xFFFFFF) continue;
        for (uint32_t eo = 0; eo + 4 <= eb.size() && pairs < 24; eo += 4) {
            uint32_t ev;
            std::memcpy(&ev, &eb[eo], 4);
            if (ev != iv) continue;
            char line[128];
            std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "    identity +0x%X == entity +0x%X  (value %u)", io, eo, iv);
            say(line);
            ++pairs;
        }
    }
    if (!pairs) say("[*] roster: no 32-bit value shared by your identity and your entity (network id not found)");
    else say("[*] roster: ^ shared values; the network id is the pair that also matches for other players");
}

void findWorldGlobal(const Process& p, const Image& img, const DiscoverConfig& cfg,
                     const std::vector<Entity>& entities, const std::function<void(const std::string&)>& log) {
    auto say = [&](const std::string& s) { log(s); };
    auto sayf = [&](const char* fmt, auto... args) {
        char b[256];
        std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, fmt, args...);
        say(b);
    };
    if (img.ptrSize != 8) { say("[!] world finder: 64-bit images only"); return; }
    const uint64_t base = img.base, imgHi = img.base + img.bytes.size();
    auto heapPtr = [&](uint64_t v) { return v >= 0x10000 && v < 0x7FFFFFFF0000ull && v % 8 == 0 && !(v >= base && v < imgHi); };

    std::vector<uint64_t> players;
    for (const auto& e : entities)
        if (heapPtr(e.addr)) players.push_back(e.addr);
    if (players.empty()) { say("[!] world finder: no entity objects to anchor on (spawn in first)"); return; }
    const std::unordered_set<uint64_t> playerSet(players.begin(), players.end());
    sayf("[*] world finder: anchoring on %zu discovered entity object(s)", players.size());

    struct Cand { uint32_t rva; uint64_t world; size_t xrefs; };
    std::vector<Cand> cands;
    auto addCand = [&](uint32_t rva, uint64_t world) {
        for (const auto& c : cands) if (c.rva == rva) return;
        cands.push_back({rva, world, findCodeXrefs(img, rva).size()});
    };

    const uint32_t nearOff = cfg.tables.size() > 0 ? cfg.tables[0].off : 0xF70;
    const uint32_t farOff = cfg.tables.size() > 1 ? cfg.tables[1].off : 0x10B8;
    {
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> entVts;
        for (uint64_t pl : players) {
            uint64_t vt = 0;
            if (p.readPtr(static_cast<uintptr_t>(pl), 8, vt) && vt >= base && vt < imgHi) entVts.insert(vt);
        }
        std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint64_t>> globals;
        for (const auto& sec : img.sections) {
            if (sec.exec() || !(sec.flags & 0x80000000)) continue;
            const uint64_t hi = std::min<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(sec.rva) + sec.vsize, img.bytes.size());
            for (uint64_t at = sec.rva; at + 8 <= hi; at += 8) {
                uint64_t v = 0;
                std::memcpy(&v, &img.bytes[static_cast<size_t>(at)], 8);
                if (heapPtr(v)) globals.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(at), v});
            }
        }
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> wvToRvas;
        for (const auto& g : globals) wvToRvas[g.second].push_back(g.first);
        std::vector<uint64_t> wvs;
        wvs.reserve(wvToRvas.size());
        for (const auto& kv : wvToRvas) wvs.push_back(kv.first);
        sayf("[*] method 3 (tables): %zu module globals, %zu distinct target objects; checking Near(+0x%X)/Far(+0x%X)",
             globals.size(), wvs.size(), nearOff, farOff);

        auto headerOk = [&](const uint64_t* hdr, uint64_t& buf, uint32_t& count) {
            buf = hdr[0];
            count = static_cast<uint32_t>(hdr[1] & 0xFFFFFFFF);
            return heapPtr(buf) && count >= 1 && count <= 20000;
        };
        struct Surv { uint64_t wv, nearBuf, farBuf; uint32_t nearCnt, farCnt; };
        std::vector<Surv> surv;
        constexpr size_t kBatch = 16384;
        for (size_t s = 0; s < wvs.size(); s += kBatch) {
            const size_t n = std::min(kBatch, wvs.size() - s);
            std::vector<uint64_t> buf(n * 4);
            std::vector<Process::ReadReq> reqs(n * 2);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                reqs[i * 2] = {static_cast<uintptr_t>(wvs[s + i] + nearOff), &buf[i * 4], 16};
                reqs[i * 2 + 1] = {static_cast<uintptr_t>(wvs[s + i] + farOff), &buf[i * 4 + 2], 16};
            }
            p.readMany(reqs);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                uint64_t nb = 0, fb = 0;
                uint32_t nc = 0, fc = 0;
                const bool nk = reqs[i * 2].ok && headerOk(&buf[i * 4], nb, nc);
                const bool fk = reqs[i * 2 + 1].ok && headerOk(&buf[i * 4 + 2], fb, fc);
                if (nk || fk) surv.push_back({wvs[s + i], nk ? nb : 0, fk ? fb : 0, nk ? nc : 0, fk ? fc : 0});
            }
        }
        sayf("[*] method 3: %zu object(s) with a Near/Far-shaped table; confirming entity vtables", surv.size());

        auto tableHoldsEntity = [&](uint64_t bufAddr, uint32_t count) {
            const uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(count, 16);
            if (!n) return false;
            std::vector<uint64_t> slots(n, 0);
            if (!p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(bufAddr), slots.data(), n * 8)) return false;
            std::vector<Process::ReadReq> vreq;
            std::vector<uint64_t> vts(n, 0);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                if (heapPtr(slots[i])) vreq.push_back({static_cast<uintptr_t>(slots[i]), &vts[i], 8});
            if (vreq.empty()) return false;
            p.readMany(vreq);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                if (entVts.count(vts[i])) return true;
            return false;
        };
        for (const auto& sv : surv) {
            const bool ok = (sv.nearBuf && tableHoldsEntity(sv.nearBuf, sv.nearCnt)) ||
                            (sv.farBuf && tableHoldsEntity(sv.farBuf, sv.farCnt));
            if (!ok) continue;
            const std::string cls = classNameAt(p, img, sv.wv);
            for (uint32_t rva : wvToRvas[sv.wv]) addCand(rva, sv.wv);
            sayf("[+] method 3: World 0x%llX %s - Near count %u, Far count %u (%zu global(s) point here)",
                 (unsigned long long)sv.wv, cls.empty() ? "(no RTTI)" : ("(" + cls + ")").c_str(), sv.nearCnt, sv.farCnt,
                 wvToRvas[sv.wv].size());
        }
    }

    if (cands.empty() && cfg.localLink) {
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> innerTargets;
        for (uint64_t pl : players) innerTargets.insert(pl + cfg.localAdj);
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> linkTargets;
        for (const auto& h : scanPointers(p, img.ptrSize, innerTargets))
            if (h.addr > cfg.localDeref) linkTargets.insert(h.addr - cfg.localDeref);
        if (linkTargets.empty()) {
            say("[*] method 1 (link): no weak-ref holder for the player - the link offsets moved; trying method 2");
        } else {
            std::unordered_set<uint64_t> worldSet;
            for (const auto& h : scanPointers(p, img.ptrSize, linkTargets))
                if (h.addr > cfg.localLink) worldSet.insert(h.addr - cfg.localLink);
            for (const auto& h : scanPointers(p, img.ptrSize, worldSet))
                if (h.addr >= base && h.addr < imgHi) {
                    addCand(static_cast<uint32_t>(h.addr - base), h.value);
                    sayf("[*] method 1 (link): base+0x%X -> World 0x%llX", static_cast<uint32_t>(h.addr - base), (unsigned long long)h.value);
                }
        }
    }

    if (cands.empty()) {
        const auto pslots = scanPointers(p, img.ptrSize, playerSet);
        constexpr int kMaxIndex = 512;
        constexpr size_t kMaxBufTargets = 4000000;
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> bufTargets;
        for (const auto& h : pslots) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kMaxIndex; ++k) {
                const uint64_t b = h.addr - uint64_t(k) * 8;
                if (b < 0x10000) break;
                bufTargets.insert(b);
            }
            if (bufTargets.size() > kMaxBufTargets) break;
        }
        std::vector<PtrHit> bslots = scanPointers(p, img.ptrSize, bufTargets);
        std::sort(bslots.begin(), bslots.end(), [](const PtrHit& a, const PtrHit& b) { return a.addr < b.addr; });
        for (const auto& sec : img.sections) {
            if (sec.exec() || !(sec.flags & 0x80000000)) continue;
            const uint64_t hi = std::min<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(sec.rva) + sec.vsize, img.bytes.size());
            for (uint64_t at = sec.rva; at + 8 <= hi; at += 8) {
                uint64_t wv = 0;
                std::memcpy(&wv, &img.bytes[static_cast<size_t>(at)], 8);
                if (!heapPtr(wv)) continue;
                auto it = std::lower_bound(bslots.begin(), bslots.end(), wv,
                                           [](const PtrHit& h, uint64_t v) { return h.addr < v; });
                for (; it != bslots.end() && it->addr < wv + 0x4000; ++it) {
                    const uint32_t off = static_cast<uint32_t>(it->addr - wv);
                    uint64_t buf = 0;
                    int32_t count = 0;
                    if (!p.readPtr(static_cast<uintptr_t>(wv + off), 8, buf) || buf != it->value) continue;
                    if (!p.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(wv + off + 8), count) || count <= 0 || count > 20000) continue;
                    addCand(static_cast<uint32_t>(at), wv);
                    sayf("[*] method 2 (table): base+0x%X -> World 0x%llX, table +0x%X (buf 0x%llX, count %d)",
                         static_cast<uint32_t>(at), (unsigned long long)wv, off, (unsigned long long)buf, count);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (cands.empty()) {
        say("[!] world finder: could not recover the World global from either method.");
        say("    Last resort: stand among several infected/players and run the normal dump (run_dump.bat).");
        return;
    }

    std::sort(cands.begin(), cands.end(), [](const Cand& a, const Cand& b) { return a.xrefs > b.xrefs; });
    for (const auto& c : cands)
        sayf("[+] World global candidate: base+0x%X  ->  World 0x%llX  [%zu code refs]", c.rva, (unsigned long long)c.world, c.xrefs);
    sayf("[+] NEW worldRva = 0x%X   <-- set dz::kWorld (src\\esp.cpp) and the dayz profile (src\\profile.cpp) to this", cands.front().rva);

    std::vector<std::string> tlog;
    scanWorldTables(p, img, cands.front().world, tlog);
    for (const auto& l : tlog) say("[*] " + l);
}
```

```h
                     const std::vector<Entity>& entities, const std::function<void(const std::string&)>& log);
```

`src/dma.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "process.h"
#include "clock.h"
#include "telemetry.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 4200 4201 4324)
#include "keyboard_resolver.h"
#pragma warning(pop)

namespace {

using PfnInitialize = VMM_HANDLE (*)(DWORD, LPCSTR*);
using PfnClose = VOID (*)(VMM_HANDLE);
using PfnMemFree = VOID (*)(PVOID);
using PfnPidGetFromName = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, LPCSTR, PDWORD);
using PfnMemReadEx = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, ULONG64, PBYTE, DWORD, PDWORD, ULONG64);
using PfnGetModuleFromNameU = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, LPCSTR, PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY*, DWORD);
using PfnGetVadU = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, BOOL, PVMMDLL_MAP_VAD*);
using PfnScatterInitialize = VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, DWORD);
using PfnScatterPrepareEx = BOOL (*)(VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE, QWORD, DWORD, PBYTE, PDWORD);
using PfnScatterExecuteRead = BOOL (*)(VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE);
using PfnScatterCloseHandle = VOID (*)(VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE);
using PfnConfigSet = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, ULONG64, ULONG64);
using PfnMemReadScatter = DWORD (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, PPMEM_SCATTER, DWORD, DWORD);
using PfnVirt2Phys = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, ULONG64, PULONG64);
using PfnGetPhysMem = BOOL (*)(VMM_HANDLE, PVMMDLL_MAP_PHYSMEM*);

constexpr uint64_t kPageSize = 0x1000;
constexpr uint64_t kPageMask = ~uint64_t(0xFFF);
constexpr DWORD kPidPhysical = (DWORD)-1;
constexpr size_t kChunkPages = 48;
constexpr size_t kChunkPagesBg = 16;

enum : int { kPrioBg = 0, kPrioNormal = 1, kPrioUrgent = 2 };
thread_local int tlPrio = kPrioNormal;
thread_local bool tlUrgent = false;

std::string exeDirectory() {
    char buf[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, buf, MAX_PATH);
    std::string p = buf;
    return p.substr(0, p.find_last_of("\\/"));
}

bool fileExists(const std::string& p) { return GetFileAttributesA(p.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES; }

DWORD toPageProtect(DWORD vadProt) {
    switch (vadProt & 7) {
        case 1: return PAGE_READONLY;
        case 2: return PAGE_EXECUTE;
        case 3: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
        case 4: return PAGE_READWRITE;
        case 5: return PAGE_WRITECOPY;
        case 6: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE;
        case 7: return PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
        default: return PAGE_NOACCESS;
    }
}

thread_local int tlHeld = 0;
struct TimedLock {
    std::recursive_mutex& m;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    uint64_t waitUs = 0;
#endif
    explicit TimedLock(std::recursive_mutex& mx) : m(mx) {
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        if (!m.try_lock()) {
            const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
            m.lock();
            waitUs = qpcUs() - t0;
        }
#else
        m.lock();
#endif
        ++tlHeld;
    }
    ~TimedLock() {
        --tlHeld;
        m.unlock();
    }
};

struct UrgentMark {
    std::atomic<int>& n;
    bool on;
    explicit UrgentMark(std::atomic<int>* c) : n(c[tlPrio]), on(tlPrio > kPrioBg) {
        if (on) n.fetch_add(1);
    }
    void done() {
        if (on) n.fetch_sub(1);
        on = false;
    }
    ~UrgentMark() { done(); }
};

class DmaProcess : public Process {
public:
    DmaProcess(std::string device, std::string dllDir, bool ownRefresh)
        : device_(std::move(device)), dllDir_(std::move(dllDir)), ownRefresh_(ownRefresh), noPaging_(ownRefresh) {}

    void maintain() override {
        TimedLock lk(mx_);
        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        pollKeyboard(now);
        if (physRead_ && now - lastPteFlush_ >= 1000) {
            lastPteFlush_ = now;
            pteCache_.clear();
            tel::count(tel::C_PTE_FLUSH);
        }
        if (!ownRefresh_ || !configSet_ || !vmm_ || now - lastTlb_ < 1000) return;
        lastTlb_ = now;
        pteCache_.clear();
        const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
        configSet_(vmm_, VMMDLL_OPT_REFRESH_FREQ_TLB_PARTIAL, 1);
        tel::time(tel::T_REFRESH, qpcUs() - t0);
        tel::count(tel::C_REFRESHES);
    }

    ~DmaProcess() override {
        if (vmm_ && close_) close_(vmm_);
        if (dll_) FreeLibrary(dll_);
    }

    bool attach(const std::string& exeName, std::string& err) override {
        if (!vmm_ && !init(err)) return false;

        DWORD pid = 0;
        if (!pidFromName_(vmm_, exeName.c_str(), &pid)) {
            const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
            bool found = false;
            if (ownRefresh_ && configSet_ && now - lastProcRefresh_ >= 2000) {
                lastProcRefresh_ = now;
                configSet_(vmm_, VMMDLL_OPT_REFRESH_FREQ_MEDIUM, 1);
                found = pidFromName_(vmm_, exeName.c_str(), &pid) != FALSE;
            }
            if (!found) {
                err = exeName + " not running";
                return false;
            }
        }
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY entry = nullptr;
        if (!moduleFromName_(vmm_, pid, exeName.c_str(), &entry, VMMDLL_MODULE_FLAG_NORMAL) || !entry) {
            err = "main module not found yet";
            return false;
        }
        mod_.name = entry->uszText ? entry->uszText : exeName;
        mod_.base = static_cast<uintptr_t>(entry->vaBase);
        mod_.size = entry->cbImageSize;
        memFree_(entry);
        pid_ = pid;
        pteCache_.clear();
        captureAliveProbes();
        return true;
    }

    bool read(uintptr_t addr, void* out, size_t size) const override {
        const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
        yieldToHigher();
        UrgentMark um(waiting_);
        TimedLock lk(mx_);
        um.done();
        if (!vmm_ || !pid_) return false;
        bool ok;
        if (physRead_) {
            ReadReq r{addr, out, size, false};
            readPhys(&r, 1);
            ok = r.ok;
        } else {
            ok = readVirt(addr, out, size);
            tel::count(tel::C_SCATTERS);
        }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        tel::CallInfo ci;
        ci.single = true;
        ci.reqs = 1;
        ci.reqsOk = ok ? 1 : 0;
        ci.bytes = size;
        ci.bytesOk = ok ? size : 0;
        ci.totalUs = qpcUs() - t0;
        ci.lockUs = lk.waitUs;
        tel::call(ci);
#endif
        return ok;
    }

    size_t readMany(std::vector<ReadReq>& reqs) const override {
        const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
        if (reqs.empty()) return 0;
        size_t n = 0;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        uint64_t lockUs = 0;
#endif
        std::vector<uint64_t> pages;
        std::vector<ReadReq*> deferred;
        for (size_t begin = 0; begin < reqs.size();) {
            size_t end = reqs.size();
            if (!tlUrgent) {
                pages.clear();
                for (end = begin; end < reqs.size(); ++end) {
                    const ReadReq& r = reqs[end];
                    const uint64_t first = uint64_t(r.addr) & kPageMask;
                    const uint64_t last = r.size ? (uint64_t(r.addr) + r.size - 1) & kPageMask : first;
                    size_t added = 0;
                    for (uint64_t va = first; va <= last; va += kPageSize)
                        if (std::find(pages.begin(), pages.end(), va) == pages.end()) ++added;
                    if (end > begin && pages.size() + added > (tlPrio == kPrioBg ? kChunkPagesBg : kChunkPages)) break;
                    for (uint64_t va = first; va <= last; va += kPageSize)
                        if (std::find(pages.begin(), pages.end(), va) == pages.end()) pages.push_back(va);
                }
            }
            yieldToHigher();
            UrgentMark um(waiting_);
            TimedLock lk(mx_);
            um.done();
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
            lockUs += lk.waitUs;
#endif
            if (!vmm_ || !pid_) return n;
            n += readManyLocked(reqs.data() + begin, end - begin, &deferred);
            begin = end;
        }
        for (size_t begin = 0; begin < deferred.size();) {
            const size_t end = tlUrgent ? deferred.size() : std::min(deferred.size(), begin + (tlPrio == kPrioBg ? kChunkPagesBg : kChunkPages));
            yieldToHigher();
            UrgentMark um(waiting_);
            TimedLock lk(mx_);
            um.done();
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
            lockUs += lk.waitUs;
#endif
            if (!vmm_ || !pid_) return n;
            n += readVirtBatchLocked(deferred.data() + begin, end - begin);
            begin = end;
        }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        tel::CallInfo ci;
        ci.reqs = static_cast<uint32_t>(reqs.size());
        for (const ReadReq& r : reqs) {
            ci.bytes += r.size;
            if (r.ok) {
                ++ci.reqsOk;
                ci.bytesOk += r.size;
            }
        }
        ci.totalUs = qpcUs() - t0;
        ci.lockUs = lockUs;
        tel::call(ci);
#endif
        return n;
    }

    bool readable(uintptr_t addr) const override {
        uint8_t b;
        return read(addr, &b, 1);
    }

    std::vector<Region> regions(uint64_t maxAddr) const override {
        TimedLock lk(mx_);
        std::vector<Region> out;
        if (!vmm_ || !pid_) return out;
        PVMMDLL_MAP_VAD vad = nullptr;
        if (!vadU_(vmm_, pid_, FALSE, &vad) || !vad) return out;
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < vad->cMap; ++i) {
            const VMMDLL_MAP_VADENTRY& e = vad->pMap[i];
            if (e.vaStart >= maxAddr || e.vaEnd < e.vaStart) continue;
            Region r;
            r.base = static_cast<uintptr_t>(e.vaStart);
            r.size = static_cast<size_t>(e.vaEnd - e.vaStart + 1);
            r.protect = toPageProtect(e.Protection);
            if (e.Protection & 0x10) r.protect |= PAGE_GUARD;
            r.type = e.fImage ? MEM_IMAGE : e.fPrivateMemory ? MEM_PRIVATE : MEM_MAPPED;
            if (r.protect & PAGE_GUARD || r.protect == PAGE_NOACCESS) continue;
            out.push_back(r);
        }
        memFree_(vad);
        return out;
    }

    bool alive() const override {
        TimedLock lk(mx_);
        if (!vmm_ || !pid_ || !mod_.base) return false;
        struct PagingOk {
            bool& f;
            explicit PagingOk(bool& b) : f(b) { f = true; }
            ~PagingOk() { f = false; }
        } po(pagingOk_);
        uint16_t mz = 0;
        if (read(mod_.base, &mz, sizeof mz) && mz == 0x5A4D) return true;
        for (const auto& p : probes_) {
            uint8_t b[sizeof p.bytes];
            if (read(p.addr, b, sizeof b) && memcmp(b, p.bytes, sizeof b) == 0) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

private:
    struct AliveProbe {
        uintptr_t addr;
        uint8_t bytes[16];
    };

    void captureAliveProbes() {
        constexpr int kProbes = 16;
        probes_.clear();
        uint8_t hdr[0x1000];
        if (!read(mod_.base, hdr, sizeof hdr)) return;
        const auto* dos = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(hdr);
        if (dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE || dos->e_lfanew <= 0 ||
            size_t(dos->e_lfanew) + sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64) > sizeof hdr) return;
        const auto* nt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*>(hdr + dos->e_lfanew);
        if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) return;
        const auto* sec = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
        const int nsec = nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
        if (reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(sec + nsec) > hdr + sizeof hdr) return;
        std::vector<std::pair<uintptr_t, size_t>> ranges;
        size_t total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nsec; ++i) {
            const DWORD c = sec[i].Characteristics;
            if (c & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE) continue;
            if (!(c & (IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE | IMAGE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA))) continue;
            const size_t len = std::min<size_t>(sec[i].Misc.VirtualSize, sec[i].SizeOfRawData);
            if (len < 0x1000) continue;
            ranges.push_back({mod_.base + sec[i].VirtualAddress, len});
            total += len;
        }
        if (!total) return;
        const size_t step = total / (kProbes * 2);
        for (int k = 0; k < kProbes * 2 && int(probes_.size()) < kProbes; ++k) {
            size_t off = step * size_t(k) + 0x800;
            for (const auto& r : ranges) {
                if (off < r.second) {
                    AliveProbe p;
                    p.addr = r.first + off;
                    if (off + 16 <= r.second && read(p.addr, p.bytes, sizeof p.bytes)) probes_.push_back(p);
                    break;
                }
                off -= r.second;
            }
        }
    }

    DWORD virtFlags() const { return VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHE | (noPaging_ && !pagingOk_ ? VMMDLL_FLAG_NOPAGING : 0); }

    void resolveKeyboard(uint64_t now) {
        if (now < remoteLookupAt_ || remoteUnsupported_) return;
        remoteLookupAt_ = now + 3000;
        if (!vmm_ || !remoteModule_ || !remoteProcesses_ || !remoteProcess_ || !remoteRegistry_) return;

        VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION game{};
        game.magic = VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION_MAGIC;
        game.wVersion = VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION_VERSION;
        game.wSize = sizeof game;
        SIZE_T size = sizeof game;
        if (!remoteProcess_(vmm_, pid_, &game, &size) || !game.win.dwSessionId) return;

        const dma_keyboard::Reader reader{vmm_, readEx_, remoteModule_, remoteProcesses_, memFree_, remoteRegistry_};
        try {
            const auto [build, revision] = reader.version();
            // Enable the undocumented bitmap only on the build exercised by the two-PC test.
            if (build != 26200 || revision != 9711) {
                remoteUnsupported_ = true;
                return;
            }
            remoteAddress_ = dma_keyboard::resolve(reader, game.win.dwSessionId);
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            remoteAddress_ = {};
        }
    }

    void pollKeyboard(uint64_t now) {
        const uint64_t requested = remoteRequestedAt_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (!requested || (now >= requested && now - requested >= 1000) ||
            now - remoteLastPollAt_ < 8) return;
        remoteLastPollAt_ = now;
        if (!remoteAddress_.va) resolveKeyboard(now);
        if (!remoteAddress_.va) return;

        dma_keyboard::Sample sample{remoteAddress_.pid};
        DWORD got = 0;
        if (!readEx_(vmm_, sample.pid, remoteAddress_.va, sample.bits.data(), DWORD(sample.bits.size()), &got,
                     virtFlags() | VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHEPUT) || got != sample.bits.size()) {
            remoteAddress_ = {};
            sample = {};
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(remoteSampleMx_);
        remoteSampleAt_ = GetTickCount64();
        remoteSample_ = sample;
    }

    dma_keyboard::Sample remoteKeySample() const override {
        const uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
        remoteRequestedAt_.store(now, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        // The DMA worker publishes snapshots so a busy game read cannot starve the render thread.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(remoteSampleMx_);
        return remoteSampleAt_ && (now <= remoteSampleAt_ || now - remoteSampleAt_ < 200)
            ? remoteSample_ : dma_keyboard::Sample{};
    }

    mutable std::atomic<uint64_t> remoteRequestedAt_{0};
    dma_keyboard::Address remoteAddress_;
    uint64_t remoteLookupAt_ = 0;
    uint64_t remoteLastPollAt_ = 0;
    bool remoteUnsupported_ = false;
    mutable std::mutex remoteSampleMx_;
    uint64_t remoteSampleAt_ = 0;
    dma_keyboard::Sample remoteSample_;

    bool readVirt(uintptr_t addr, void* out, size_t size) const {
        DWORD got = 0;
        const BOOL ok = readEx_(vmm_, pid_, addr, static_cast<PBYTE>(out), static_cast<DWORD>(size), &got, virtFlags());
        return ok && got == size;
    }

    size_t readManyLocked(ReadReq* reqs, size_t count, std::vector<ReadReq*>* deferVirt = nullptr) const {
        if (physRead_) return readPhys(reqs, count, deferVirt);
        size_t n = 0;
        VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE hs = scatterInit_ ? scatterInit_(vmm_, pid_, VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHE) : nullptr;
        if (!hs) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) n += (reqs[i].ok = readVirt(reqs[i].addr, reqs[i].out, reqs[i].size)) ? 1 : 0;
            return n;
        }
        std::vector<DWORD> got(count, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            scatterPrepareEx_(hs, reqs[i].addr, static_cast<DWORD>(reqs[i].size), static_cast<PBYTE>(reqs[i].out), &got[i]);
        const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
        scatterExecuteRead_(hs);
        tel::time(tel::T_DEVICE, qpcUs() - t0);
        tel::count(tel::C_SCATTERS);
        scatterClose_(hs);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) n += (reqs[i].ok = got[i] == reqs[i].size) ? 1 : 0;
        return n;
    }

    bool higherWaiting() const {
        for (int p = tlPrio + 1; p <= kPrioUrgent; ++p)
            if (waiting_[p].load(std::memory_order_relaxed) > 0) return true;
        return false;
    }
    void yieldToHigher() const {
        if (tlUrgent || tlHeld) return;
        if (!higherWaiting()) return;
        const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
        while (higherWaiting() && qpcUs() - t0 < 2000) std::this_thread::yield();
    }

    uint64_t vaToPa(uint64_t vaPage) const {
        auto it = pteCache_.find(vaPage);
        if (it != pteCache_.end()) return it->second;
        uint64_t pa = 0;
        if (!virt2phys_(vmm_, pid_, vaPage, &pa)) pa = 0;
        pa &= kPageMask;
        pteCache_.emplace(vaPage, pa);
        return pa;
    }

    size_t readPhys(ReadReq* reqs, size_t count, std::vector<ReadReq*>* deferVirt = nullptr) const {
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, size_t> frameSlot;
        std::vector<uint64_t> frames;
        std::vector<char> needVirt(count, 0);

        const uint64_t tx0 = qpcUs();
        const size_t cached0 = pteCache_.size();
        size_t looks = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            reqs[i].ok = false;
            if (!reqs[i].size || !reqs[i].out) { reqs[i].ok = (reqs[i].size == 0); continue; }
            const uint64_t firstVa = uint64_t(reqs[i].addr) & kPageMask;
            const uint64_t lastVa = (uint64_t(reqs[i].addr) + reqs[i].size - 1) & kPageMask;
            for (uint64_t va = firstVa; va <= lastVa; va += kPageSize) {
                ++looks;
                const uint64_t pa = vaToPa(va);
                if (!pa) { needVirt[i] = 1; break; }
                if (frameSlot.emplace(pa, frames.size()).second) frames.push_back(pa);
            }
        }
        tel::time(tel::T_XLATE, qpcUs() - tx0);
        tel::count(tel::C_PTE_HIT, looks - (pteCache_.size() - cached0));
        tel::count(tel::C_PTE_MISS, pteCache_.size() - cached0);

        if (!frames.empty()) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> buf(frames.size() * kPageSize);
            std::vector<MEM_SCATTER> mems(frames.size());
            std::vector<PMEM_SCATTER> pp(frames.size());
            for (size_t s = 0; s < frames.size(); ++s) {
                MEM_SCATTER& m = mems[s];
                std::memset(&m, 0, sizeof m);
                m.version = MEM_SCATTER_VERSION;
                m.qwA = frames[s];
                m.pb = buf.data() + s * kPageSize;
                m.cb = static_cast<DWORD>(kPageSize);
                pp[s] = &m;
            }
            const uint64_t td0 = qpcUs();
            scatterRead_(vmm_, kPidPhysical, pp.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(pp.size()), VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHE | VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHEPUT);
            tel::time(tel::T_DEVICE, qpcUs() - td0);
            tel::count(tel::C_SCATTERS);
            tel::count(tel::C_PAGES, frames.size());
            uint64_t pagesFailed = 0;
            for (const MEM_SCATTER& m : mems) pagesFailed += m.f ? 0 : 1;
            tel::count(tel::C_PAGES_FAIL, pagesFailed);

            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                if (needVirt[i] || !reqs[i].size) continue;
                uint8_t* dst = static_cast<uint8_t*>(reqs[i].out);
                uint64_t va = reqs[i].addr;
                size_t left = reqs[i].size;
                bool ok = true;
                while (left) {
                    const uint64_t pa = vaToPa(va & kPageMask);
                    const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(va & 0xFFF);
                    const size_t n = std::min(left, static_cast<size_t>(kPageSize - off));
                    const auto slot = frameSlot.find(pa);
                    if (!pa || slot == frameSlot.end() || !mems[slot->second].f) { ok = false; break; }
                    std::memcpy(dst, buf.data() + slot->second * kPageSize + off, n);
                    dst += n; va += n; left -= n;
                }
                if (ok) reqs[i].ok = true; else needVirt[i] = 1;
            }
        }

        size_t ok = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            if (!reqs[i].ok && needVirt[i] && reqs[i].size && reqs[i].out) {
                if (deferVirt) {
                    deferVirt->push_back(&reqs[i]);
                    continue;
                }
                reqs[i].ok = readVirt(reqs[i].addr, reqs[i].out, reqs[i].size);
                tel::count(tel::C_VIRT_FB);
                if (!reqs[i].ok) tel::count(tel::C_VIRT_FB_FAIL);
            }
            if (reqs[i].ok) ++ok;
        }
        return ok;
    }

    size_t readVirtBatchLocked(ReadReq* const* rs, size_t count) const {
        size_t n = 0;
        VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE hs = scatterInit_ ? scatterInit_(vmm_, pid_, virtFlags()) : nullptr;
        if (!hs) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) n += (rs[i]->ok = readVirt(rs[i]->addr, rs[i]->out, rs[i]->size)) ? 1 : 0;
        } else {
            std::vector<DWORD> got(count, 0);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                scatterPrepareEx_(hs, rs[i]->addr, static_cast<DWORD>(rs[i]->size), static_cast<PBYTE>(rs[i]->out), &got[i]);
            const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
            scatterExecuteRead_(hs);
            tel::time(tel::T_VIRT, qpcUs() - t0);
            scatterClose_(hs);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) n += (rs[i]->ok = got[i] == rs[i]->size) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        tel::count(tel::C_VIRT_FB, count);
        tel::count(tel::C_VIRT_FB_FAIL, count - n);
        return n;
    }

    bool writeMemMap(const std::string& path) {
        const auto getPhysMem = reinterpret_cast<PfnGetPhysMem>(GetProcAddress(dll_, "VMMDLL_Map_GetPhysMem"));
        PVMMDLL_MAP_PHYSMEM map = nullptr;
        if (!getPhysMem || !getPhysMem(vmm_, &map) || !map) return false;
        bool ok = false;
        if (map->dwVersion == VMMDLL_MAP_PHYSMEM_VERSION && map->cMap > 0) {
            FILE* f = nullptr;
            if (!fopen_s(&f, path.c_str(), "w") && f) {
                for (DWORD i = 0; i < map->cMap; ++i)
                    std::fprintf(f, "%016llx - %016llx\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(map->pMap[i].pa),
                                 static_cast<unsigned long long>(map->pMap[i].pa + map->pMap[i].cb - 1));
                ok = std::fclose(f) == 0;
            }
        }
        memFree_(map);
        return ok;
    }

    bool init(std::string& err) {
        std::vector<std::string> dirs;
        if (!dllDir_.empty()) dirs.push_back(dllDir_);
        dirs.push_back(exeDirectory() + "\\dma");
        dirs.push_back(exeDirectory());
        for (const auto& d : dirs) {
            const std::string path = d + "\\vmm.dll";
            if (fileExists(path)) {
                dll_ = LoadLibraryExA(path.c_str(), nullptr, LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH);
                if (dll_) break;
                err = "fatal: can't load " + path + " (error " + std::to_string(GetLastError()) + ")";
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (!dll_) dll_ = LoadLibraryA("vmm.dll");
        if (!dll_) {
            err = "fatal: vmm.dll not found";
            return false;
        }

        auto sym = [&](const char* name) { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(dll_, name)); };
        initialize_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnInitialize>(sym("VMMDLL_Initialize"));
        close_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnClose>(sym("VMMDLL_Close"));
        memFree_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnMemFree>(sym("VMMDLL_MemFree"));
        pidFromName_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnPidGetFromName>(sym("VMMDLL_PidGetFromName"));
        readEx_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnMemReadEx>(sym("VMMDLL_MemReadEx"));
        moduleFromName_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnGetModuleFromNameU>(sym("VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU"));
        remoteModule_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(remoteModule_)>(sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU"));
        remoteProcesses_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(remoteProcesses_)>(sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll"));
        remoteProcess_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(remoteProcess_)>(sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation"));
        remoteRegistry_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(remoteRegistry_)>(sym("VMMDLL_WinReg_QueryValueExU"));
        vadU_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnGetVadU>(sym("VMMDLL_Map_GetVadU"));
        if (!initialize_ || !close_ || !memFree_ || !pidFromName_ || !readEx_ || !moduleFromName_ || !vadU_) {
            err = "fatal: wrong vmm.dll version";
            return false;
        }
        scatterInit_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnScatterInitialize>(sym("VMMDLL_Scatter_Initialize"));
        scatterPrepareEx_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnScatterPrepareEx>(sym("VMMDLL_Scatter_PrepareEx"));
        scatterExecuteRead_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnScatterExecuteRead>(sym("VMMDLL_Scatter_ExecuteRead"));
        scatterClose_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnScatterCloseHandle>(sym("VMMDLL_Scatter_CloseHandle"));
        if (!scatterPrepareEx_ || !scatterExecuteRead_ || !scatterClose_) scatterInit_ = nullptr;
        scatterRead_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnMemReadScatter>(sym("VMMDLL_MemReadScatter"));
        virt2phys_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnVirt2Phys>(sym("VMMDLL_MemVirt2Phys"));
        physRead_ = scatterRead_ && virt2phys_;
        configSet_ = reinterpret_cast<PfnConfigSet>(sym("VMMDLL_ConfigSet"));
        if (!configSet_) ownRefresh_ = false;

        std::string dev = device_.empty() ? "fpga" : device_;
        const std::string mmap = exeDirectory() + "\\mmap.txt";
        const auto open = [&](const std::string& memmap) {
            std::vector<LPCSTR> argv = {"", "-device", dev.c_str(), "-waitinitialize"};
            if (!memmap.empty()) {
                argv.push_back("-memmap");
                argv.push_back(memmap.c_str());
            }
            if (ownRefresh_) argv.push_back("-norefresh");
            return initialize_(DWORD(argv.size()), argv.data());
        };
        bool haveMap = fileExists(mmap);
        if (haveMap) vmm_ = open(mmap);
        if (!vmm_) {
            vmm_ = open("");
            if (vmm_ && haveMap) DeleteFileA(mmap.c_str());
            haveMap = false;
        }
        if (vmm_ && !haveMap && writeMemMap(mmap)) {
            close_(vmm_);
            vmm_ = open(mmap);
            haveMap = vmm_ != nullptr;
            if (!vmm_) {
                vmm_ = open("");
                if (vmm_) DeleteFileA(mmap.c_str());
            }
        }
        lastTlb_ = lastPteFlush_ = GetTickCount64();
        if (!vmm_) {
            err = "fatal: MemProcFS init failed (" + dev + ")";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    std::string device_, dllDir_;
    bool ownRefresh_ = false;
    bool noPaging_ = false;
    mutable bool pagingOk_ = false;
    ULONGLONG lastProcRefresh_ = 0;
    bool physRead_ = false;
    ULONGLONG lastTlb_ = 0, lastPteFlush_ = 0;
    mutable std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint64_t> pteCache_;
    std::vector<AliveProbe> probes_;
    mutable std::recursive_mutex mx_;
    mutable std::atomic<int> waiting_[3] = {};
    PfnConfigSet configSet_ = nullptr;
    HMODULE dll_ = nullptr;
    VMM_HANDLE vmm_ = nullptr;
    PfnInitialize initialize_ = nullptr;
    PfnClose close_ = nullptr;
    PfnMemFree memFree_ = nullptr;
    PfnPidGetFromName pidFromName_ = nullptr;

    PfnScatterExecuteRead scatterExecuteRead_ = nullptr;
    PfnScatterCloseHandle scatterClose_ = nullptr;
    PfnMemReadScatter scatterRead_ = nullptr;
    PfnVirt2Phys virt2phys_ = nullptr;
};

}

void markUrgentReadThread() {
    tlPrio = kPrioUrgent;
    tlUrgent = true;
}
```

```cpp
void logLine(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char line[1024];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    std::vsnprintf(line, sizeof line, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    std::puts(line);
    if (!gLog) return;
    SYSTEMTIME t;
    GetLocalTime(&t);
    std::fprintf(gLog, "%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d %s\n", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, t.wMilliseconds, line);
    std::fflush(gLog);
}

}

std::string moduleOffset(const void* a) {
    char buf[400];
    HMODULE m = nullptr;
    if (GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, reinterpret_cast<LPCSTR>(a), &m) && m) {
        char name[MAX_PATH] = "?";
        GetModuleFileNameA(m, name, MAX_PATH);
        const char* slash = std::strrchr(name, '\\');
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s+0x%llX", slash ? slash + 1 : name,
                      static_cast<unsigned long long>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(a) - reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(m)));
    } else {
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%p", a);
    }
    return buf;
}

void logCrash(const char* what, const EXCEPTION_POINTERS* ep) {
    static std::atomic<bool> once{false};
    if (once.exchange(true) || !gLog) return;
    std::fprintf(gLog, "CRASH: %s on thread %lu\n", what, GetCurrentThreadId());
    if (ep && ep->ExceptionRecord) {
        const EXCEPTION_RECORD* er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
        std::fprintf(gLog, "CRASH: code 0x%08lX at %s", er->ExceptionCode, moduleOffset(er->ExceptionAddress).c_str());
        if (er->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && er->NumberParameters >= 2)
            std::fprintf(gLog, ", %s address 0x%llX", er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1 ? "writing" : er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 8 ? "executing" : "reading",
                         static_cast<unsigned long long>(er->ExceptionInformation[1]));
        std::fputc('\n', gLog);
    }
    void* frames[48];
    const USHORT n = CaptureStackBackTrace(0, 48, frames, nullptr);
    for (USHORT i = 0; i < n; ++i) std::fprintf(gLog, "CRASH:   #%u %s\n", unsigned(i), moduleOffset(frames[i]).c_str());
    std::fflush(gLog);
}

LONG WINAPI crashFilter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS* ep) {
    logCrash("unhandled exception", ep);
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

void terminateHandler() {
    const char* what = "std::terminate (uncaught C++ exception or noexcept violation)";
    char buf[300];
    if (const std::exception_ptr ep = std::current_exception()) {
        try {
            std::rethrow_exception(ep);
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "uncaught C++ exception: %s", e.what());
            what = buf;
        } catch (...) {
        }
    }
    logCrash(what, nullptr);
    std::abort();
}

void installCrashHandlers() {
    SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(crashFilter);
    std::set_terminate(terminateHandler);
    std::signal(SIGABRT, [](int) { logCrash("abort() called", nullptr); });
    _set_purecall_handler([] { logCrash("pure virtual call", nullptr); });
    _set_invalid_parameter_handler([](const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*, unsigned, uintptr_t) { logCrash("invalid CRT parameter", nullptr); });
}

    MONITORINFOEXA mi{};

    logLine("[log] %s: %ld,%ld %ldx%ld on %s, visible=%d topmost=%d dpi=%u foreground=%d", what, r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left,
         r.bottom - r.top, mi.szDevice, IsWindowVisible(hwnd) ? 1 : 0, (GetWindowLongA(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE) & WS_EX_TOPMOST) ? 1 : 0,
         GetDpiForWindow(hwnd), GetForegroundWindow() == hwnd ? 1 : 0);
}

HWND findGameWindow(DWORD pid) {
    struct Ctx {
        DWORD pid;
        HWND hwnd;
    } ctx{pid, nullptr};
    EnumWindows(
        [](HWND hwnd, LPARAM lp) -> BOOL {
            auto* c = reinterpret_cast<Ctx*>(lp);
            DWORD p = 0;
            GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, &p);
            if (p != c->pid || !IsWindowVisible(hwnd) || GetWindow(hwnd, GW_OWNER)) return TRUE;
            c->hwnd = hwnd;
            return FALSE;
        },
        reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&ctx));
    return ctx.hwnd;
}

bool placeOverlay() {
    if (!gGame || !IsWindow(gGame)) gGame = findGameWindow(gProc->pid());
    if (!gGame || IsIconic(gGame) || GetForegroundWindow() != gGame) {
        ShowWindow(gOverlay, SW_HIDE);
        return false;
    }
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(gGame, &rc);
    POINT tl{0, 0};
    ClientToScreen(gGame, &tl);
    SetWindowPos(gOverlay, HWND_TOPMOST, tl.x, tl.y, rc.right, rc.bottom, SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
    gView = {0, 0, rc.right, rc.bottom};
    return true;
}

bool placeDmaView(const float* proj) {
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(gOverlay, &rc);
    if (rc.right <= 0 || rc.bottom <= 0) return false;
    float aspect = 16.f / 9;
    if (proj && proj[0] > 0 && proj[5] > 0) aspect = proj[5] / proj[0];
    int vw = rc.right, vh = int(vw / aspect);
    if (vh > rc.bottom) {
        vh = rc.bottom;
        vw = int(vh * aspect);
    }
    const int ox = (rc.right - vw) / 2, oy = (rc.bottom - vh) / 2;
    gView = {ox, oy, ox + vw, oy + vh};
    return true;
}

bool updateFrame(const char*& stage, int& count);

bool update() {
    static ULONGLONG lastAliveCheck = 0;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    static ULONGLONG lastStatus = 0;
    static const char* lastStage = "";
    static int frames = 0;
#endif
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (now - lastAliveCheck >= 500) {
        lastAliveCheck = now;
        static int aliveMiss = 0;
        if (gProc->alive()) {
            aliveMiss = 0;
        } else if (++aliveMiss >= 4) {
            logLine("[log] game process gone on the target (%d checks)", aliveMiss);
            aliveMiss = 0;
            return false;
        }
    }
    {
        static bool upWas = false, dnWas = false;
        const bool up = (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_PRIOR) & 0x8000) != 0, dn = (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_NEXT) & 0x8000) != 0;
        if ((up && !upWas) || (dn && !dnWas)) {
            gSettings.predictMs = std::max(0, std::min(60, gSettings.predictMs + (up && !upWas ? 1 : -1)));
            logLine("[log] predict_ms = %d", gSettings.predictMs);
            saveSettings(gSettings);
        }
        upWas = up;
        dnWas = dn;
    }
    const char* stage = "";
    int count = 0;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    static LARGE_INTEGER freq{};
    if (!freq.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&freq);
    LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1;
#endif
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
#endif
    updateFrame(stage, count);
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
    ++frames;
    {
        const double ms = double(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / double(freq.QuadPart);
        tel::time(tel::T_SCAN, uint64_t(ms * 1000.0));
        tel::count(tel::C_SCANS);
        if (std::strcmp(stage, "ok") != 0 && std::strcmp(stage, "") != 0) tel::count(tel::C_SCANS_BAD);
    }
#endif
    gProc->maintain();

    static ULONGLONG lastFps = now;
    static int fpsFrames = 0;
    ++fpsFrames;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    static double readSum = 0, readMax = 0;
    const double readMs = double(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / double(freq.QuadPart);
    readSum += readMs;
    readMax = std::max(readMax, readMs);
#endif
    if (now - lastFps >= 1000) {
        gFps = int(fpsFrames * 1000 / (now - lastFps));
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        gReadAvgMs = readSum / fpsFrames;
        gReadMaxMs = readMax;
        readSum = readMax = 0;
#endif
        lastFps = now;
        fpsFrames = 0;
    }

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    if (std::strcmp(stage, lastStage) != 0) {
        logLine("[log] frame: %s", stage);
        lastStage = stage;
    }
    if (now - lastStatus >= 2000) {
        logLine("[log] status: %d frames/2s (%d fps, reads %.1f ms avg / %.1f max, paint %.1f ms), players=%d boxes=%zu view=%ld,%ld %ldx%ld",
                frames, gFps, gReadAvgMs.load(), gReadMaxMs.load(), gPaintMs, count, gBoxes.size(), gView.left, gView.top, gView.right - gView.left,
                gView.bottom - gView.top);
        if (gDma) logWindow("window", gOverlay);
        lastStatus = now;
        frames = 0;
    }
#endif
    return true;
}

struct Cam {
    Vec3 right, up, fwd, pos;
    float px, py;
};

bool orthonormal(const float* r) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i)
        if (!std::isfinite(r[i])) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const float* a = r + 3 * i;
        if (std::fabs(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2] - 1) > 0.02f) return false;
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 3; ++j) {
            const float* b = r + 3 * j;
            if (std::fabs(a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]) > 0.02f) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool parseCam(const uint8_t* b, Cam& c) {
    static uint32_t basis = kCamBasis;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    static bool logged = false, warnedProj = false;
#endif
    auto fits = [&](uint32_t o) { return o + 48 <= kCamBytes && orthonormal(reinterpret_cast<const float*>(b + o)); };
    if (!fits(basis)) {
        uint32_t found = 0;
        for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 48 <= kCamBytes && !found; o += 4)
            if (fits(o)) found = o;
        if (!found) return false;
        logLine("[!] DayZ camera basis is not at +0x%X; using +0x%X", basis, found);
        basis = found;
    }
    std::memcpy(&c.right, b + basis, 12);
    std::memcpy(&c.up, b + basis + 12, 12);
    std::memcpy(&c.fwd, b + basis + 24, 12);
    std::memcpy(&c.pos, b + basis + 36, 12);
    std::memcpy(&c.px, b + kCamProjD1, 4);
    std::memcpy(&c.py, b + kCamProjD2 + 4, 4);
    if (!(c.px > 0.05f && c.px < 20 && c.py > 0.05f && c.py < 20)) {
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        if (!warnedProj) logLine("[!] DayZ camera projection unreadable (%.3f, %.3f); assuming 90 deg 16:9", c.px, c.py);
        warnedProj = true;
#endif
        c.px = 1;
        c.py = 9.f / 16;
    }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    if (!logged) {
        logLine("[log] DayZ camera: basis +0x%X, pos %.1f %.1f %.1f, tan(fov/2) %.3f x %.3f", basis, c.pos.x, c.pos.y, c.pos.z, c.px, c.py);
        logged = true;
    }
#endif
    return true;
}

bool toScreen(const Cam& c, const Vec3& p, float w, float h, float& sx, float& sy) {
    const Vec3 d{p.x - c.pos.x, p.y - c.pos.y, p.z - c.pos.z};
    const float x = d.x * c.right.x + d.y * c.right.y + d.z * c.right.z;
    const float y = d.x * c.up.x + d.y * c.up.y + d.z * c.up.z;
    const float z = d.x * c.fwd.x + d.y * c.fwd.y + d.z * c.fwd.z;
    if (z < 0.1f) return false;
    sx = w / 2 * (1 + x / c.px / z);
    sy = h / 2 * (1 - y / c.py / z);
    return true;
}

bool heapPtr(uint64_t v) { return v >= 0x10000 && v < 0x7FFFFFFF0000ull && v % 8 == 0; }

inline Vec3 vadd(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z}; }
inline Vec3 vsub(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z}; }
inline Vec3 vscale(const Vec3& a, float s) { return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s}; }
inline float vdot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z; }
inline Vec3 vcross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x}; }
inline float vlen(const Vec3& a) { return std::sqrt(vdot(a, a)); }
inline Vec3 vlerp(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, float t) { return vadd(vscale(a, 1 - t), vscale(b, t)); }
inline Vec3 rodrigues(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& k, float rad) {
    const float c = std::cos(rad), s = std::sin(rad);
    return vadd(vadd(vscale(v, c), vscale(vcross(k, v), s)), vscale(k, vdot(k, v) * (1 - c)));
}
```
