```cpp
void drawDzIcon(Canvas& cv, const char* const* icon, int cx, int cy, int cell, COLORREF col) {
    const int x0 = cx - 7 * cell / 2, y0 = cy - 7 * cell / 2;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        const int o = pass == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        const COLORREF c = pass == 0 ? RGB(1, 1, 1) : col;
        for (int r = 0; r < 7; ++r)
            for (int i = 0; i < 7;) {
                if (icon[r][i] != '#') { ++i; continue; }
                int j = i;
                while (j < 7 && icon[r][j] == '#') ++j;
                cv.fill({x0 + i * cell - o, y0 + r * cell - o, x0 + j * cell + o, y0 + (r + 1) * cell + o}, c);
                i = j;
            }
    }
}

float drawRadarView(Canvas& cv, const RECT& area, const Vec3& c, float R, bool full) {
    const int l = area.left, t = area.top, r = area.right, b = area.bottom;
    const float w = float(r - l), h = float(b - t);
    const float k = std::min(w, h) / 2.f / R;
    const float cx = l + w / 2.f, cy = t + h / 2.f;
    auto sx = [&](float x) { return cx + (x - c.x) * k; };
    auto sy = [&](float z) { return cy - (z - c.z) * k; };
    cv.fill(area, RGB(24, 26, 30));

    const float M = dzMapSize(gSettings.dzMap);
    const float x0 = c.x - w / 2.f / k, x1 = c.x + w / 2.f / k, z0 = c.z - h / 2.f / k, z1 = c.z + h / 2.f / k;
    const float cx0 = std::max(0.f, x0), cx1 = std::min(M, x1), cz0 = std::max(0.f, z0), cz1 = std::min(M, z1);
    if (cx1 > cx0 && cz1 > cz0) {
        const RECT dst{LONG(sx(cx0)), LONG(sy(cz1)), LONG(sx(cx1)), LONG(sy(cz0))};
        const std::string base = dzMapBase(gSettings.dzMap);
        if (!cv.image(base + ".png", cx0 / M, (M - cz1) / M, cx1 / M, (M - cz0) / M, dst, full ? 1.f : 0.85f))
            cv.image(base + ".jpg", cx0 / M, (M - cz1) / M, cx1 / M, (M - cz0) / M, dst, full ? 1.f : 0.85f);
    }

    if (full) {
        const float step = R > 400 ? 1000.f : 100.f;
        cv.pen(RGB(90, 95, 105), 1);
        for (float gx = std::ceil(x0 / step) * step; gx <= x1; gx += step) {
            const int px = int(sx(gx));
            cv.line(px, t, px, b);
            char lab[16];
            std::snprintf(lab, sizeof lab, step >= 1000 ? "%02.0f" : "%03.0f", gx / 100.f / (step >= 1000 ? 10.f : 1.f));
            cv.text(lab, {px + 3, b - 18, px + 60, b - 2}, RGB(170, 175, 185), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
        }
        for (float gz = std::ceil(z0 / step) * step; gz <= z1; gz += step) {
            const int py = int(sy(gz));
            cv.line(l, py, r, py);
            char lab[16];
            std::snprintf(lab, sizeof lab, step >= 1000 ? "%02.0f" : "%03.0f", (M - gz) / 100.f / (step >= 1000 ? 10.f : 1.f));
            cv.text(lab, {r - 40, py + 2, r - 2, py + 18}, RGB(170, 175, 185), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
        }
    } else {
        cv.pen(RGB(70, 75, 85), 1);
        cv.ellipse(int(cx - w / 4.f), int(cy - h / 4.f), int(cx + w / 4.f), int(cy + h / 4.f));
        cv.line(int(cx), t, int(cx), b);
        cv.line(l, int(cy), r, int(cy));
    }
    {
        const int maxTier = full ? (R <= 1200 ? 3 : R <= 4000 ? 2 : 1) : (R <= 600 ? 2 : 1);
        static const COLORREF kTierCol[] = {RGB(255, 255, 255), RGB(250, 245, 225), RGB(215, 215, 205), RGB(170, 190, 205)};
        for (const DzPlace& p : dzPlaces()) {
            if (p.tier > maxTier) continue;
            const int px = int(sx(p.x)), py = int(sy(p.z));
            if (px < l + 4 || px > r - 4 || py < t + 18 || py > b - 18) continue;
            const RECT box{px - 150, py - 8, px + 150, py + 8};
            cv.text(p.name.c_str(), {box.left + 1, box.top + 1, box.right + 1, box.bottom + 1}, RGB(1, 1, 1), DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);
            cv.text(p.name.c_str(), box, kTierCol[p.tier], DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);
        }
    }

    cv.pen(RGB(120, 125, 140), 1);
    cv.rect(l, t, r, b);
    cv.text("N", {l, t + 2, r, t + 18}, RGB(230, 230, 230), DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);

    const Vec3& me = gDzRadar.me;
    const float scale = std::clamp(gSettings.dzRadarMarker, 0.5f, 2.5f);
    const int entCell = std::max(1, int((full ? 2.f : 1.5f) * scale + 0.5f));
    const int lootCell = std::max(1, int((full ? 1.5f : 1.f) * scale + 0.5f));
    auto layer = [](int kind) { return kind >= 10 ? 0 : kind >= 3 ? 1 : kind == 2 ? 2 : 3; };
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 4; ++pass)
    for (const RadarPt& p : gDzRadar.pts) {
        if (layer(p.kind) != pass) continue;
        if (p.kind == 2 && !gSettings.dzInfected) continue;
        const int px = int(sx(p.x)), py = int(sy(p.z));
        const bool loot = p.kind >= 10;
        if (loot && !::loot::visible(gSettings.dzLootCats, p.kind - 10, p.name ? *p.name : std::string())) continue;
        const COLORREF col = loot ? dzLootColor(p.kind - 10) : dzKindColor(p.kind, !(p.name && friends::contains(*p.name)));
        int hs = 0;
        if (loot) {
            const int cell = (p.kind == 10 + LC_Rare) ? entCell : lootCell;
            hs = 7 * cell / 2 + 1;
            if (px - hs < l || px + hs >= r || py - hs < t || py + hs >= b) continue;
            drawDzIcon(cv, kIconLoot[std::clamp(p.kind - 10, 0, ::loot::Count - 1)], px, py, cell, col);
        } else {
            const int s = std::max(2, (full ? 2 : 1) * entCell + 1);
            const int w2 = p.kind == 4 ? s + 2 : s;
            hs = w2 + 2;
            if (px - hs < l || px + hs >= r || py - hs < t || py + hs >= b) continue;
            cv.fill({px - w2 - 1, py - s - 1, px + w2 + 1, py + s + 1}, RGB(8, 9, 11));
            cv.fill({px - w2, py - s, px + w2, py + s}, col);
            if (p.kind == 1) cv.fill({px - 1, py - 1, px + 1, py + 1}, RGB(248, 248, 250));
        }
        if (!gSettings.dzRadarNames || !p.name) continue;
        const float d = std::sqrt((p.x - me.x) * (p.x - me.x) + (p.z - me.z) * (p.z - me.z));
        const bool label = loot ? (p.kind == 10 + LC_Rare || d <= float(std::max(25, gSettings.dzRadarLootLabel))) : p.kind != 2;
        if (!label) continue;
        char txt[96];
        if (loot) std::snprintf(txt, sizeof txt, "%s", p.name->c_str());
        else std::snprintf(txt, sizeof txt, "%s  %.0fm", p.name->empty() ? "?" : p.name->c_str(), d);
        const int tw = int(std::strlen(txt)) * 6 + 8;
        const RECT bg{px + hs + 3, py - 7, px + hs + 3 + tw, py + 8};
        cv.fill({bg.left, bg.top, bg.right, bg.bottom}, RGB(14, 16, 20));
        cv.text(txt, {bg.left + 3, bg.top - 1, bg.right, bg.bottom}, col, DT_LEFT | DT_TOP, 11);
    }

    float fx = gDzRadar.fwd.x, fz = gDzRadar.fwd.z;
    const float fl = std::sqrt(fx * fx + fz * fz);
    const float ax = sx(me.x), ay = sy(me.z), as = full ? 2.f : 1.f;
    if (fl > 1e-3f && ax > l && ax < r && ay > t && ay < b) {
        fx /= fl;
        fz /= fl;
        const POINT tip{LONG(ax + fx * 12 * as), LONG(ay - fz * 12 * as)};
        const POINT lw{LONG(ax - (fx * 6 + fz * 6) * as), LONG(ay + (fz * 6 - fx * 6) * as)};
        const POINT rw{LONG(ax - (fx * 6 - fz * 6) * as), LONG(ay + (fz * 6 + fx * 6) * as)};
        const POINT arrow[4] = {lw, tip, rw, lw};
        cv.pen(RGB(1, 1, 1), 4);
        cv.polyline(arrow, 4);
        cv.pen(RGB(255, 255, 255), 2);
        cv.polyline(arrow, 4);
    }
    if (!gDzMeNameDraw.empty() && ax > l && ax < r && ay > t && ay < b && false) {
        const LONG tx = LONG(ax + 14 * as), ty = LONG(ay - 8);
        cv.text(gDzMeNameDraw.c_str(), {tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + 301, ty + 17}, RGB(1, 1, 1), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
        cv.text(gDzMeNameDraw.c_str(), {tx, ty, tx + 300, ty + 16}, RGB(255, 255, 255), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
    }
    return k;
}

void drawDzRadar(Canvas& cv) {
    const int S = std::clamp(gSettings.dzRadarSize, 110, 900);
    const RECT area{gView.right - S - 16, gView.top + 16, gView.right - 16, gView.top + 16 + S};
    drawRadarView(cv, area, gDzRadar.me, float(std::max(25, gSettings.dzRadarRange)), false);
    char scale[32];
    std::snprintf(scale, sizeof scale, "%dm", std::max(25, gSettings.dzRadarRange));
    cv.text(scale, {area.left + 5, area.bottom - 18, area.left + 120, area.bottom - 2}, RGB(200, 200, 200), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
}

void drawScene(Canvas& cv) {
    if (gDma && !gFull) {
        cv.pen(RGB(70, 70, 70), 1);
        cv.rect(gView.left, gView.top, gView.right, gView.bottom);
    }
    if (gSettings.fps) {
        char fps[24];
        std::snprintf(fps, sizeof fps, "%d FPS", gFps);
        cv.text(fps, {gView.left + 7, gView.top + 7, gView.right, gView.top + 27}, RGB(1, 1, 1), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
        cv.text(fps, {gView.left + 6, gView.top + 6, gView.right, gView.top + 26}, RGB(255, 220, 80), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
    }
    for (const auto& b : gBoxes) {
        const COLORREF col = dzKindColor(b.kind, b.enemy);
        const int l = int(b.x), t = int(b.y), r = int(b.x + b.w), btm = int(b.y + b.h);
        const auto& opt = gSettings;
        if (b.kind >= 3) {
            cv.pen(RGB(1, 1, 1), 3);
            cv.rect(l, t, r, btm);
            cv.pen(col, 1);
            cv.rect(l, t, r, btm);
            if (opt.names) cv.text(b.e.name.c_str(), {l - 80, t - 16, r + 80, t - 1}, col, DT_CENTER | DT_BOTTOM);
            if (opt.info) {
                char info[16];
                std::snprintf(info, sizeof info, "%.0fm", b.dist);
                cv.text(info, {l - 80, btm + 1, r + 80, btm + 16}, col, DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);
            }
            continue;
        }

        auto outlined = [&](auto&& draw) {
            cv.pen(RGB(1, 1, 1), 3);
            draw();
            cv.pen(col, 1);
            draw();
        };
        if (opt.box) outlined([&] { cv.rect(l, t, r, btm); });
        if (opt.skeleton && b.skel.ok[DJ_Pelvis] && b.skel.ok[DJ_Neck]) {
            const Skeleton& s = b.skel;
            outlined([&] {
                for (const auto& bone : dz::kDzSkelBones) {
                    if (!s.ok[bone.first] || !s.ok[bone.second]) continue;
                    cv.line(s.pt[bone.first].x, s.pt[bone.first].y, s.pt[bone.second].x, s.pt[bone.second].y);
                }
                if (s.headRadius && s.ok[DJ_Head]) {
                    const POINT c = s.pt[DJ_Head];
                    cv.ellipse(c.x - s.headRadius, c.y - s.headRadius, c.x + s.headRadius, c.y + s.headRadius);
                }
            });
        } else if (opt.skeleton) {
            const int bw = r - l, bh = btm - t;
            auto px = [&](int j) { return POINT{LONG(l + kStick[j].nx * bw), LONG(t + kStick[j].ny * bh)}; };
            const int hr = std::max(2, bw / 6);
            outlined([&] {
                for (const auto& bone : kStickBones) {
                    const POINT a = px(bone.first), c = px(bone.second);
                    cv.line(a.x, a.y, c.x, c.y);
                }
                POINT hd = px(0);
                hd.y += hr;
                cv.ellipse(hd.x - hr, hd.y - hr, hd.x + hr, hd.y + hr);
            });
        }

        if (opt.names) cv.text(b.e.name.c_str(), {l - 80, t - 16, r + 80, t - 1}, col, DT_CENTER | DT_BOTTOM);
        if (opt.info) {
            char info[64];
            std::snprintf(info, sizeof info, b.weapon.empty() ? "%.0fm" : "%.0fm  %s", b.dist, b.weapon.c_str());
            cv.text(info, {l - 80, btm + 1, r + 80, btm + 16}, col, DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);
        }
    }

    if (gSettings.dzLoot && !gDzLootPts.empty()) {
        for (const auto& lp : gDzLootPts) {
            const COLORREF lc = dzLootColor(lp.cat);
            const int x = lp.pt.x, y = lp.pt.y, r = lp.cat == LC_Rare ? 6 : 4;
            const POINT d[5] = {{x, y - r}, {x + r, y}, {x, y + r}, {x - r, y}, {x, y - r}};
            cv.pen(RGB(1, 1, 1), 3);
            cv.polyline(d, 5);
            cv.pen(lc, lp.cat == LC_Rare ? 2 : 1);
            cv.polyline(d, 5);
            if (!lp.name.empty())
                cv.text(lp.name.c_str(), {x - 90, y - r - 16, x + 90, y - r - 2}, lc, DT_CENTER | DT_BOTTOM);
            if (gSettings.info) {
                char info[16];
                std::snprintf(info, sizeof info, "%.0fm", lp.dist);
                cv.text(info, {x - 40, y + r + 1, x + 40, y + r + 15}, lc, DT_CENTER | DT_TOP);
            }
        }
    }

    if (gDzRadar.ok && gSettings.dzRadar) drawDzRadar(cv);

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    if (gSettings.dzBoneIds && !gDzDbgBones.empty()) {
        cv.pen(RGB(0, 255, 255), 1);
        for (const auto& b : gDzDbgBones) {
            cv.ellipse(b.pt.x - 2, b.pt.y - 2, b.pt.x + 2, b.pt.y + 2);
            char num[8];
            std::snprintf(num, sizeof num, "%d", b.idx);
            cv.text(num, {b.pt.x + 3, b.pt.y - 7, b.pt.x + 40, b.pt.y + 8}, RGB(0, 255, 255), DT_LEFT | DT_TOP);
        }
    }
#endif

    if (gSettings.crosshair) {
        const int cx = (gView.left + gView.right) / 2, cy = (gView.top + gView.bottom) / 2;
        const int arm = std::clamp(gSettings.crosshairSize, 4, 40), gap = std::max(2, arm / 3);
        const COLORREF col = RGB(80, 255, 140);
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
            const int o = pass == 0 ? 1 : 0;
            const COLORREF c = pass == 0 ? RGB(1, 1, 1) : col;
            cv.fill({cx - arm - o, cy - o, cx - gap + 1 + o, cy + 1 + o}, c);
            cv.fill({cx + gap - o, cy - o, cx + arm + 1 + o, cy + 1 + o}, c);
            cv.fill({cx - o, cy - arm - o, cx + 1 + o, cy - gap + 1 + o}, c);
            cv.fill({cx - o, cy + gap - o, cx + 1 + o, cy + arm + 1 + o}, c);
            cv.fill({cx - o, cy - o, cx + 1 + o, cy + 1 + o}, c);
        }
    }
}

void paint(HDC hdc, int w, int h) {
    if (!gBack.dc || gBack.w != w || gBack.h != h) {
        gBack.release();
        gBack.dc = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
        gBack.bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, w, h);
        gBack.old = SelectObject(gBack.dc, gBack.bmp);
        gBack.w = w;
        gBack.h = h;
    }
    HDC mem = gBack.dc;
    RECT all{0, 0, w, h};
    HBRUSH key = CreateSolidBrush(kKey);
    FillRect(mem, &all, key);
    DeleteObject(key);
    {
        GdiCanvas cv(mem);
        drawScene(cv);
    }
    BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, mem, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

enum class Run { Idle, Attaching, Running } gRun = Run::Idle;
unsigned gGen = 0;
std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> gCancel;
HWND gPanel = nullptr, gCtl = nullptr;
RECT gScreen{};
constexpr UINT WM_ATTACHED = WM_APP + 10;

struct AttachResult {
    unsigned gen = 0;
    std::unique_ptr<Process> proc;
    std::map<uint64_t, int> dzKinds;
    std::map<uint64_t, int> dzLootVts;
    std::string err;
};

constexpr const char* kGameExe = "DayZ_x64.exe";

PanelInfo espInfo() {
    PanelInfo in;
    if (gRun != Run::Running || !gProc) return in;
    in.pid = gProc->pid();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzServerMx);
        in.server = gDzServer;
    }
    if (gDma) in.mbps = speed::gLinkMBps;
    return in;
}

void destroyRadarScreen();

void stopEsp() {
    ++gGen;
    if (gCancel) *gCancel = true;
    gCancel.reset();
    destroyRadarScreen();
    stopDzThread();
    gGpu.reset();
    gGpuFails = 0;
    if (gOverlay) DestroyWindow(gOverlay);
    gOverlay = nullptr;
    gGame = nullptr;
    gProc.reset();
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzSnapMx); gDzSnap = DzSnap{}; }
    gDzKinds.clear();
    gDzLootVts.clear();
    gDzLootCat.clear();
    gDzEntHeld.clear();
    gDzItemName.clear();
    gDzRoster.clear();
    gDzEntNetId.clear();
    gDzRadar = DzRadar{};
    gDzEntKind.clear();
    gDzEntPos.clear();
    gDzEntVs.clear();
    gDzEntVel.clear();
    gDzEntPosUs.clear();
    gDzEntFwd.clear();
    gDzEntName.clear();
    gDzEntChain.clear();
    gDzEntJointOfs.clear();
    gDzEntReadUs.clear();
    gDzEntBoneUs.clear();
    gDzEntDead.clear();
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzCamMx); gDzCamShare = DzCamShare{}; }
    gDzLootVs.clear();
    gDzLootPos.clear();
    gDzLootName.clear();
    gDzLootPts.clear();
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzLootMx); gDzLootList.reset(); gDzLootSlotsPub = 0; }
    gDzWorld = 0;
    gBoxes.clear();
    gBack.release();
    gFps = 0;
    if (gRun != Run::Idle) logLine("[*] stopped");
    gRun = Run::Idle;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzServerMx); gDzServer.clear(); }
}

LRESULT CALLBACK wndProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    switch (msg) {
        case WM_ERASEBKGND: return 1;
        case WM_PAINT: {
            PAINTSTRUCT ps;
            HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
            if (!(gGpu && hwnd == gOverlay)) {
                RECT rc;
                GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
                paint(hdc, rc.right, rc.bottom);
            }
            EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_CLOSE: stopEsp(); return 0;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        case WM_DISPLAYCHANGE: logLine("[log] display change: %ux%u", LOWORD(lp), HIWORD(lp)); break;
        case WM_DPICHANGED: logLine("[log] window moved to a monitor with dpi %u", LOWORD(wp)); break;
#endif
    }
    return DefWindowProcA(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

ULONGLONG gRadarTick = 0;

constexpr ULONGLONG kSaveDelayMs = 500;
ULONGLONG gSaveDue = 0;
void saveSettingsSoon() { gSaveDue = GetTickCount64() + kSaveDelayMs; }
void flushSettings(bool now = false) {
    if (!gSaveDue || (!now && GetTickCount64() < gSaveDue)) return;
    gSaveDue = 0;
    saveSettings(gSettings);
}

void destroyRadarScreen() { radar::destroy(); }

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
const bool gRadarLogWired = [] {
    radar::setLog([](const char* s) { logLine("%s", s); });
    mapdl::setLog([](const char* s) { logLine("%s", s); });
    return true;
}();
#endif

void syncRadarScreen() {
    static bool f8Was = false;
    const bool f8 = (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_F8) & 0x8000) != 0;
    if (f8 && !f8Was) {
        gSettings.dzRadarScreen = !gSettings.dzRadarScreen;
        saveSettings(gSettings);
        if (gPanel) InvalidateRect(gPanel, nullptr, FALSE);
    }
    f8Was = f8;

    dzMapDownloads();

    {
        std::string detected;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzMapMx);
            detected.swap(gDzMapDetected);
        }
        if (!detected.empty() && gSettings.dzMapAuto && gSettings.dzMap != detected) {
            gSettings.dzMap = detected;
            saveSettings(gSettings);
        }
    }

    const bool wantShow = gSettings.dzRadarScreen;
    if (!wantShow && !radar::visible()) return;
    if (wantShow && radar::visible()) {
        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        if (now - gRadarTick < 33) return;
        gRadarTick = now;
    }

    RECT tgt{};
    const RECT* ptgt = nullptr;
    for (const auto& d : listDisplays())
        if (!EqualRect(&d.rc, &gScreen)) {
            tgt = d.rc;
            ptgt = &tgt;
            break;
        }

    radar::Frame fr;
    fr.ok = gDzRadar.ok;
    if (fr.ok) {
        fr.meX = gDzRadar.me.x;
        fr.meZ = gDzRadar.me.z;
        fr.fwdX = gDzRadar.fwd.x;
        fr.fwdZ = gDzRadar.fwd.z;
        fr.meName = gDzMeNameDraw;
        fr.mapBase = dzMapBase(gSettings.dzMap);
        fr.mapSize = dzMapSize(gSettings.dzMap);
        const Vec3& me = gDzRadar.me;

        static const COLORREF kTierCol[] = {RGB(255, 255, 255), RGB(250, 245, 225), RGB(215, 215, 205), RGB(170, 190, 205)};
        for (const DzPlace& p : dzPlaces()) fr.places.push_back({p.x, p.z, p.tier, kTierCol[p.tier], p.name});

        for (const RadarPt& p : gDzRadar.pts) {
            const bool isLoot = p.kind >= 10;
            radar::Dot dot;
            dot.x = p.x;
            dot.z = p.z;
            if (isLoot) {
                dot.icon = radar::Icon::Loot;
                dot.cat = p.kind - 10;
            } else {
                dot.color = dzKindColor(p.kind, !(p.name && friends::contains(*p.name)));
                dot.fwdX = p.fwdX;
                dot.fwdZ = p.fwdZ;
                switch (p.kind) {
                    case 2: dot.icon = radar::Icon::Infected; break;
                    case 3: dot.icon = radar::Icon::Animal; break;
                    case 4: dot.icon = radar::Icon::Vehicle; break;
                    default: dot.icon = radar::Icon::Survivor; break;
                }
            }
            if (p.name && !(isLoot ? p.name->empty() : p.kind == 2)) {
                char txt[160];
                if (isLoot) {
                    std::snprintf(txt, sizeof txt, "%s", p.name->c_str());
                } else {
                    const float d = std::sqrt((p.x - me.x) * (p.x - me.x) + (p.z - me.z) * (p.z - me.z));
                    const bool held = p.held && !p.held->empty() && gSettings.dzHeld;
                    std::snprintf(txt, sizeof txt, held ? "%s  %.0fm\n%s" : "%s  %.0fm", p.name->empty() ? "?" : p.name->c_str(), d,
                                  held ? p.held->c_str() : "");
                }
                dot.label = txt;
            }
            if (!isLoot && p.name) dot.name = *p.name;
            fr.dots.push_back(std::move(dot));
        }

        if (gDzOnlineDraw) {
            std::unordered_map<std::string, float> nearby;
            for (const RadarPt& p : gDzRadar.pts)
                if (p.kind == 1 && p.name && !p.name->empty()) {
                    const float d = std::sqrt((p.x - me.x) * (p.x - me.x) + (p.z - me.z) * (p.z - me.z));
                    const auto it = nearby.find(*p.name);
                    if (it == nearby.end() || d < it->second) nearby[*p.name] = d;
                }
            for (const std::string& nm : *gDzOnlineDraw) {
                const auto it = nearby.find(nm);
                fr.online.push_back({nm, it != nearby.end() ? it->second : -1.f, nm == fr.meName});
            }
        }
    }

    radar::Config cfg;
    cfg.loot = gSettings.dzLoot;
    cfg.lootMask = gSettings.dzLootCats & loot::kAll;
    cfg.filter = loot::filter();
    cfg.headings = gSettings.dzRadarHeadings;
    cfg.headingLen = gSettings.dzRadarHeadingLen;
    cfg.esp.skeleton = gSettings.skeleton;
    cfg.esp.box = gSettings.box;
    cfg.esp.names = gSettings.names;
    cfg.esp.distance = gSettings.info;
    cfg.esp.fps = gSettings.fps;
    cfg.esp.uncapped = gSettings.uncapped;
    cfg.esp.held = gSettings.dzHeld;
    cfg.esp.valuables = gSettings.dzLootValuables;
    cfg.esp.minimap = gSettings.dzRadar;
    cfg.esp.minimapSize = gSettings.dzRadarSize;
    cfg.esp.range = gSettings.dzRange;
    cfg.esp.crosshair = gSettings.crosshair;
    cfg.esp.crosshairSize = gSettings.crosshairSize;
    cfg.animals = gSettings.dzAnimals;
    cfg.vehicles = gSettings.dzVehicles;
    cfg.infected = gSettings.dzInfected;
    cfg.names = gSettings.dzRadarNames;
    cfg.lootLabelRange = gSettings.dzRadarLootLabel;
    cfg.markerScale = gSettings.dzRadarMarker;
    cfg.sideOpen = gSettings.dzSideOpen;
    cfg.menuOpen = gSettings.dzMenu;
    cfg.mapAuto = gSettings.dzMapAuto;
    cfg.map = gSettings.dzMap;
    cfg.mapTopo = gSettings.dzMapTopo;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gDzMapMx);
        cfg.mapDetected = gDzMapSeen.empty() ? std::string() : mapdl::label(gDzMapSeen);
    }
    cfg.mapHigh = gSettings.dzMapHigh;
    cfg.mapList = radarMapList();
    {
        const mapdl::Status st = mapdl::status();
        cfg.dl.busy = st.busy;
        cfg.dl.label = mapdl::label(st.id);
        cfg.dl.phase = st.phase;
        cfg.dl.done = st.done;
        cfg.dl.total = st.total;
        cfg.dl.mbps = float(st.mbps);
        if (st.id == gSettings.dzMap && st.topo == gSettings.dzMapTopo) cfg.dl.error = st.error;
    }

    bool want = wantShow;
    int zoom = std::max(25, gSettings.dzRadarZoom);
    if (!radar::sync(want, zoom, cfg, fr, ptgt)) {
        gSettings.dzRadarScreen = false;
        saveSettings(gSettings);
        if (gPanel) InvalidateRect(gPanel, nullptr, FALSE);
        return;
    }
    const bool zoomed = zoom != gSettings.dzRadarZoom;
    gSettings.dzRadarZoom = zoom;
    if (zoomed) saveSettingsSoon();
    if (cfg.cancelReq) mapdl::cancel();
    if (!cfg.downloadReq.empty()) dzMapDownloadNow(cfg.downloadReq);
    if (cfg.showSetup && gPanel) {
        ShowWindow(gPanel, SW_RESTORE);
        SetWindowPos(gPanel, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
        SetForegroundWindow(gPanel);
    }
    if (cfg.changed) {
        gSettings.dzLoot = cfg.loot;
        gSettings.dzLootCats = cfg.lootMask;
        loot::setFilter(cfg.filter);
        const loot::Filter fl = loot::filter();
        gSettings.dzFilterMode = fl.mode;
        gSettings.dzFilterList = loot::serializeList(fl.list);
        gSettings.dzRadarHeadings = cfg.headings;
        gSettings.dzRadarHeadingLen = cfg.headingLen;
        gSettings.skeleton = cfg.esp.skeleton;
        gSettings.box = cfg.esp.box;
        gSettings.names = cfg.esp.names;
        gSettings.info = cfg.esp.distance;
        gSettings.fps = cfg.esp.fps;
        gSettings.uncapped = cfg.esp.uncapped;
        gSettings.dzHeld = cfg.esp.held;
        gSettings.dzLootValuables = cfg.esp.valuables;
        gSettings.dzRadar = cfg.esp.minimap;
        gSettings.dzRadarSize = cfg.esp.minimapSize;
        gSettings.dzRange = cfg.esp.range;
        gSettings.crosshair = cfg.esp.crosshair;
        gSettings.crosshairSize = cfg.esp.crosshairSize;
        gSettings.dzAnimals = cfg.animals;
        gSettings.dzVehicles = cfg.vehicles;
        gSettings.dzInfected = cfg.infected;
        gSettings.dzRadarNames = cfg.names;
        gSettings.dzRadarLootLabel = cfg.lootLabelRange;
        gSettings.dzRadarMarker = cfg.markerScale;
        gSettings.dzSideOpen = cfg.sideOpen;
        gSettings.dzMenu = cfg.menuOpen;
        if (cfg.mapAuto && !gSettings.dzMapAuto) gDzMapRedetect = true;
        gSettings.dzMapAuto = cfg.mapAuto;
        gSettings.dzMap = cfg.map;
        gSettings.dzMapTopo = cfg.mapTopo;
        gSettings.dzMapHigh = cfg.mapHigh;
        saveSettingsSoon();
    }
    if (wantShow && !want) {
        gSettings.dzRadarScreen = false;
        saveSettings(gSettings);
        if (gPanel) InvalidateRect(gPanel, nullptr, FALSE);
    }
}

void runFrame() {
    if (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_END) & 0x8000) {
        PostMessage(gPanel, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    const bool uncapped = gSettings.uncapped;
    if (gGpu && !uncapped) gGpu->waitForFrame();
    {
        static uint64_t lastFrameUs = 0;
        const uint64_t nowUs = qpcUs();
        if (lastFrameUs) tel::time(tel::T_FRAME, nowUs - lastFrameUs);
        lastFrameUs = nowUs;
        tel::count(tel::C_FRAMES);
    }
    if (gDma) {
        if (!drawDayzFrame()) return;
    } else if (!update()) {
        logLine("[*] game closed");
        stopEsp();
        return;
    }
    if (gGpu) {
        static bool hadMinimap = false;
        static std::string mapWas;
        if ((hadMinimap && !gSettings.dzRadar) || (hadMinimap && mapWas != gSettings.dzMap)) {
            gGpu->releaseImages();
            logLine("[log] minimap: map image released");
        }
        hadMinimap = gSettings.dzRadar;
        mapWas = gSettings.dzMap;
    }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    LARGE_INTEGER f, t0, t1;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
#endif
    bool gpuOk = true;
    if (gGpu) {
        Canvas* cv = gGpu->begin(kKey);
        gpuOk = cv != nullptr;
        if (gpuOk) {
            drawScene(*cv);
            gpuOk = gGpu->end();
        }
    } else {
        RECT rc;
        GetClientRect(gOverlay, &rc);
        HDC hdc = GetDC(gOverlay);
        paint(hdc, rc.right, rc.bottom);
        ReleaseDC(gOverlay, hdc);
    }
    ValidateRect(gOverlay, nullptr);
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
#endif
    if (gGpu) {
        const uint64_t p0 = qpcUs();
        gpuOk = gpuOk && gGpu->present(!uncapped);
        tel::time(tel::T_PRESENT, qpcUs() - p0);
        if (!gpuOk) {
            gGpu.reset();
            std::string err;
            if (++gGpuFails <= 3) gGpu = GpuRenderer::create(gOverlay, err);
            logLine(gGpu ? "[!] GPU renderer lost; recreated" : "[!] GPU renderer lost; using GDI (%s)", err.c_str());
        }
    }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    const double paintMs = double(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / double(f.QuadPart);
    gPaintMs = gPaintMs * 0.9 + paintMs * 0.1;
    tel::time(tel::T_PAINT, uint64_t(paintMs * 1000.0));
#endif
    {
        static uint64_t lastRadarUs = 0;
        const uint64_t nowUs = qpcUs();
        if (!uncapped || nowUs - lastRadarUs >= 6000) {
            lastRadarUs = nowUs;
            syncRadarScreen();
        }
    }
}

bool createOverlay() {
    const HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleA(nullptr);
    static bool registered = false;
    if (!registered) {
        WNDCLASSA wc{};
        wc.lpfnWndProc = wndProc;
        wc.hInstance = inst;
        wc.lpszClassName = "hirschgangware_fullscreen";
        RegisterClassA(&wc);
        wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
        wc.lpszClassName = "hirschgangware_overlay";
        RegisterClassA(&wc);
        registered = true;
    }
    if (gFull) {
        gOverlay = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_TOPMOST, "hirschgangware_fullscreen", "HirschgangWare - DMA view (END quits)", WS_POPUP | WS_VISIBLE, gScreen.left,
                                   gScreen.top, gScreen.right - gScreen.left, gScreen.bottom - gScreen.top, nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr);
        if (gOverlay)
            SetWindowPos(gOverlay, HWND_TOPMOST, gScreen.left, gScreen.top, gScreen.right - gScreen.left, gScreen.bottom - gScreen.top,
                         SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    } else if (gDma) {
        gOverlay = CreateWindowExA(0, "hirschgangware_overlay", "HirschgangWare - DMA view (END quits)", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE, CW_USEDEFAULT,
                                   CW_USEDEFAULT, 1280, 760, nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr);
    } else {
        gOverlay = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, "hirschgangware_overlay",
                                   "HirschgangWare", WS_POPUP, 0, 0, 1, 1, nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr);
        if (gOverlay) SetLayeredWindowAttributes(gOverlay, kKey, 0, LWA_COLORKEY);
    }
    if (!gOverlay) {
        logLine("[-] could not create the window (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        return false;
    }
    if (gDma) logWindow("window created", gOverlay);
    if (gFull) {
        std::string err = "disabled by --gdi";
        if (!gForceGdi) gGpu = GpuRenderer::create(gOverlay, err);
        if (gGpu) logLine("[+] renderer: %s", gGpu->describe().c_str());
        else logLine("[!] renderer: GDI (%s)", err.c_str());
    }
    return true;
}

void startEsp(bool recovering = false) {
    if (gRun != Run::Idle) return;
    gDma = gSettings.dma;
    gFull = gDma && gSettings.fullscreen;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    const EspSettings& o = gSettings;
    logLine("[log] start: %s%s, draw: skeleton=%d box=%d names=%d info=%d fps=%d", gDma ? "DMA" : "this PC", gFull ? " fullscreen" : "",
            o.skeleton, o.box, o.names, o.info, o.fps);
#endif
    if (gFull) {
        const auto displays = listDisplays();
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        for (const auto& d : displays) {
            DEVMODEA dm{};
            dm.dmSize = sizeof dm;
            const DWORD hz = EnumDisplaySettingsA(d.device.c_str(), ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) ? dm.dmDisplayFrequency : 0;
            logLine("[log] display %d: %ldx%ld at %ld,%ld @ %lu Hz%s  (%s)", d.number, d.width(), d.height(), d.rc.left, d.rc.top, hz,
                    d.primary ? " (primary)" : "", d.device.c_str());
        }
#endif
        const DisplayInfo* pick = pickDisplay(displays, gSettings);
        if (!pick) {
            logLine("[-] no display to go fullscreen on");
            return;
        }
        gScreen = pick->rc;
        logLine("[+] fullscreen on display %d (%ldx%ld)", pick->number, pick->width(), pick->height());
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        DEVMODEA pdm{};
        pdm.dmSize = sizeof pdm;
        if (EnumDisplaySettingsA(pick->device.c_str(), ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &pdm)) {
            std::vector<DWORD> rates;
            DEVMODEA m{};
            m.dmSize = sizeof m;
            for (DWORD i = 0; EnumDisplaySettingsA(pick->device.c_str(), i, &m); ++i)
                if (m.dmPelsWidth == pdm.dmPelsWidth && m.dmPelsHeight == pdm.dmPelsHeight &&
                    std::find(rates.begin(), rates.end(), m.dmDisplayFrequency) == rates.end())
                    rates.push_back(m.dmDisplayFrequency);
            std::sort(rates.begin(), rates.end());
            std::string list;
            for (DWORD r : rates) list += (list.empty() ? "" : ", ") + std::to_string(r);
            logLine("[log] display %d refresh rates at %lux%lu: %s Hz (current %lu)", pick->number, pdm.dmPelsWidth, pdm.dmPelsHeight, list.c_str(),
                    pdm.dmDisplayFrequency);
        }
#endif
    }

    gRun = Run::Attaching;
    const unsigned gen = ++gGen;
    auto cancel = gCancel = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
    logLine(gDma ? "[*] waiting for DayZ_x64.exe on the target PC over DMA (offline mode, spawned in)"
                 : "[*] waiting for DayZ_x64.exe (offline mode, spawned in)");
    std::thread([gen, cancel, recovering, dma = gDma, device = gSettings.device, dmaDir = gSettings.dmaDir, ctl = gCtl] {
        auto res = std::make_unique<AttachResult>();
        res->gen = gen;
        res->proc = dma ? makeDmaProcess(device, dmaDir, true) : makeLocalProcess();
        std::string err;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        std::string lastErr;
#endif
        while (!res->proc->attach(kGameExe, err)) {
            if (*cancel) return;
            if (recovering && err.rfind("fatal: MemProcFS init failed", 0) == 0) {
                res->proc = makeDmaProcess(device, dmaDir, true);
                Sleep(1000);
                if (*cancel) return;
                continue;
            }
            if (err.rfind("fatal:", 0) == 0) {
                res->err = err.substr(7);
                res->proc.reset();
                PostMessage(ctl, WM_ATTACHED, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(res.release()));
                return;
            }
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
            if (dma && err != lastErr) logLine("[*] %s", (lastErr = err).c_str());
#endif
            Sleep(500);
        }
        Image img;
        std::vector<VTableInfo> vts;
        const bool loaded = img.load(*res->proc, err);
        for (const auto& [cls, kind] : {std::pair<const char*, int>{"DayZPlayer", 1}, {"DayZInfected", 2}}) {
            if (loaded && findVTables(img, cls, vts, err)) {
                for (const auto& v : vts) res->dzKinds[static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + v.rva] = kind;
                logLine("[+] %s: %zu vtable(s)", cls, vts.size());
            } else {
                const uint64_t rva = kind == 1 ? 0x12E2160 : 0x12FBF70;
                res->dzKinds[res->proc->module().base + rva] = kind;
                logLine("[!] %s RTTI unavailable (%s); using RVA 0x%llX from DayZ 1.30 Main", cls, err.c_str(),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(rva));
            }
        }
        if (loaded) {
            for (const auto& [cls, kind] : {std::pair<const char*, int>{"DayZAnimal", 3}, {"Transport", 4}}) {
                if (!findVTables(img, cls, vts, err)) { logLine("[!] %s RTTI unavailable (%s)", cls, err.c_str()); continue; }
                for (const auto& v : vts) res->dzKinds.emplace(static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + v.rva, kind);
                logLine("[+] %s: %zu vtable(s)", cls, vts.size());
            }
            for (const auto& [cls, cat] : {std::pair<const char*, int>{"Weapon", LC_Weapon}, {"Magazine", LC_Ammo}, {"Clothing_Base", LC_Clothing}}) {
                if (!findVTables(img, cls, vts, err)) { logLine("[!] %s RTTI unavailable (%s)", cls, err.c_str()); continue; }
                for (const auto& v : vts) res->dzLootVts.emplace(static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + v.rva, cat);
                logLine("[+] loot class %s: %zu vtable(s)", cls, vts.size());
            }
        }
        if (*cancel) return;
        PostMessage(ctl, WM_ATTACHED, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(res.release()));
    }).detach();
}

LRESULT CALLBACK ctlProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    if (msg == WM_ATTACHED) {
        std::unique_ptr<AttachResult> r(reinterpret_cast<AttachResult*>(lp));
        if (r->gen != gGen || gRun != Run::Attaching) return 0;
        if (!r->proc) {
            logLine("[-] %s", r->err.c_str());
            stopEsp();
            MessageBoxA(gPanel, r->err.c_str(), "HirschgangWare", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return 0;
        }
        gProc = std::move(r->proc);
        gDzKinds = std::move(r->dzKinds);
        gDzLootVts = std::move(r->dzLootVts);
        dzLoadRare();
        const size_t overrides = loot::loadOverrides(exeDir() + "dayz_loot_cats.txt");
        logLine("[*] dayz_loot_cats.txt: %zu category override(s)", overrides);
        gCancel.reset();
        logLine("[+] attached: pid %lu, base 0x%llX. END quits.", static_cast<unsigned long>(gProc->pid()),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(gProc->module().base));
        if (!createOverlay()) {
            logLine("[-] could not create the overlay window");
            stopEsp();
            return 0;
        }
        gRun = Run::Running;
        if (gDma) startDzThread();
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcA(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
std::string exeDir0() {
    char self[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, self, MAX_PATH);
    return std::string(self).substr(0, std::string(self).find_last_of("\\/"));
}

bool updatePending() {
    static ULONGLONG last = GetTickCount64();
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (now - last < 1000) return false;
    last = now;
    const std::string pending = exeDir0() + "\\HirschgangWare_pending.exe";
    if (GetFileAttributesA(pending.c_str()) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return false;
    const HANDLE h = CreateFileA(pending.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    CloseHandle(h);
    logLine("[log] update pending - exiting to relaunch into the new build");
    return true;
}

int swapAndRelaunch() {
    char selfBuf[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, selfBuf, MAX_PATH);
    const std::string self = selfBuf, dir = exeDir0();
    const std::string old = dir + "\\HirschgangWare_old.exe", pending = dir + "\\HirschgangWare_pending.exe";
    const auto moveRetry = [](const std::string& from, const std::string& to) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; ++i) {
            if (MoveFileExA(from.c_str(), to.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) return true;
            Sleep(250);
        }
        return false;
    };
    if (moveRetry(self, old)) {
        if (moveRetry(pending, self)) {
            logLine("[log] swapped in the new build");
        } else {
            logLine("[!] update: could not move HirschgangWare_pending.exe into place (error %lu) - restarting the old build",
                    GetLastError());
            moveRetry(old, self);
        }
    } else {
        logLine("[!] update: could not rename the running exe (error %lu) - restarting it", GetLastError());
    }
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    if (!CreateProcessW(nullptr, GetCommandLineW(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, 0, nullptr, std::wstring(dir.begin(), dir.end()).c_str(),
                        &si, &pi)) {
        logLine("[!] update: could not relaunch (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        return 10;
    }
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    logLine("[log] relaunched (pid %lu)", pi.dwProcessId);
    return 0;
}
#endif

}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const bool perMonitorDpi = SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2) != FALSE;
    if (!perMonitorDpi) SetProcessDPIAware();

    loadSettings(gSettings);
    friends::load();
    trigger::load();
    loot::setFilter({gSettings.dzFilterMode, loot::parseList(gSettings.dzFilterList)});
    const bool autoStart = argc > 1;
    int monitor = 0;
    long wantW = 0, wantH = 0;
    if (autoStart) {
        gSettings.dma = false;
        gSettings.fullscreen = false;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string a = argv[i];
        if (a == "--dma") gSettings.dma = true;
        else if (a == "--device" && i + 1 < argc) gSettings.device = argv[++i];
        else if (a == "--dma-dir" && i + 1 < argc) gSettings.dmaDir = argv[++i];
        else if (a == "--fullscreen") gSettings.fullscreen = true;
        else if (a == "--gdi") gForceGdi = true;
        else if (a == "--loot") gSettings.dzLoot = true;
        else if (a == "--radar") gSettings.dzRadar = true;
        else if (a == "--map" && i + 1 < argc) { gSettings.dzMap = argv[++i]; gSettings.dzMapAuto = false; }
        else if (a == "--local") gSettings.dma = false;
        else if (a == "--sweep") gWantSweep = true;
        else if (a == "--monitor" && i + 1 < argc) {
            const char* v = argv[++i];
            if (sscanf_s(v, "%ldx%ld", &wantW, &wantH) != 2) monitor = std::atoi(v);
        } else {
            MessageBoxA(nullptr,
                "HirschgangWare [--local | --dma] [--device fpga] [--dma-dir dir] [--fullscreen]\n"
                "      [--monitor n|WxH] [--gdi] [--loot] [--radar] [--map name]\n"
                "no args = just the panel",
                "HirschgangWare", a == "-h" || a == "--help" ? MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION : MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return a == "-h" || a == "--help" ? 0 : 2;
        }
    }
    if (autoStart && gSettings.fullscreen && !gSettings.dma) {
        MessageBoxA(nullptr, "--fullscreen only applies with --dma", "HirschgangWare", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return 2;
    }
    if (monitor || wantW) {
        const auto displays = listDisplays();
        const DisplayInfo* pick = nullptr;
        for (const auto& d : displays)
            if (!pick && (wantW ? d.width() == wantW && d.height() == wantH : d.number == monitor)) pick = &d;
        if (!pick) {
            char msg[96];
            if (wantW) std::snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "No display is %ldx%ld.", wantW, wantH);
            else std::snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "No display %d.", monitor);
            MessageBoxA(nullptr, msg, "HirschgangWare", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return 2;
        }
        gSettings.displayDevice = pick->device;
        gSettings.displayW = pick->width();
        gSettings.displayH = pick->height();
    }

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    openLog();
    trigger::setLog([](const char* s) { logLine("%s", s); });
    trigger::setRemoteKeys([] { return gProc ? gProc->remoteKeySample() : dma_keyboard::Sample{}; });
    installCrashHandlers();
    DeleteFileA((exeDir0() + "\\HirschgangWare_old.exe").c_str());
#endif
    const bool fineTimer = timeBeginPeriod(1) == TIMERR_NOERROR;
    std::string args;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) args += std::string(" ") + argv[i];
    logLine("[log] HirschgangWare " HIRSCHGANGWARE_VERSION " started:%s (per-monitor dpi %s)", autoStart ? args.c_str() : " (panel)", perMonitorDpi ? "on" : "unavailable");

    tel::start([](const char* l) { logLine("%s", l); });

    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartupInput gsi;
    ULONG_PTR token = 0;
    Gdiplus::GdiplusStartup(&token, &gsi, nullptr);
    ui::init();

    WNDCLASSA cc{};
    cc.lpfnWndProc = ctlProc;
    cc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleA(nullptr);
    cc.lpszClassName = "hirschgangware_ctl";
    RegisterClassA(&cc);
    gCtl = CreateWindowExA(0, cc.lpszClassName, "", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, nullptr, cc.hInstance, nullptr);

    gPanel = createPanel(gSettings, {[] { gAutoResumeAt = 0; startEsp(); }, [] { gAutoResumeAt = 0; stopEsp(); },
                                     [] { return gRun != Run::Idle; }, [] { return espInfo(); }});
    if (!gPanel) {
        logLine("[-] could not create the panel (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        return 1;
    }
    if (autoStart) {
        if (gSettings.dma) gSettings.dzRadarScreen = true;
        startEsp();
    }

#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    bool updating = false;
#endif
    MSG m;
    for (bool quit = false; !quit;) {
        while (PeekMessageA(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            if (m.message == WM_QUIT) {
                quit = true;
                break;
            }
            TranslateMessage(&m);
            DispatchMessageA(&m);
        }
        if (quit) break;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
        if (updatePending()) {
            updating = true;
            break;
        }
#endif
        flushSettings();
        {
            static bool tabWas = false;
            const bool tabDown = (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_TAB) & 0x8000) != 0;
            if (tabDown && !tabWas) {
                gSettings.dzSideOpen = !gSettings.dzSideOpen;
                saveSettingsSoon();
                logLine("[*] sidebar %s (Tab)", gSettings.dzSideOpen ? "open" : "collapsed");
            }
            tabWas = tabDown;
        }
        if (gAutoResumeAt && gRun == Run::Idle && GetTickCount64() >= gAutoResumeAt) {
            gAutoResumeAt = 0;
            logLine("[*] auto-resume: attaching again");
            startEsp(true);
        }
        trigger::pollInputs();
        if (gRun == Run::Running && gOverlay) {
            runFrame();
            if (!gGpu && !gSettings.uncapped && FAILED(DwmFlush())) Sleep(5);
        } else {
            syncRadarScreen();
            trigger::update({}, 0.f, 0.f);
            MsgWaitForMultipleObjects(0, nullptr, FALSE, 50, QS_ALLINPUT);
        }
    }
    stopEsp();
    flushSettings(true);
    if (fineTimer) timeEndPeriod(1);
    tel::stop();
    ui::shutdown();
    Gdiplus::GdiplusShutdown(token);
    int exitCode = 0;
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    if (updating) exitCode = swapAndRelaunch();
    logLine("[log] quit%s", updating ? " (for update)" : "");
    if (gLog) std::fclose(gLog);
#endif
    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), UINT(exitCode));
    return exitCode;
}
```

```cpp
#include "esp_launcher.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")

namespace {

constexpr UINT kIdentifyMs = 2500;
constexpr char kSection[] = "HirschgangWare";
constexpr char kIdentifyClass[] = "hirschgangware_identify";
std::vector<HWND> gIdentify;

std::string settingsPath(const char* file) {
    char buf[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, buf, MAX_PATH);
    std::string p = buf;
    return p.substr(0, p.find_last_of("\\/") + 1) + file;
}

std::string iniPath() { return settingsPath("HirschgangWare.ini"); }

bool hasNewSettings() { return GetFileAttributesA(iniPath().c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES; }

std::string readIniPath() {
    return hasNewSettings() ? iniPath() : settingsPath("Ickza.ini");
}

const char* readSection() { return hasNewSettings() ? kSection : "Ickza"; }

LRESULT CALLBACK identifyProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    if (msg == WM_PAINT) {
        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        RECT rc;
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
        FillRect(hdc, &rc, static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH)));
        HFONT big = CreateFontA(-(rc.bottom * 3 / 4), 0, 0, 0, FW_BOLD, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET, OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS,
                                CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, ANTIALIASED_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_SWISS, "Segoe UI");
        HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(hdc, big);
        SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
        SetTextColor(hdc, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        char text[16];
        std::snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%d", static_cast<int>(GetWindowLongPtrA(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA)));
        DrawTextA(hdc, text, -1, &rc, DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER | DT_SINGLELINE);
        SelectObject(hdc, old);
        DeleteObject(big);
        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }
    if (msg == WM_ERASEBKGND) return 1;
    return DefWindowProcA(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

void closeIdentify() {
    for (HWND w : gIdentify) DestroyWindow(w);
    gIdentify.clear();
}

bool readBool(const char* key, bool def) { return GetPrivateProfileIntA(readSection(), key, def ? 1 : 0, readIniPath().c_str()) != 0; }

std::string readString(const char* key, const std::string& def) {
    char buf[8192];
    GetPrivateProfileStringA(readSection(), key, def.c_str(), buf, sizeof buf, readIniPath().c_str());
    return buf;
}

void writeString(const char* key, const std::string& v) { WritePrivateProfileStringA(kSection, key, v.c_str(), iniPath().c_str()); }
void writeBool(const char* key, bool v) { writeString(key, v ? "1" : "0"); }

}

std::vector<DisplayInfo> listDisplays() {
    std::vector<DisplayInfo> out;
    EnumDisplayMonitors(
        nullptr, nullptr,
        [](HMONITOR mon, HDC, LPRECT, LPARAM lp) -> BOOL {
            MONITORINFOEXA mi{};
            mi.cbSize = sizeof mi;
            GetMonitorInfoA(mon, &mi);
            DisplayInfo d;
            d.rc = mi.rcMonitor;
            d.device = mi.szDevice;
            d.primary = (mi.dwFlags & MONITORINFOF_PRIMARY) != 0;
            reinterpret_cast<std::vector<DisplayInfo>*>(lp)->push_back(d);
            return TRUE;
        },
        reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&out));
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const DisplayInfo& a, const DisplayInfo& b) {
        return a.rc.left != b.rc.left ? a.rc.left < b.rc.left : a.rc.top < b.rc.top;
    });
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); ++i) out[i].number = static_cast<int>(i) + 1;
    return out;
}

const DisplayInfo* findDisplay(const std::vector<DisplayInfo>& displays, const EspSettings& s) {
    if (!s.displayDevice.empty())
        for (const auto& d : displays)
            if (_stricmp(d.device.c_str(), s.displayDevice.c_str()) == 0) return &d;
    if (s.displayW > 0 && s.displayH > 0)
        for (const auto& d : displays)
            if (d.width() == s.displayW && d.height() == s.displayH) return &d;
    return nullptr;
}

const DisplayInfo* pickDisplay(const std::vector<DisplayInfo>& displays, const EspSettings& s) {
    if (const DisplayInfo* d = findDisplay(displays, s)) return d;
    for (const auto& d : displays)
        if (!d.primary) return &d;
    return displays.empty() ? nullptr : &displays.front();
}

void identifyDisplays(const std::vector<DisplayInfo>& displays) {
    static bool registered = false;
    if (!registered) {
        WNDCLASSA ic{};
        ic.lpfnWndProc = identifyProc;
        ic.hInstance = GetModuleHandleA(nullptr);
        ic.lpszClassName = kIdentifyClass;
        RegisterClassA(&ic);
        registered = true;
    }
    closeIdentify();
    for (const auto& d : displays) {
        const int side = std::min(d.width(), d.height()) / 3;
        const int x = (d.rc.left + d.rc.right - side) / 2, y = (d.rc.top + d.rc.bottom - side) / 2;
        HWND w = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, kIdentifyClass, "", WS_POPUP, x, y, side, side,
                                 nullptr, nullptr, GetModuleHandleA(nullptr), nullptr);
        if (!w) continue;
        SetWindowLongPtrA(w, GWLP_USERDATA, d.number);
        SetWindowPos(w, HWND_TOPMOST, x, y, side, side, SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
        gIdentify.push_back(w);
    }
    SetTimer(nullptr, 0, kIdentifyMs, [](HWND, UINT, UINT_PTR id, DWORD) {
        KillTimer(nullptr, id);
        closeIdentify();
    });
}

void loadSettings(EspSettings& s) {

    s.crosshairSize = GetPrivateProfileIntA(readSection(), "crosshair_size", s.crosshairSize, readIniPath().c_str());
}

void saveSettings(const EspSettings& s) {
    writeBool("dma", s.dma);
    writeString("device", s.device);
    writeString("dma_dir", s.dmaDir);
    writeBool("fullscreen", s.fullscreen);
    writeString("display_device", s.displayDevice);
    writeString("display_width", std::to_string(s.displayW));
    writeString("display_height", std::to_string(s.displayH));
    writeBool("skeleton", s.skeleton);
    writeBool("fps", s.fps);
    writeBool("uncapped", s.uncapped);
    writeString("predict_ms", std::to_string(s.predictMs));
    writeString("dz_range", std::to_string(s.dzRange));
    writeBool("dz_loot", s.dzLoot);
    writeString("dz_loot_range", std::to_string(s.dzLootRange));
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    writeBool("dz_bone_ids", s.dzBoneIds);
#endif
    writeBool("dz_animals", s.dzAnimals);
    writeBool("dz_vehicles", s.dzVehicles);
    writeBool("dz_loot_valuables", s.dzLootValuables);
    writeBool("dz_held", s.dzHeld);
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
    writeString("dz_name_anchor", s.dzNameAnchor);
#endif
    writeBool("dz_radar", s.dzRadar);
    writeString("dz_radar_range", std::to_string(s.dzRadarRange));
    writeString("dz_radar_size", std::to_string(s.dzRadarSize));
    writeString("dz_map", s.dzMap);
    writeBool("dz_map_auto", s.dzMapAuto);
    writeBool("dz_map_topo", s.dzMapTopo);

    writeBool("dz_radar_screen", s.dzRadarScreen);

    writeBool("names", s.names);
    writeBool("info", s.info);
    writeBool("crosshair", s.crosshair);
    writeString("crosshair_size", std::to_string(s.crosshairSize));
}
```

`src/esp_panel.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "esp_launcher.h"
#include "brand.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "version.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <unordered_map>

#include <dwmapi.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dwmapi.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;
using ui::fillRR;
using ui::fonts;
using ui::strokeRR;
using ui::text;

namespace {

constexpr float W = 740, H = 520;
constexpr float SW = 188;
constexpr float CX = SW + 28, CW = 496;
constexpr float kCorner = 8;
constexpr UINT_PTR kRefreshTimer = 1, kAnimTimer = 2;

namespace th {
const Color bg(255, 14, 14, 20), bgLow(255, 10, 10, 15), side(255, 9, 9, 13);
const Color surface(255, 21, 21, 30), surfaceHot(255, 28, 28, 40), track(255, 44, 44, 60);
const Color border(255, 36, 36, 50), borderHot(255, 58, 58, 80);
const Color text(255, 238, 238, 246), dim(255, 140, 140, 162), faint(255, 84, 84, 106);
const Color a1(255, 124, 92, 255), a2(255, 76, 142, 255), accentText(255, 168, 148, 255);
const Color ok(255, 74, 222, 128), red(255, 244, 87, 107), red2(255, 214, 56, 96), white(255, 255, 255, 255);
}

enum Id : int {
    None = -1, BtnClose, BtnMin, DispPrev, DispNext, BtnFullscreen, BtnIdentify, BtnStart,
};

enum : int { KeyHover = 10000, KeyOn = 20000, KeyRun = 31001 };

struct Hit {
    int id;
    RectF r;
};

struct Anim {
    float v, t;
};

struct Panel {
    HWND hwnd = nullptr;
    float scale = 1.0f;
    int hot = None, down = None;
    bool tracking = false, animTimer = false;
    EspSettings* s = nullptr;
    PanelHooks hooks;
    std::vector<DisplayInfo> displays;
    std::vector<Hit> hits;
    std::unordered_map<int, Anim> anims;
    bool shownRun = false;
    PanelInfo shown;
} p;

void redraw() { InvalidateRect(p.hwnd, nullptr, FALSE); }
bool running() { return p.hooks.running && p.hooks.running(); }


float animTo(int key, float target) {
    auto it = p.anims.find(key);
    if (it == p.anims.end()) {
        p.anims[key] = {target, target};
        return target;
    }
    it->second.t = target;
    return it->second.v;
}

bool anyMoving() {
    for (const auto& kv : p.anims)
        if (kv.second.v != kv.second.t) return true;
    return false;
}

bool stepAnims() {
    bool moving = false;
    for (auto& kv : p.anims) {
        Anim& a = kv.second;
        const float d = a.t - a.v;
        if (std::fabs(d) < 0.01f) {
            a.v = a.t;
            continue;
        }
        a.v += d * 0.34f;
        moving = true;
    }
    return moving;
}

float hover(int id) { return animTo(KeyHover + id, p.hot == id ? 1.0f : 0.0f); }
bool pressed(int id) { return p.down == id && p.hot == id; }


Color lerp(Color a, Color b, float t) {
    t = std::max(0.0f, std::min(1.0f, t));
    auto mix = [&](int x, int y) { return static_cast<BYTE>(x + (y - x) * t + 0.5f); };
    return Color(mix(a.GetA(), b.GetA()), mix(a.GetR(), b.GetR()), mix(a.GetG(), b.GetG()), mix(a.GetB(), b.GetB()));
}

Color withAlpha(Color c, int a) { return Color(static_cast<BYTE>(a), c.GetR(), c.GetG(), c.GetB()); }

void fillGrad(Graphics& g, RectF r, Color c1, Color c2, float rad, LinearGradientMode mode = LinearGradientModeHorizontal) {
    LinearGradientBrush b(RectF(r.X - 0.5f, r.Y - 0.5f, r.Width + 1, r.Height + 1), c1, c2, mode);
    GraphicsPath path;
    ui::roundedRect(path, r, rad);
    g.FillPath(&b, &path);
}

void glow(Graphics& g, RectF r, Color c, float rad, int alpha) {
    for (int i = 9; i >= 1; --i) {
        const float e = i * 1.7f;
        SolidBrush b(withAlpha(c, alpha));
        fillRR(g, b, RectF(r.X - e, r.Y - e + 5, r.Width + e * 2, r.Height + e * 2), rad + e);
    }
}

float textW(Graphics& g, const std::string& s, const Font& f) {
    RectF out;
    const std::wstring w = ui::widen(s);
    g.MeasureString(w.c_str(), -1, &f, PointF(0, 0), &out);
    return out.Width;
}

void label(Graphics& g, const std::string& s, float x, float y, float w = 200) {
    text(g, s, *fonts.micro, RectF(x, y, w, 14), th::faint, StringAlignmentNear);
}

void dot(Graphics& g, float cx, float cy, float r, Color c, bool halo) {
    if (halo) {
        SolidBrush h(withAlpha(c, 46));
        g.FillEllipse(&h, cx - r * 2.2f, cy - r * 2.2f, r * 4.4f, r * 4.4f);
    }
    SolidBrush b(c);
    g.FillEllipse(&b, cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
}

void card(Graphics& g, RectF r, float hot, Color border) {
    SolidBrush b(lerp(th::surface, th::surfaceHot, hot));
    fillRR(g, b, r, 10);
    strokeRR(g, border, r, 10);
}

void switchKnob(Graphics& g, RectF r, float k) {
    SolidBrush trackB(lerp(th::track, th::a1, k));
    fillRR(g, trackB, r, r.Height / 2);
    if (k < 0.5f) strokeRR(g, withAlpha(th::borderHot, static_cast<int>(255 * (1 - 2 * k))), r, r.Height / 2);
    const float d = r.Height - 6;
    SolidBrush knob(lerp(th::dim, th::white, k));
    g.FillEllipse(&knob, r.X + 3 + (r.Width - 6 - d) * k, r.Y + 3, d, d);
}

enum class Icon { Sliders, Crosshair };

void drawIcon(Graphics& g, Icon icon, float x, float y, Color c) {
    Pen pen(c, 1.6f);
    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
    pen.SetLineJoin(LineJoinRound);
    SolidBrush fill(c);
    switch (icon) {
        case Icon::Sliders:
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x, y + 4, x + 18, y + 4);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x, y + 9, x + 18, y + 9);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x, y + 14, x + 18, y + 14);
            for (const auto& k : {PointF(x + 12, y + 4), PointF(x + 5, y + 9), PointF(x + 13, y + 14)}) {
                SolidBrush hole(th::side);
                g.FillEllipse(&hole, k.X - 3, k.Y - 3, 6.0f, 6.0f);
                g.DrawEllipse(&pen, k.X - 2.6f, k.Y - 2.6f, 5.2f, 5.2f);
            }
            break;
        case Icon::Crosshair:
            g.DrawEllipse(&pen, x + 3.5f, y + 3.5f, 11.0f, 11.0f);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x + 9, y, x + 9, y + 5);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x + 9, y + 13, x + 9, y + 18);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x, y + 9, x + 5, y + 9);
            g.DrawLine(&pen, x + 13, y + 9, x + 18, y + 9);
            break;
    }
}


void sideItem(Graphics& g, const std::string& name, Icon icon, float y) {
    const RectF r(12, y, SW - 24, 40);
    SolidBrush bg(Color(15, 255, 255, 255));
    fillRR(g, bg, r, 10);
    drawIcon(g, icon, r.X + 15, r.Y + 11, th::accentText);
    text(g, name, *fonts.semi, RectF(r.X + 46, r.Y, r.Width - 50, r.Height), th::white, StringAlignmentNear);
    fillGrad(g, RectF(0, y + 10, 3.5f, 20), th::a1, th::a2, 1.75f, LinearGradientModeVertical);
}

void winButton(Graphics& g, int id, RectF r, bool close) {
    const float h = hover(id);
    if (h > 0.01f) {
        SolidBrush b(close ? withAlpha(th::red2, static_cast<int>(255 * h)) : Color(static_cast<BYTE>(22 * h), 255, 255, 255));
        fillRR(g, b, r, 8);
    }
    Pen pen(close && h > 0.5f ? th::white : lerp(th::dim, th::text, h), 1.4f);
    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
    const float cx = r.X + r.Width / 2, cy = r.Y + r.Height / 2;
    if (close) {
        g.DrawLine(&pen, cx - 4.5f, cy - 4.5f, cx + 4.5f, cy + 4.5f);
        g.DrawLine(&pen, cx + 4.5f, cy - 4.5f, cx - 4.5f, cy + 4.5f);
    } else {
        g.DrawLine(&pen, cx - 5, cy, cx + 5, cy);
    }
    p.hits.push_back({id, r});
}

void chip(Graphics& g, int id, const std::string& s, RectF r, bool on, bool enabled = true, const Font* f = nullptr) {
    const float h = enabled ? hover(id) : 0.0f;
    const float press = enabled && pressed(id) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    if (on) {
        const float dimK = enabled ? 0.0f : 0.55f;
        const Color c1 = lerp(lerp(th::a1, th::white, h * 0.1f), th::surface, dimK), c2 = lerp(lerp(th::a2, th::white, h * 0.1f), th::surface, dimK);
        fillGrad(g, r, lerp(c1, th::bgLow, press * 0.25f), lerp(c2, th::bgLow, press * 0.25f), 8);
    } else {
        SolidBrush b(lerp(th::surface, th::surfaceHot, h));
        fillRR(g, b, r, 8);
        strokeRR(g, lerp(th::border, th::borderHot, h), r, 8);
    }
    text(g, s, f ? *f : *fonts.semi, r, on ? (enabled ? th::white : th::dim) : enabled ? lerp(th::dim, th::text, h) : th::faint);
    if (enabled) p.hits.push_back({id, r});
}

std::string displayLabel() {
    const DisplayInfo* d = pickDisplay(p.displays, *p.s);
    if (!d) return "no display";
    char buf[96];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "Display %d · %ldx%ld%s", d->number, d->width(), d->height(), d->primary ? " · main" : "");
    return buf;
}


void setupPage(Graphics& g, bool run) {
    label(g, "DISPLAY", CX, 96);
    const RectF dc(CX, 114, CW, 52);
    card(g, dc, 0, th::border);
    {
        const bool fs = p.s->fullscreen;
        chip(g, DispPrev, "‹", RectF(CX + 12, dc.Y + 13, 26, 26), false, !run && fs, fonts.btn.get());
        text(g, fs ? displayLabel() : "Own window on this PC", *fonts.semi, RectF(CX + 42, dc.Y, 176, dc.Height), fs ? th::accentText : th::dim);
        chip(g, DispNext, "›", RectF(CX + 222, dc.Y + 13, 26, 26), false, !run && fs, fonts.btn.get());

        const RectF fsHit(CX + 262, dc.Y + 8, 112, 36);
        const float h = run ? 0.0f : hover(BtnFullscreen), k = animTo(KeyOn + BtnFullscreen, fs ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
        text(g, "Fullscreen", *fonts.caption, RectF(fsHit.X, dc.Y, 66, dc.Height), run ? th::faint : lerp(th::dim, th::text, h), StringAlignmentNear);
        switchKnob(g, RectF(CX + 334, dc.Y + 15, 38, 22), k);
        if (!run) p.hits.push_back({BtnFullscreen, fsHit});

        chip(g, BtnIdentify, "Identify", RectF(CX + CW - 12 - 88, dc.Y + 13, 88, 26), false);
    }

    const RectF sb(CX, 182, CW, 48);
    const float rk = animTo(KeyRun, run ? 1.0f : 0.0f), h = hover(BtnStart), press = pressed(BtnStart) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    glow(g, sb, lerp(th::a1, th::red, rk), 12, static_cast<int>(3 + 3 * h));
    const Color c1 = lerp(lerp(th::a1, th::red, rk), th::white, h * 0.1f), c2 = lerp(lerp(th::a2, th::red2, rk), th::white, h * 0.1f);
    fillGrad(g, sb, lerp(c1, th::bgLow, press * 0.25f), lerp(c2, th::bgLow, press * 0.25f), 12);
    {
        const std::string s = run ? "Stop" : "Start";
        const float tw = textW(g, s, *fonts.semi), cx = sb.X + sb.Width / 2, cy = sb.Y + sb.Height / 2;
        text(g, s, *fonts.semi, RectF(cx - tw / 2 + 10, sb.Y, tw + 4, sb.Height), th::white, StringAlignmentNear);
        SolidBrush w(th::white);
        const float ix = cx - tw / 2 - 12;
        if (run) {
            fillRR(g, w, RectF(ix - 5, cy - 5, 10, 10), 2);
        } else {
            const PointF tri[3] = {PointF(ix - 4, cy - 6), PointF(ix - 4, cy + 6), PointF(ix + 6, cy)};
            g.FillPolygon(&w, tri, 3);
        }
        p.hits.push_back({BtnStart, sb});
    }

    const PanelInfo in = run && p.hooks.info ? p.hooks.info() : PanelInfo{};
    p.shownRun = run;
    p.shown = in;
    char pid[32], speed[48];
    std::snprintf(pid, sizeof pid, "%lu", in.pid);
    std::snprintf(speed, sizeof speed, "%.1f MB/s", in.mbps);
    const std::pair<const char*, std::string> rows[] = {
        {"World PID", in.pid ? pid : "-"},
        {"Server", in.server.empty() ? "-" : in.server},
        {"DMA speed", in.mbps > 0 ? speed : "-"},
    };
    constexpr int kRows = 3;
    const RectF ib(CX, 250, CW, kRows * 44 + 8);
    card(g, ib, 0, th::border);
    for (int i = 0; i < kRows; ++i) {
        const float y = ib.Y + 4 + i * 44;
        if (i) {
            Pen div(th::border, 1.0f);
            g.DrawLine(&div, ib.X + 14, y, ib.X + ib.Width - 14, y);
        }
        text(g, rows[i].first, *fonts.caption, RectF(ib.X + 18, y, 150, 44), th::dim, StringAlignmentNear);
        text(g, rows[i].second, *fonts.semi, RectF(ib.X + 170, y, ib.Width - 188, 44), rows[i].second == "-" ? th::faint : th::text,
             StringAlignmentFar, StringAlignmentCenter, true);
    }
}

void paint(HDC hdc) {
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(p.hwnd, &rc);
    Bitmap bmp(rc.right, rc.bottom, PixelFormat32bppPARGB);
    Graphics g(&bmp);
    g.SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
    g.SetTextRenderingHint(TextRenderingHintAntiAliasGridFit);
    g.ScaleTransform(p.scale, p.scale);
    p.hits.clear();

    const bool run = running();

    {
        LinearGradientBrush bg(RectF(0, 0, W, H), th::bg, th::bgLow, LinearGradientModeVertical);
        g.FillRectangle(&bg, 0.0f, 0.0f, W, H);

        GraphicsPath bloom;
        bloom.AddEllipse(RectF(SW - 40, -190, 560, 340));
        PathGradientBrush pg(&bloom);
        pg.SetCenterColor(Color(36, 124, 92, 255));
        const Color edge(0, 124, 92, 255);
        int n = 1;
        pg.SetSurroundColors(&edge, &n);
        g.SetClip(RectF(SW, 0, W - SW, H));
        g.FillPath(&pg, &bloom);
        g.ResetClip();

        SolidBrush side(th::side);
        g.FillRectangle(&side, 0.0f, 0.0f, SW, H);
        Pen div(th::border, 1.0f);
        g.DrawLine(&div, SW, 0.0f, SW, H);
    }
    strokeRR(g, th::border, RectF(0.5f, 0.5f, W - 1, H - 1), kCorner);

    {
        fillGrad(g, RectF(20, 22, 34, 34), th::a1, th::a2, 10, LinearGradientModeForwardDiagonal);
        Pen logo(th::white, 1.6f);
        logo.SetStartCap(LineCapRound);
        logo.SetEndCap(LineCapRound);
        for (const float side : {-1.f, 1.f})
            for (const auto& line : brand::deer)
                g.DrawLine(&logo, 37.f + side * line.x1 * 14.f, 39.f + line.y1 * 14.f,
                           37.f + side * line.x2 * 14.f, 39.f + line.y2 * 14.f);
        text(g, brand::name, *fonts.semi, RectF(64, 22, SW - 72, 18), th::text, StringAlignmentNear);
        text(g, "DayZ · v" HIRSCHGANGWARE_VERSION, *fonts.caption, RectF(64, 40, SW - 72, 16), th::dim, StringAlignmentNear);

        sideItem(g, "Setup", Icon::Sliders, 92);

        const RectF chipR(16, H - 72, SW - 32, 34);
        SolidBrush cb(th::surface);
        fillRR(g, cb, chipR, 10);
        strokeRR(g, th::border, chipR, 10);
        dot(g, chipR.X + 18, chipR.Y + 17, 3.5f, run ? th::ok : th::faint, run);
        text(g, run ? "Running" : "Idle", *fonts.caption, RectF(chipR.X + 34, chipR.Y, chipR.Width - 40, chipR.Height),
             run ? th::text : th::dim, StringAlignmentNear);
        text(g, "END quits", *fonts.micro, RectF(0, H - 30, SW, 14), th::faint);
    }

    {
        text(g, "Setup", *fonts.heading, RectF(CX, 20, CW - 100, 30), th::text, StringAlignmentNear);
        text(g, "Pick the display, then start.", *fonts.caption, RectF(CX, 52, CW - 100, 18), th::dim, StringAlignmentNear);
        winButton(g, BtnMin, RectF(W - 84, 14, 32, 28), false);
        winButton(g, BtnClose, RectF(W - 48, 14, 32, 28), true);
    }

    setupPage(g, run);

    Graphics screen(hdc);
    screen.DrawImage(&bmp, 0, 0);

    if (anyMoving() && !p.animTimer) {
        SetTimer(p.hwnd, kAnimTimer, 15, nullptr);
        p.animTimer = true;
    }
}

int hitTest(float x, float y) {
    for (auto it = p.hits.rbegin(); it != p.hits.rend(); ++it)
        if (it->r.Contains(x, y)) return it->id;
    return None;
}

void cycleDisplay(int dir) {
    if (p.displays.empty()) return;
    const DisplayInfo* cur = pickDisplay(p.displays, *p.s);
    const int n = static_cast<int>(p.displays.size());
    const int i = ((cur ? cur->number - 1 : 0) + dir + n) % n;
    const DisplayInfo& d = p.displays[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
    p.s->displayDevice = d.device;
    p.s->displayW = d.width();
    p.s->displayH = d.height();
}

void activate(int id) {
    const bool run = running();
    switch (id) {
        case BtnClose: PostMessage(p.hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0); break;
        case BtnMin: ShowWindow(p.hwnd, SW_MINIMIZE); break;
        case DispPrev:
        case DispNext:
            if (!run) cycleDisplay(id == DispNext ? 1 : -1);
            break;
        case BtnFullscreen:
            if (!run) p.s->fullscreen = !p.s->fullscreen;
            break;
        case BtnIdentify: identifyDisplays(p.displays); break;
        case BtnStart:
            if (run) p.hooks.stop();
            else {
                p.s->dma = true;
                p.s->dzRadarScreen = true;
                p.hooks.start();
            }
            break;
        default: break;
    }
    saveSettings(*p.s);
    redraw();
}

LRESULT CALLBACK proc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    auto logical = [&](LPARAM l, float& x, float& y) {
        x = static_cast<float>(static_cast<short>(LOWORD(l))) / p.scale;
        y = static_cast<float>(static_cast<short>(HIWORD(l))) / p.scale;
    };
    switch (msg) {
        case WM_ERASEBKGND: return 1;
        case WM_PAINT: {
            PAINTSTRUCT ps;
            HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps);
            paint(hdc);
            EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_TIMER:
            if (wp == kAnimTimer) {
                if (!stepAnims()) {
                    KillTimer(hwnd, kAnimTimer);
                    p.animTimer = false;
                }
                if (!IsIconic(hwnd)) redraw();
            } else if (wp == kRefreshTimer && !IsIconic(hwnd)) {
                const bool run = running();
                const PanelInfo in = run && p.hooks.info ? p.hooks.info() : PanelInfo{};
                const auto mb = [](double v) { return int(v * 10 + 0.5); };
                if (run != p.shownRun || in.pid != p.shown.pid || in.server != p.shown.server || mb(in.mbps) != mb(p.shown.mbps))
                    redraw();
            }
            return 0;
        case WM_NCHITTEST: {
            POINT pt{static_cast<short>(LOWORD(lp)), static_cast<short>(HIWORD(lp))};
            ScreenToClient(hwnd, &pt);
            const float x = pt.x / p.scale, y = pt.y / p.scale;
            if ((y < 78 || x < SW) && hitTest(x, y) == None) return HTCAPTION;
            return HTCLIENT;
        }
        case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
            float x, y;
            logical(lp, x, y);
            const int h = hitTest(x, y);
            if (!p.tracking) {
                TRACKMOUSEEVENT t{sizeof(t), TME_LEAVE, hwnd, 0};
                TrackMouseEvent(&t);
                p.tracking = true;
            }
            if (h != p.hot) {
                p.hot = h;
                redraw();
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
            p.tracking = false;
            p.hot = None;
            redraw();
            return 0;
        case WM_SETCURSOR:
            if (LOWORD(lp) == HTCLIENT && p.hot != None) {
                SetCursor(LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_HAND));
                return TRUE;
            }
            break;
        case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
            float x, y;
            logical(lp, x, y);
            p.down = hitTest(x, y);
            redraw();
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_LBUTTONUP: {
            float x, y;
            logical(lp, x, y);
            const int up = hitTest(x, y), was = p.down;
            p.down = None;
            if (up != None && up == was) activate(up);
            else redraw();
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_DISPLAYCHANGE:
            p.displays = listDisplays();
            redraw();
            break;
        case WM_DESTROY:
            KillTimer(hwnd, kRefreshTimer);
            KillTimer(hwnd, kAnimTimer);
            if (running()) p.hooks.stop();
            p.hwnd = nullptr;
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

}


HWND createPanel(EspSettings& s, PanelHooks hooks) {
    p.s = &s;
    p.hooks = std::move(hooks);
    p.displays = listDisplays();
    p.scale = GetDpiForSystem() / 96.0f;

    WNDCLASSEXW wc{};
    wc.cbSize = sizeof(wc);
    wc.style = CS_DROPSHADOW;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = proc;
    wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.lpszClassName = L"hirschgangware_panel";
    wc.hIcon = LoadIconW(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(brand::iconResource));
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);

    RECT work{};
    SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWORKAREA, 0, &work, 0);
    const int w = static_cast<int>(W * p.scale), h = static_cast<int>(H * p.scale);
    const int x = work.left + (work.right - work.left - w) / 2, y = work.top + (work.bottom - work.top - h) / 2;
    p.hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_APPWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST, wc.lpszClassName, L"HirschgangWare", WS_POPUP | WS_MINIMIZEBOX, x, y, w, h, nullptr, nullptr,
                             wc.hInstance, nullptr);
    if (!p.hwnd) return nullptr;
    const DWORD round = 2;
    if (FAILED(DwmSetWindowAttribute(p.hwnd, 33 , &round, sizeof round))) {
        const int r = static_cast<int>(kCorner * 2 * p.scale);
        SetWindowRgn(p.hwnd, CreateRoundRectRgn(0, 0, w + 1, h + 1, r, r), TRUE);
    }
    SetTimer(p.hwnd, kRefreshTimer, 250, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(p.hwnd, SW_SHOW);
    return p.hwnd;
}
```

`src/friends.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "friends.h"

#include <windows.h>

#include <cctype>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>

namespace friends {

namespace {

std::mutex gMx;
std::set<std::string> gNames;  // upper-cased keys for case-insensitive matching

std::string upper(const std::string& s) {
    std::string r = s;
    for (char& c : r) c = char(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return r;
}

std::string filePath() {
    char buf[MAX_PATH] = {};
    const DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, buf, MAX_PATH);
    std::string p(buf, n ? n : 0);
    const size_t slash = p.find_last_of("\\/");
    p.resize(slash == std::string::npos ? 0 : slash + 1);
    return p + "friends.txt";
}

void trim(std::string& s) {
    while (!s.empty() && (s.back() == '\r' || s.back() == '\n' || s.back() == ' ' || s.back() == '\t')) s.pop_back();
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.size() && (s[i] == ' ' || s[i] == '\t')) ++i;
    s.erase(0, i);
}

}  // namespace

bool contains(const std::string& name) {
    if (name.empty()) return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    return gNames.count(upper(name)) != 0;
}

bool toggle(const std::string& name) {
    if (name.empty() || name == "?") return false;
    const std::string key = upper(name);
    bool now = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
        const auto it = gNames.find(key);
        if (it != gNames.end()) {
            gNames.erase(it);
        } else {
            gNames.insert(key);
            now = true;
        }
    }
    save();
    return now;
}

void load() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    gNames.clear();
    std::ifstream f(filePath());
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(f, line)) {
        trim(line);
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#') continue;
        gNames.insert(upper(line));
    }
}

void save() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    std::ofstream f(filePath(), std::ios::trunc);
    if (!f) return;
    f << "# HirschgangWare teammates - one player name per line; marked players are green on ESP + radar\n";
    for (const std::string& k : gNames) f << k << "\n";
}

}  // namespace friends
```

```h
#pragma once
// Persistent "teammate / friend" list keyed by player name (case-insensitive).
// Marked friends are drawn GREEN on the ESP and on every radar.
// Shared by esp.cpp (coloring) and radar.cpp (middle-click toggling).
#include <string>

namespace friends {
bool contains(const std::string& name);
bool toggle(const std::string& name);  // flips state, saves to friends.txt, returns true if now a friend
void load();
```
