```h
         } else if (r->was_packed && r->w == 0 && r->h == 0 && missing_glyph >= 0) {
            ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j] = ranges[i].chardata_for_range[missing_glyph];
         } else {
            return_value = 0; // if any fail, report failure
         }

         ++k;
      }
   }

   // restore original values
   spc->h_oversample = old_h_over;
   spc->v_oversample = old_v_over;

   return return_value;
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_PackFontRangesPackRects(stbtt_pack_context *spc, stbrp_rect *rects, int num_rects)
{
   stbrp_pack_rects((stbrp_context *) spc->pack_info, rects, num_rects);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_PackFontRanges(stbtt_pack_context *spc, const unsigned char *fontdata, int font_index, stbtt_pack_range *ranges, int num_ranges)
{
   stbtt_fontinfo info;
   int i, j, n, return_value; // [DEAR IMGUI] removed = 1;
   //stbrp_context *context = (stbrp_context *) spc->pack_info;
   stbrp_rect    *rects;

   // flag all characters as NOT packed
   for (i=0; i < num_ranges; ++i)
      for (j=0; j < ranges[i].num_chars; ++j)
         ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j].x0 =
         ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j].y0 =
         ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j].x1 =
         ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j].y1 = 0;

   n = 0;
   for (i=0; i < num_ranges; ++i)
      n += ranges[i].num_chars;

   rects = (stbrp_rect *) STBTT_malloc(sizeof(*rects) * n, spc->user_allocator_context);
   if (rects == NULL)
      return 0;

   info.userdata = spc->user_allocator_context;
   stbtt_InitFont(&info, fontdata, stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(fontdata,font_index));

   n = stbtt_PackFontRangesGatherRects(spc, &info, ranges, num_ranges, rects);

   stbtt_PackFontRangesPackRects(spc, rects, n);

   return_value = stbtt_PackFontRangesRenderIntoRects(spc, &info, ranges, num_ranges, rects);

   STBTT_free(rects, spc->user_allocator_context);
   return return_value;
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_PackFontRange(stbtt_pack_context *spc, const unsigned char *fontdata, int font_index, float font_size,
            int first_unicode_codepoint_in_range, int num_chars_in_range, stbtt_packedchar *chardata_for_range)
{
   stbtt_pack_range range;
   range.first_unicode_codepoint_in_range = first_unicode_codepoint_in_range;
   range.array_of_unicode_codepoints = NULL;
   range.num_chars                   = num_chars_in_range;
   range.chardata_for_range          = chardata_for_range;
   range.font_size                   = font_size;
   return stbtt_PackFontRanges(spc, fontdata, font_index, &range, 1);
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetScaledFontVMetrics(const unsigned char *fontdata, int index, float size, float *ascent, float *descent, float *lineGap)
{
   int i_ascent, i_descent, i_lineGap;
   float scale;
   stbtt_fontinfo info;
   stbtt_InitFont(&info, fontdata, stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(fontdata, index));
   scale = size > 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(&info, size) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(&info, -size);
   stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(&info, &i_ascent, &i_descent, &i_lineGap);
   *ascent  = (float) i_ascent  * scale;
   *descent = (float) i_descent * scale;
   *lineGap = (float) i_lineGap * scale;
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetPackedQuad(const stbtt_packedchar *chardata, int pw, int ph, int char_index, float *xpos, float *ypos, stbtt_aligned_quad *q, int align_to_integer)
{
   float ipw = 1.0f / pw, iph = 1.0f / ph;
   const stbtt_packedchar *b = chardata + char_index;

   if (align_to_integer) {
      float x = (float) STBTT_ifloor((*xpos + b->xoff) + 0.5f);
      float y = (float) STBTT_ifloor((*ypos + b->yoff) + 0.5f);
      q->x0 = x;
      q->y0 = y;
      q->x1 = x + b->xoff2 - b->xoff;
      q->y1 = y + b->yoff2 - b->yoff;
   } else {
      q->x0 = *xpos + b->xoff;
      q->y0 = *ypos + b->yoff;
      q->x1 = *xpos + b->xoff2;
      q->y1 = *ypos + b->yoff2;
   }

   q->s0 = b->x0 * ipw;
   q->t0 = b->y0 * iph;
   q->s1 = b->x1 * ipw;
   q->t1 = b->y1 * iph;

   *xpos += b->xadvance;
}

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
// sdf computation
//

#define STBTT_min(a,b)  ((a) < (b) ? (a) : (b))
#define STBTT_max(a,b)  ((a) < (b) ? (b) : (a))

static int stbtt__ray_intersect_bezier(float orig[2], float ray[2], float q0[2], float q1[2], float q2[2], float hits[2][2])
{
   float q0perp = q0[1]*ray[0] - q0[0]*ray[1];
   float q1perp = q1[1]*ray[0] - q1[0]*ray[1];
   float q2perp = q2[1]*ray[0] - q2[0]*ray[1];
   float roperp = orig[1]*ray[0] - orig[0]*ray[1];

   float a = q0perp - 2*q1perp + q2perp;
   float b = q1perp - q0perp;
   float c = q0perp - roperp;

   float s0 = 0., s1 = 0.;
   int num_s = 0;

   if (a != 0.0) {
      float discr = b*b - a*c;
      if (discr > 0.0) {
         float rcpna = -1 / a;
         float d = (float) STBTT_sqrt(discr);
         s0 = (b+d) * rcpna;
         s1 = (b-d) * rcpna;
         if (s0 >= 0.0 && s0 <= 1.0)
            num_s = 1;
         if (d > 0.0 && s1 >= 0.0 && s1 <= 1.0) {
            if (num_s == 0) s0 = s1;
            ++num_s;
         }
      }
   } else {
      // 2*b*s + c = 0
      // s = -c / (2*b)
      s0 = c / (-2 * b);
      if (s0 >= 0.0 && s0 <= 1.0)
         num_s = 1;
   }

   if (num_s == 0)
      return 0;
   else {
      float rcp_len2 = 1 / (ray[0]*ray[0] + ray[1]*ray[1]);
      float rayn_x = ray[0] * rcp_len2, rayn_y = ray[1] * rcp_len2;

      float q0d =   q0[0]*rayn_x +   q0[1]*rayn_y;
      float q1d =   q1[0]*rayn_x +   q1[1]*rayn_y;
      float q2d =   q2[0]*rayn_x +   q2[1]*rayn_y;
      float rod = orig[0]*rayn_x + orig[1]*rayn_y;

      float q10d = q1d - q0d;
      float q20d = q2d - q0d;
      float q0rd = q0d - rod;

      hits[0][0] = q0rd + s0*(2.0f - 2.0f*s0)*q10d + s0*s0*q20d;
      hits[0][1] = a*s0+b;

      if (num_s > 1) {
         hits[1][0] = q0rd + s1*(2.0f - 2.0f*s1)*q10d + s1*s1*q20d;
         hits[1][1] = a*s1+b;
         return 2;
      } else {
         return 1;
      }
   }
}

static int equal(float *a, float *b)
{
   return (a[0] == b[0] && a[1] == b[1]);
}

static int stbtt__compute_crossings_x(float x, float y, int nverts, stbtt_vertex *verts)
{
   int i;
   float orig[2], ray[2] = { 1, 0 };
   float y_frac;
   int winding = 0;

   // make sure y never passes through a vertex of the shape
   y_frac = (float) STBTT_fmod(y, 1.0f);
   if (y_frac < 0.01f)
      y += 0.01f;
   else if (y_frac > 0.99f)
      y -= 0.01f;

   orig[0] = x;
   orig[1] = y;

   // test a ray from (-infinity,y) to (x,y)
   for (i=0; i < nverts; ++i) {
      if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline) {
         int x0 = (int) verts[i-1].x, y0 = (int) verts[i-1].y;
         int x1 = (int) verts[i  ].x, y1 = (int) verts[i  ].y;
         if (y > STBTT_min(y0,y1) && y < STBTT_max(y0,y1) && x > STBTT_min(x0,x1)) {
            float x_inter = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (x1-x0) + x0;
            if (x_inter < x)
               winding += (y0 < y1) ? 1 : -1;
         }
      }
      if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {
         int x0 = (int) verts[i-1].x , y0 = (int) verts[i-1].y ;
         int x1 = (int) verts[i  ].cx, y1 = (int) verts[i  ].cy;
         int x2 = (int) verts[i  ].x , y2 = (int) verts[i  ].y ;
         int ax = STBTT_min(x0,STBTT_min(x1,x2)), ay = STBTT_min(y0,STBTT_min(y1,y2));
         int by = STBTT_max(y0,STBTT_max(y1,y2));
         if (y > ay && y < by && x > ax) {
            float q0[2],q1[2],q2[2];
            float hits[2][2];
            q0[0] = (float)x0;
            q0[1] = (float)y0;
            q1[0] = (float)x1;
            q1[1] = (float)y1;
            q2[0] = (float)x2;
            q2[1] = (float)y2;
            if (equal(q0,q1) || equal(q1,q2)) {
               x0 = (int)verts[i-1].x; //-V1048
               y0 = (int)verts[i-1].y; //-V1048
               x1 = (int)verts[i  ].x;
               y1 = (int)verts[i  ].y;
               if (y > STBTT_min(y0,y1) && y < STBTT_max(y0,y1) && x > STBTT_min(x0,x1)) {
                  float x_inter = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (x1-x0) + x0;
                  if (x_inter < x)
                     winding += (y0 < y1) ? 1 : -1;
               }
            } else {
               int num_hits = stbtt__ray_intersect_bezier(orig, ray, q0, q1, q2, hits);
               if (num_hits >= 1)
                  if (hits[0][0] < 0)
                     winding += (hits[0][1] < 0 ? -1 : 1);
               if (num_hits >= 2)
                  if (hits[1][0] < 0)
                     winding += (hits[1][1] < 0 ? -1 : 1);
            }
         }
      }
   }
   return winding;
}

static float stbtt__cuberoot( float x )
{
   if (x<0)
      return -(float) STBTT_pow(-x,1.0f/3.0f);
   else
      return  (float) STBTT_pow( x,1.0f/3.0f);
}

// x^3 + a*x^2 + b*x + c = 0
static int stbtt__solve_cubic(float a, float b, float c, float* r)
{
   float s = -a / 3;
   float p = b - a*a / 3;
   float q = a * (2*a*a - 9*b) / 27 + c;
   float p3 = p*p*p;
   float d = q*q + 4*p3 / 27;
   if (d >= 0) {
      float z = (float) STBTT_sqrt(d);
      float u = (-q + z) / 2;
      float v = (-q - z) / 2;
      u = stbtt__cuberoot(u);
      v = stbtt__cuberoot(v);
      r[0] = s + u + v;
      return 1;
   } else {
      float u = (float) STBTT_sqrt(-p/3);
      float v = (float) STBTT_acos(-STBTT_sqrt(-27/p3) * q / 2) / 3; // p3 must be negative, since d is negative
      float m = (float) STBTT_cos(v);
      float n = (float) STBTT_cos(v-3.141592/2)*1.732050808f;
      r[0] = s + u * 2 * m;
      r[1] = s - u * (m + n);
      r[2] = s - u * (m - n);

      //STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[0]+a)*r[0]+b)*r[0]+c) < 0.05f);  // these asserts may not be safe at all scales, though they're in bezier t parameter units so maybe?
      //STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[1]+a)*r[1]+b)*r[1]+c) < 0.05f);
      //STBTT_assert( STBTT_fabs(((r[2]+a)*r[2]+b)*r[2]+c) < 0.05f);
      return 3;
   }
}

STBTT_DEF unsigned char * stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(const stbtt_fontinfo *info, float scale, int glyph, int padding, unsigned char onedge_value, float pixel_dist_scale, int *width, int *height, int *xoff, int *yoff)
{
   float scale_x = scale, scale_y = scale;
   int ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1;
   int w,h;
   unsigned char *data;

   if (scale == 0) return NULL;

   stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(info, glyph, scale, scale, 0.0f,0.0f, &ix0,&iy0,&ix1,&iy1);

   // if empty, return NULL
   if (ix0 == ix1 || iy0 == iy1)
      return NULL;

   ix0 -= padding;
   iy0 -= padding;
   ix1 += padding;
   iy1 += padding;

   w = (ix1 - ix0);
   h = (iy1 - iy0);

   if (width ) *width  = w;
   if (height) *height = h;
   if (xoff  ) *xoff   = ix0;
   if (yoff  ) *yoff   = iy0;

   // invert for y-downwards bitmaps
   scale_y = -scale_y;

   {
      int x,y,i,j;
      float *precompute;
      stbtt_vertex *verts;
      int num_verts = stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, glyph, &verts);
      data = (unsigned char *) STBTT_malloc(w * h, info->userdata);
      precompute = (float *) STBTT_malloc(num_verts * sizeof(float), info->userdata);

      for (i=0,j=num_verts-1; i < num_verts; j=i++) {
         if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline) {
            float x0 = verts[i].x*scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y*scale_y;
            float x1 = verts[j].x*scale_x, y1 = verts[j].y*scale_y;
            float dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt((x1-x0)*(x1-x0) + (y1-y0)*(y1-y0));
            precompute[i] = (dist == 0) ? 0.0f : 1.0f / dist;
         } else if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {
            float x2 = verts[j].x *scale_x, y2 = verts[j].y *scale_y;
            float x1 = verts[i].cx*scale_x, y1 = verts[i].cy*scale_y;
            float x0 = verts[i].x *scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y *scale_y;
            float bx = x0 - 2*x1 + x2, by = y0 - 2*y1 + y2;
            float len2 = bx*bx + by*by;
            if (len2 != 0.0f)
               precompute[i] = 1.0f / (bx*bx + by*by);
            else
               precompute[i] = 0.0f;
         } else
            precompute[i] = 0.0f;
      }

      for (y=iy0; y < iy1; ++y) {
         for (x=ix0; x < ix1; ++x) {
            float val;
            float min_dist = 999999.0f;
            float sx = (float) x + 0.5f;
            float sy = (float) y + 0.5f;
            float x_gspace = (sx / scale_x);
            float y_gspace = (sy / scale_y);

            int winding = stbtt__compute_crossings_x(x_gspace, y_gspace, num_verts, verts); // @OPTIMIZE: this could just be a rasterization, but needs to be line vs. non-tesselated curves so a new path

            for (i=0; i < num_verts; ++i) {
               float x0 = verts[i].x*scale_x, y0 = verts[i].y*scale_y;

               if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vline && precompute[i] != 0.0f) {
                  float x1 = verts[i-1].x*scale_x, y1 = verts[i-1].y*scale_y;

                  float dist,dist2 = (x0-sx)*(x0-sx) + (y0-sy)*(y0-sy);
                  if (dist2 < min_dist*min_dist)
                     min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);

                  // coarse culling against bbox
                  //if (sx > STBTT_min(x0,x1)-min_dist && sx < STBTT_max(x0,x1)+min_dist &&
                  //    sy > STBTT_min(y0,y1)-min_dist && sy < STBTT_max(y0,y1)+min_dist)
                  dist = (float) STBTT_fabs((x1-x0)*(y0-sy) - (y1-y0)*(x0-sx)) * precompute[i];
                  STBTT_assert(i != 0);
                  if (dist < min_dist) {
                     // check position along line
                     // x' = x0 + t*(x1-x0), y' = y0 + t*(y1-y0)
                     // minimize (x'-sx)*(x'-sx)+(y'-sy)*(y'-sy)
                     float dx = x1-x0, dy = y1-y0;
                     float px = x0-sx, py = y0-sy;
                     // minimize (px+t*dx)^2 + (py+t*dy)^2 = px*px + 2*px*dx*t + t^2*dx*dx + py*py + 2*py*dy*t + t^2*dy*dy
                     // derivative: 2*px*dx + 2*py*dy + (2*dx*dx+2*dy*dy)*t, set to 0 and solve
                     float t = -(px*dx + py*dy) / (dx*dx + dy*dy);
                     if (t >= 0.0f && t <= 1.0f)
                        min_dist = dist;
                  }
               } else if (verts[i].type == STBTT_vcurve) {
                  float x2 = verts[i-1].x *scale_x, y2 = verts[i-1].y *scale_y;
                  float x1 = verts[i  ].cx*scale_x, y1 = verts[i  ].cy*scale_y;
                  float box_x0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(x0,x1),x2);
                  float box_y0 = STBTT_min(STBTT_min(y0,y1),y2);
                  float box_x1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(x0,x1),x2);
                  float box_y1 = STBTT_max(STBTT_max(y0,y1),y2);
                  // coarse culling against bbox to avoid computing cubic unnecessarily
                  if (sx > box_x0-min_dist && sx < box_x1+min_dist && sy > box_y0-min_dist && sy < box_y1+min_dist) {
                     int num=0;
                     float ax = x1-x0, ay = y1-y0;
                     float bx = x0 - 2*x1 + x2, by = y0 - 2*y1 + y2;
                     float mx = x0 - sx, my = y0 - sy;
                     float res[3] = {0.f,0.f,0.f};
                     float px,py,t,it,dist2;
                     float a_inv = precompute[i];
                     if (a_inv == 0.0) { // if a_inv is 0, it's 2nd degree so use quadratic formula
                        float a = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by);
                        float b = 2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by);
                        float c = mx*ax+my*ay;
                        if (a == 0.0) { // if a is 0, it's linear
                           if (b != 0.0) {
                              res[num++] = -c/b;
                           }
                        } else {
                           float discriminant = b*b - 4*a*c;
                           if (discriminant < 0)
                              num = 0;
                           else {
                              float root = (float) STBTT_sqrt(discriminant);
                              res[0] = (-b - root)/(2*a);
                              res[1] = (-b + root)/(2*a);
                              num = 2; // don't bother distinguishing 1-solution case, as code below will still work
                           }
                        }
                     } else {
                        float b = 3*(ax*bx + ay*by) * a_inv; // could precompute this as it doesn't depend on sample point
                        float c = (2*(ax*ax + ay*ay) + (mx*bx+my*by)) * a_inv;
                        float d = (mx*ax+my*ay) * a_inv;
                        num = stbtt__solve_cubic(b, c, d, res);
                     }
                     dist2 = (x0-sx)*(x0-sx) + (y0-sy)*(y0-sy);
                     if (dist2 < min_dist*min_dist)
                        min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);

                     if (num >= 1 && res[0] >= 0.0f && res[0] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[0], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                     if (num >= 2 && res[1] >= 0.0f && res[1] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[1], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                     if (num >= 3 && res[2] >= 0.0f && res[2] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[2], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                  }
               }
            }
            if (winding == 0)
               min_dist = -min_dist;  // if outside the shape, value is negative
            val = onedge_value + pixel_dist_scale * min_dist;
            if (val < 0)
               val = 0;
            else if (val > 255)
               val = 255;
            data[(y-iy0)*w+(x-ix0)] = (unsigned char) val;
         }
      }
      STBTT_free(precompute, info->userdata);
      STBTT_free(verts, info->userdata);
   }
   return data;
}

STBTT_DEF unsigned char * stbtt_GetCodepointSDF(const stbtt_fontinfo *info, float scale, int codepoint, int padding, unsigned char onedge_value, float pixel_dist_scale, int *width, int *height, int *xoff, int *yoff)
{
   return stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(info, scale, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint), padding, onedge_value, pixel_dist_scale, width, height, xoff, yoff);
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_FreeSDF(unsigned char *bitmap, void *userdata)
{
   STBTT_free(bitmap, userdata);
}

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
// font name matching -- recommended not to use this
//

// check if a utf8 string contains a prefix which is the utf16 string; if so return length of matching utf8 string
static stbtt_int32 stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(stbtt_uint8 *s1, stbtt_int32 len1, stbtt_uint8 *s2, stbtt_int32 len2)
{
   stbtt_int32 i=0;

   // convert utf16 to utf8 and compare the results while converting
   while (len2) {
      stbtt_uint16 ch = s2[0]*256 + s2[1];
      if (ch < 0x80) {
         if (i >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != ch) return -1;
      } else if (ch < 0x800) {
         if (i+1 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xc0 + (ch >> 6)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + (ch & 0x3f)) return -1;
      } else if (ch >= 0xd800 && ch < 0xdc00) {
         stbtt_uint32 c;
         stbtt_uint16 ch2 = s2[2]*256 + s2[3];
         if (i+3 >= len1) return -1;
         c = ((ch - 0xd800) << 10) + (ch2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xf0 + (c >> 18)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >>  6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c      ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         s2 += 2; // plus another 2 below
         len2 -= 2;
      } else if (ch >= 0xdc00 && ch < 0xe000) {
         return -1;
      } else {
         if (i+2 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xe0 + (ch >> 12)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch >> 6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch     ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
      }
      s2 += 2;
      len2 -= 2;
   }
   return i;
}

static int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal(char *s1, int len1, char *s2, int len2)
{
   return len1 == stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix((stbtt_uint8*) s1, len1, (stbtt_uint8*) s2, len2);
}

// returns results in whatever encoding you request... but note that 2-byte encodings
// will be BIG-ENDIAN... use stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian() to compare
STBTT_DEF const char *stbtt_GetFontNameString(const stbtt_fontinfo *font, int *length, int platformID, int encodingID, int languageID, int nameID)
{
   stbtt_int32 i,count,stringOffset;
   stbtt_uint8 *fc = font->data;
   stbtt_uint32 offset = font->fontstart;
   stbtt_uint32 nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return NULL;

   count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);
   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      if (platformID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0) && encodingID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2)
          && languageID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4) && nameID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6)) {
         *length = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
         return (const char *) (fc+stringOffset+ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10));
      }
   }
   return NULL;
}

static int stbtt__matchpair(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 nm, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 nlen, stbtt_int32 target_id, stbtt_int32 next_id)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   stbtt_int32 count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stbtt_int32 stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);

   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      stbtt_int32 id = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6);
      if (id == target_id) {
         // find the encoding
         stbtt_int32 platform = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0), encoding = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2), language = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4);

         // is this a Unicode encoding?
         if (platform == 0 || (platform == 3 && encoding == 1) || (platform == 3 && encoding == 10)) {
            stbtt_int32 slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
            stbtt_int32 off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10);

            // check if there's a prefix match
            stbtt_int32 matchlen = stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(name, nlen, fc+stringOffset+off,slen);
            if (matchlen >= 0) {
               // check for target_id+1 immediately following, with same encoding & language
               if (i+1 < count && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+6) == next_id && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12) == platform && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+2) == encoding && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+4) == language) {
                  slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+8);
                  off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+10);
                  if (slen == 0) {
                     if (matchlen == nlen)
                        return 1;
                  } else if (matchlen < nlen && name[matchlen] == ' ') {
                     ++matchlen;
                     if (stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char*) (name+matchlen), nlen-matchlen, (char*)(fc+stringOffset+off),slen))
                        return 1;
                  }
               } else {
                  // if nothing immediately following
                  if (matchlen == nlen)
                     return 1;
               }
            }
         }

         // @TODO handle other encodings
      }
   }
   return 0;
}

static int stbtt__matches(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 offset, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 nlen = (stbtt_int32) STBTT_strlen((char *) name);
   stbtt_uint32 nm,hd;
   if (!stbtt__isfont(fc+offset)) return 0;

   // check italics/bold/underline flags in macStyle...
   if (flags) {
      hd = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "head");
      if ((ttUSHORT(fc+hd+44) & 7) != (flags & 7)) return 0;
   }

   nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return 0;

   if (flags) {
      // if we checked the macStyle flags, then just check the family and ignore the subfamily
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   } else {
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, 17))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1,  2))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   }

   return 0;
}

static int stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal(unsigned char *font_collection, char *name_utf8, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   for (i=0;;++i) {
      stbtt_int32 off = stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(font_collection, i);
      if (off < 0) return off;
      if (stbtt__matches((stbtt_uint8 *) font_collection, off, (stbtt_uint8*) name_utf8, flags))
         return off;
   }
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
#endif

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_BakeFontBitmap(const unsigned char *data, int offset,
                                float pixel_height, unsigned char *pixels, int pw, int ph,
                                int first_char, int num_chars, stbtt_bakedchar *chardata)
{
   return stbtt_BakeFontBitmap_internal((unsigned char *) data, offset, pixel_height, pixels, pw, ph, first_char, num_chars, chardata);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(const unsigned char *data, int index)
{
   return stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex_internal((unsigned char *) data, index);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts(const unsigned char *data)
{
   return stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts_internal((unsigned char *) data);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_InitFont(stbtt_fontinfo *info, const unsigned char *data, int offset)
{
   return stbtt_InitFont_internal(info, (unsigned char *) data, offset);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_FindMatchingFont(const unsigned char *fontdata, const char *name, int flags)
{
   return stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal((unsigned char *) fontdata, (char *) name, flags);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian(const char *s1, int len1, const char *s2, int len2)
{
   return stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char *) s1, len1, (char *) s2, len2);
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

namespace dma_keyboard {

using Bitmap = std::array<uint8_t, 64>;

struct Sample {
    uint32_t pid = 0;
    Bitmap bits{};
};

inline bool validKey(unsigned vk) { return vk >= 8 && vk < 255; }

inline bool down(const Bitmap& bits, unsigned vk) {
    return (bits[vk / 4] & (1u << (2 * (vk % 4)))) != 0;
}

}  // namespace dma_keyboard
```

`src/keyboard_resolver.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "keyboard_bitmap.h"
#include <vmmdll.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace dma_keyboard {

inline constexpr DWORD kKernel = VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY;
inline constexpr int kWildcard = -1;

struct Reader {
    VMM_HANDLE handle = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_MemReadEx) read = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU) module = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll) processes = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_MemFree) free = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_WinReg_QueryValueExU) registry = nullptr;

    bool exact(DWORD pid, uint64_t address, void* out, DWORD size) const {
        DWORD got = 0;
        return read(handle, pid, address, static_cast<PBYTE>(out), size, &got,
                    VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHE | VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHEPUT) && got == size;
    }

    template<class T>
    bool exact(DWORD pid, uint64_t address, T& out) const {
        return exact(pid, address, &out, sizeof out);
    }

    std::pair<DWORD, DWORD> version() const {
        constexpr char root[] = "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\";
        const std::string buildPath = std::string(root) + "CurrentBuild";
        const std::string revisionPath = std::string(root) + "UBR";
        wchar_t build[32]{};
        DWORD revision = 0, type = 0, size = sizeof build - sizeof(wchar_t);
        if (!registry(handle, buildPath.c_str(), &type, reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>(build), &size) || type != REG_SZ)
            throw std::runtime_error("Could not read target Windows build.");
        size = sizeof revision;
        if (!registry(handle, revisionPath.c_str(), &type, reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>(&revision), &size) ||
            type != REG_DWORD || size != sizeof revision)
            throw std::runtime_error("Could not read target Windows revision.");
        return {std::stoul(build), revision};
    }
};

struct Pattern {
    const char* name;
    std::vector<int> bytes;
    size_t operand;
    bool ripRelative;
    std::vector<uint64_t> targets;
};

template<class T>
T field(const uint8_t* bytes) {
    T value{};
    std::memcpy(&value, bytes, sizeof value);
    return value;
}

inline void scan(const Reader& vmm, DWORD pid, const char* module, std::vector<Pattern>& patterns) {
    const uint64_t base = vmm.module(vmm.handle, pid, module);
    uint8_t header[4096]{};
    if (!base || !vmm.exact(pid, base, header)) throw std::runtime_error("Module PE header unavailable.");
    const auto dos = field<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER>(header);
    if (dos.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE || dos.e_lfanew < sizeof dos ||
        size_t(dos.e_lfanew) > sizeof header - sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64))
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid DOS header.");
    const auto nt = field<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64>(header + dos.e_lfanew);
    if (nt.Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE || nt.OptionalHeader.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC ||
        nt.FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader < sizeof(IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64))
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid PE32+ header.");
    const size_t table = size_t(dos.e_lfanew) + sizeof(DWORD) + sizeof(IMAGE_FILE_HEADER) +
                         nt.FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader;
    if (table > sizeof header || nt.FileHeader.NumberOfSections > (sizeof header - table) / sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER))
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid section table.");
    bool scanned = false;
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt.FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i) {
        const auto section = field<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER>(header + table + i * sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER));
        if (!(section.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) || !section.Misc.VirtualSize) continue;
        const DWORD size = section.Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (size > 16u * 1024 * 1024 || uint64_t(section.VirtualAddress) + size > nt.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid executable section.");
        const uint64_t code = base + section.VirtualAddress;
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(size);
        if (!vmm.exact(pid, code, bytes.data(), size))
            throw std::runtime_error("Executable section incomplete; signature counts would be misleading.");
        scanned = true;
        for (auto& pattern : patterns) {
            for (size_t at = 0; at + pattern.bytes.size() <= bytes.size(); ++at) {
                size_t j = 0;
                for (; j < pattern.bytes.size(); ++j) {
                    const int b = pattern.bytes[j];
                    if (b != kWildcard && b != bytes[at + j]) break;
                }
                if (j != pattern.bytes.size()) continue;
                const auto* operand = bytes.data() + at + pattern.operand;
                const auto target = pattern.ripRelative ? code + at + 7 + field<int32_t>(operand)
                                                        : uint64_t(field<uint32_t>(operand));
                pattern.targets.push_back(target);
            }
        }
    }
    if (!scanned) throw std::runtime_error("No executable section found.");

}

inline bool kernelAddress(uint64_t address) { return address >= 0xffff800000000000ull; }

inline std::pair<DWORD, DWORD> proxies(const Reader& vmm, DWORD session) {
    PVMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION all = nullptr;
    DWORD n = 0;
    if (!vmm.processes(vmm.handle, &all, &n) || !all)
        throw std::runtime_error("Could not enumerate target processes.");
    DWORD csrss = 0, winlogon = 0;
    unsigned csrssCount = 0, winlogonCount = 0;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const auto& p = all[i];
        if (p.dwState || p.win.dwSessionId != session) continue;
        if (_stricmp(p.szName, "csrss.exe") == 0) {
            ++csrssCount;
            csrss = p.dwPID;
        }
        if (_stricmp(p.szName, "winlogon.exe") == 0) {
            ++winlogonCount;
            winlogon = p.dwPID;
        }
    }
    vmm.free(all);
    if (csrssCount != 1 || winlogonCount != 1)
        throw std::runtime_error("Expected one live csrss and winlogon in the requested session.");
    return {csrss, winlogon};
}

struct Address {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    uint64_t va = 0;
};

inline void printMatches(const char* module, const std::vector<Pattern>& patterns) {
    for (const auto& pattern : patterns) {
        std::printf("%s %s: %zu matches", module, pattern.name, pattern.targets.size());
        for (auto target : pattern.targets) std::printf(" 0x%llx", target);
        std::puts("");
    }
}

inline Address resolve(const Reader& vmm, DWORD session, bool diagnostics = false) {
    const auto [csrss, winlogon] = proxies(vmm, session);
    const DWORD pid = csrss | kKernel;
    if (diagnostics) std::printf("Session %lu: csrss=%lu winlogon=%lu\n", session, csrss, winlogon);
    // Compare Mambo's patterns against the instruction-specific references.
    const int x = kWildcard;
    std::vector<Pattern> slots{
        {"Mambo short A", {0x48,0x8b,0x05,x,x,x,x,0x48,0x8b,0x04,0xc8}, 3, true, {}},
        {"Mambo short B", {0x48,0x8b,0x05,x,x,x,x,0xff,0xc9}, 3, true, {}},
        {"memflow slots", {0x48,0x8b,0x05,x,x,x,x,0xff,0xc9,0x48,0x8b,0x04,0xc8,0xc3}, 3, true, {}},
    };
    std::vector<Pattern> offsets{
        {"Mambo offset", {0x48,0x8d,0x90,x,x,x,x,0xe8,x,x,x,x,0x0f,0x57,0xc0}, 3, false, {}},
        {"memflow offset A", {0xb9,0x00,0x80,0xff,0xff,x,0x22,0xb4,x,x,x,x,x,0x41}, 9, false, {}},
        {"memflow offset B", {0x40,0x0f,0xb6,x,0x48,0xc1,0xe9,0x02,0x8a,0x94,0x08,x,x,x,x}, 11, false, {}},
    };
    scan(vmm, pid, "win32k.sys", slots);
    scan(vmm, pid, "win32kbase.sys", offsets);
    if (diagnostics) {
        printMatches("win32k.sys", slots);
        printMatches("win32kbase.sys", offsets);
    }
    const auto& global = slots.back().targets;
    const auto& mambo = offsets.front().targets;
    const auto& first = offsets[1].targets;
    const auto& second = offsets[2].targets;
    if (global.size() != 1 || mambo.size() != 1 || first.size() + second.size() != 1 ||
        mambo.front() != (first.empty() ? second.front() : first.front()))
        throw std::runtime_error("No unique, corroborated candidate.");
    const DWORD reader = winlogon | kKernel;
    uint64_t table = 0, slot = 0, state = 0;
    // memflow's slot-zero chain is a hypothesis to test, even when readable.
    if (!vmm.exact(pid, global.front(), table) || !kernelAddress(table) ||
        !vmm.exact(pid, table, slot) || !kernelAddress(slot) ||
        !vmm.exact(pid, slot, state) || !kernelAddress(state) ||
        state > UINT64_MAX - mambo.front() - sizeof(Bitmap))
        throw std::runtime_error("Slot-zero pointer chain unavailable.");
    Bitmap buffer{};
    const uint64_t address = state + mambo.front();
    if (!vmm.exact(reader, address, buffer)) throw std::runtime_error("Candidate is unreadable in winlogon.");
    return {reader, address};
}

}  // namespace dma_keyboard
```

```cpp
std::string lower(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) c = char(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return s;
}

struct Rule {
    int cat;
    const char* pat;
};

bool matches(const std::string& n, const char* pat) {
    if (pat[0] == '=') return n == pat + 1;
    if (pat[0] == '^') return n.rfind(pat + 1, 0) == 0;
    return n.find(pat) != std::string::npos;
}

}

const Info& info(int cat) { return kInfo[cat >= 0 && cat < Count ? cat : Other]; }

bool valuable(int cat) {
    switch (cat) {
        case Gun:
        case Ammo:
        case Attachment:
        case Explosive:
        case Bag:
        case Rare: return true;
        default: return false;
    }
}

int classify(int engineCat, const std::string& name) {
    const std::string n = lower(name);
    for (const auto& [cat, pat] : gOverride)
        if (matches(n, pat.c_str())) return cat;
    if (engineCat == Gun) return Gun;
    if (engineCat == Ammo || n.rfind("ammo_", 0) == 0 || n.rfind("mag_", 0) == 0) return Ammo;
    if (engineCat == Clothing)
        return (n.find("bag") != std::string::npos || n.find("backpack") != std::string::npos || n.find("sack") != std::string::npos)
                   ? Bag
                   : Clothing;
    for (const Rule& r : kRules)
        if (matches(n, r.pat)) return r.cat;
    return Other;
}

size_t loadOverrides(const std::string& path) {
    gOverride.clear();
    FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, path.c_str(), "r") || !f) return 0;
    char line[256];
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        std::string s = line;
        s = lower(s.substr(0, s.find('#')));
        char id[32] = {}, pat[128] = {};
        if (sscanf_s(s.c_str(), "%31s %127s", id, unsigned(sizeof id), pat, unsigned(sizeof pat)) != 2) continue;
        int cat = -1;
        for (int c = 0; c < Count; ++c)
            if (std::string(kInfo[c].id) == id) cat = c;
        if (cat < 0) continue;
        std::string p = pat;
        const bool head = p.front() == '*', tail = p.size() > 1 && p.back() == '*';
        if (head) p.erase(0, 1);
        if (tail) p.pop_back();
        if (p.empty()) continue;
        gOverride.push_back({cat, head ? p : tail ? "^" + p : "=" + p});
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return gOverride.size();
}

bool globMatch(const std::string& pat, const std::string& name) {
    size_t p = 0, n = 0, star = std::string::npos, mark = 0;
    while (n < name.size()) {
        const char c = char(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(name[n])));
        if (p < pat.size() && pat[p] == '*') {
            star = p++;
            mark = n;
        } else if (p < pat.size() && pat[p] == c) {
            ++p;
            ++n;
        } else if (star != std::string::npos) {
            p = star + 1;
            n = ++mark;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    while (p < pat.size() && pat[p] == '*') ++p;
    return p == pat.size();
}

void setFilter(const Filter& f) {
    Filter clean;
    clean.mode = f.mode >= FilterOff && f.mode <= FilterWhite ? f.mode : FilterOff;
    for (const FilterEntry& e : f.list) {
        const std::string pat = lower(e.pat);
        if (!pat.empty()) clean.list.push_back({pat, e.on});
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gFilterMx);
    if (clean == gFilter) return;
    gFilter = std::move(clean);
    gListed.clear();
}

Filter filter() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gFilterMx);
    return gFilter;
}

bool listed(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gFilterMx);
    const auto it = gListed.find(name);
    if (it != gListed.end()) return it->second;
    bool hit = false;
    for (const FilterEntry& e : gFilter.list)
        if (e.on && globMatch(e.pat, name)) {
            hit = true;
            break;
        }
    if (gListed.size() > 20000) gListed.clear();
    gListed.emplace(name, hit);
    return hit;
}

bool visible(unsigned mask, int cat, const std::string& name) {
    int mode;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gFilterMx);
        mode = gFilter.mode;
    }
    if (mode == FilterWhite) return listed(name);
    if (!shown(mask, cat)) return false;
    return mode != FilterBlack || !listed(name);
}

std::string serializeList(const std::vector<FilterEntry>& list) {
    std::string s;
    for (const FilterEntry& e : list) {
        if (e.pat.empty()) continue;
        if (!s.empty()) s += '|';
        if (!e.on) s += '!';
        s += e.pat;
    }
    return s;
}

std::vector<FilterEntry> parseList(const std::string& s) {
    std::vector<FilterEntry> out;
    size_t a = 0;
    while (a <= s.size()) {
        size_t b = s.find('|', a);
        if (b == std::string::npos) b = s.size();
        std::string t = s.substr(a, b - a);
        while (!t.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(t.back()))) t.pop_back();
        size_t i = 0;
        while (i < t.size() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(t[i]))) ++i;
        t.erase(0, i);
        FilterEntry e;
        if (!t.empty() && t[0] == '!') {
            e.on = false;
            t.erase(0, 1);
        }
        e.pat = lower(t);
        if (!e.pat.empty()) out.push_back(std::move(e));
        a = b + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

}
```

`src/loot.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <windows.h>

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace loot {

enum Cat : int {
    Other,
    Gun,
    Ammo,
    Attachment,
    Melee,
    Explosive,
    Medical,
    Food,
    Drink,
    Tool,
    Clothing,
    Bag,
    VehiclePart,
    Base,
    Rare,
    Count
};

constexpr unsigned kAll = (1u << Count) - 1;

struct Info {
    const char* name;
    const char* id;
    COLORREF color;
};
const Info& info(int cat);

inline bool shown(unsigned mask, int cat) { return cat >= 0 && cat < Count && (mask >> cat & 1u) != 0; }

bool valuable(int cat);

int classify(int engineCat, const std::string& name);

size_t loadOverrides(const std::string& path);
```

```cpp
bool fileExists(const std::string& p) {
    const DWORD a = GetFileAttributesA(p.c_str());
    return a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && !(a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY);
}

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
    std::wstring w(s.size() + 1, L'\0');
    const int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, w.data(), int(w.size()));
    w.resize(n > 0 ? size_t(n - 1) : 0);
    return w;
}

HINTERNET session() {
    static HINTERNET s = [] {
        HINTERNET h = WinHttpOpen(L"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) HirschgangWare", WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_AUTOMATIC_PROXY,
                                  WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0);
        if (!h)
            h = WinHttpOpen(L"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) HirschgangWare", WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_DEFAULT_PROXY,
                            WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0);
        if (h) WinHttpSetTimeouts(h, 10000, 10000, 15000, 30000);
        return h;
    }();
    return s;
}

struct Conn {
    HINTERNET h = nullptr;
    explicit Conn(const wchar_t* host) {
        if (HINTERNET s = session()) h = WinHttpConnect(s, host, INTERNET_DEFAULT_HTTPS_PORT, 0);
    }
    ~Conn() {
        if (h) WinHttpCloseHandle(h);
    }
    Conn(const Conn&) = delete;
    Conn& operator=(const Conn&) = delete;

    int get(const std::string& path, std::string& body) {
        body.clear();
        if (!h) return -1;
        HINTERNET r = WinHttpOpenRequest(h, L"GET", widen(path).c_str(), nullptr, WINHTTP_NO_REFERER, WINHTTP_DEFAULT_ACCEPT_TYPES,
                                         WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE);
        if (!r) return -1;
        int status = -1;
        const wchar_t* hdr = L"Referer: https://dayz.xam.nu/\r\n";
        if (WinHttpSendRequest(r, hdr, DWORD(-1L), WINHTTP_NO_REQUEST_DATA, 0, 0, 0) && WinHttpReceiveResponse(r, nullptr)) {
            DWORD code = 0, len = sizeof code;
            if (WinHttpQueryHeaders(r, WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER, WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX, &code, &len,
                                    WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX))
                status = int(code);
            for (;;) {
                DWORD avail = 0;
                if (!WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(r, &avail)) {
                    status = -1;
                    break;
                }
                if (!avail) break;
                const size_t at = body.size();
                body.resize(at + avail);
                DWORD got = 0;
                if (!WinHttpReadData(r, body.data() + at, avail, &got)) {
                    status = -1;
                    break;
                }
                body.resize(at + got);
                gBytes += got;
                if (gCancel) break;
            }
        }
        WinHttpCloseHandle(r);
        return status;
    }
};

std::string jsonStr(const std::string& j, const char* key, size_t from = 0, size_t to = std::string::npos) {
    const std::string k = std::string("\"") + key + "\":\"";
    const size_t a = j.find(k, from);
    if (a == std::string::npos || a >= to) return "";
    const size_t s = a + k.size(), e = j.find('"', s);
    return e == std::string::npos ? "" : j.substr(s, e - s);
}
double jsonNum(const std::string& j, const char* key, size_t from = 0, size_t to = std::string::npos) {
    const std::string k = std::string("\"") + key + "\":";
    const size_t a = j.find(k, from);
    if (a == std::string::npos || a >= to) return 0;
    return std::strtod(j.c_str() + a + k.size(), nullptr);
}
size_t matchClose(const std::string& j, size_t at) {
    int depth = 0;
    bool str = false;
    for (size_t i = at; i < j.size(); ++i) {
        const char c = j[i];
        if (str) {
            if (c == '\\') ++i;
            else if (c == '"') str = false;
        } else if (c == '"') {
            str = true;
        } else if (c == '{' || c == '[') {
            ++depth;
        } else if (c == '}' || c == ']') {
            if (--depth == 0) return i;
        }
    }
    return std::string::npos;
}
std::string readJsonString(const std::string& j, size_t s) {
    std::string out;
    for (size_t i = s; i < j.size() && j[i] != '"'; ++i) {
        if (j[i] != '\\') {
            out += j[i];
            continue;
        }
        if (++i >= j.size()) break;
        if (j[i] == 'u') {
            out += '?';
            i += 4;
        } else {
            out += j[i] == 'n' || j[i] == 't' ? ' ' : j[i];
        }
    }
    return out;
}

std::map<std::string, std::string> liveVersions() {
    static std::mutex mx;
    static bool tried = false;
    static std::map<std::string, std::string> out;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mx);
    if (tried) return out;
    tried = true;
    Conn site(kSiteHost);
    std::string html, js;
    if (site.get("/", html) != 200) return out;
    const size_t a = html.find("/js/bundle.");
    if (a == std::string::npos) return out;
    const size_t e = html.find(".js", a);
    if (e == std::string::npos) return out;
    if (site.get(html.substr(a, e + 3 - a), js) != 200) return out;
    const size_t t = js.find("{\"chernarusplus\":{\"v\":\"");
    if (t == std::string::npos) return out;
    const size_t end = matchClose(js, t);
    if (end == std::string::npos) return out;
    const std::string tbl = js.substr(t, end + 1 - t);
    for (size_t p = 1; (p = tbl.find("\":{\"v\":\"", p)) != std::string::npos; ++p) {
        const size_t ns = tbl.rfind('"', p - 1);
        if (ns == std::string::npos) continue;
        const std::string name = tbl.substr(ns + 1, p - ns - 1);
        const size_t vs = p + 8, ve = tbl.find('"', vs);
        if (ve == std::string::npos) break;
        const std::string v = tbl.substr(vs, ve - vs);
        const size_t close = tbl.find('}', ve);
        const int it = int(jsonNum(tbl, "i", ve, close));
        out[name] = it ? v + "-" + std::to_string(it) : v;
    }
    dlog("[*] maps: XAM site lists %zu maps", out.size());
    return out;
}

std::string titleCase(std::string s) {
    bool up = true;
    for (char& c : s) {
        if (c == '_') c = ' ';
        const unsigned char u = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
        if (up && std::isalpha(u)) c = char(std::toupper(u));
        up = c == ' ' || c == '-' || c == '(' || c == '/';
    }
    return s;
}

int writeNames(const std::string& j, float size, const std::string& path) {
    const size_t a = j.find("\"locations\":[");
    if (a == std::string::npos) return 0;
    const size_t arr = a + 12, end = matchClose(j, arr);
    if (end == std::string::npos) return 0;
    FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, path.c_str(), "w") || !f) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (size_t o = j.find('{', arr); o != std::string::npos && o < end;) {
        const size_t oe = matchClose(j, o);
        if (oe == std::string::npos || oe > end) break;
        std::string w = jsonStr(j, "w", o, oe);
        const size_t pa = j.find("\"p\":[", o);
        const size_t sa = j.find("\"s\":[\"", o);
        if (!w.empty() && pa < oe && sa < oe) {
            char* q = nullptr;
            const double lat = std::strtod(j.c_str() + pa + 5, &q);
            const double lng = (q && *q == ',') ? std::strtod(q + 1, nullptr) : 0;
            const std::string name = titleCase(readJsonString(j, sa + 6));
            const float x = float(lng / 256.0 * size), z = float((256.0 + lat) / 256.0 * size);
            if (!name.empty() && x >= 0 && z >= 0 && x <= size && z <= size) {
                if (w == "namemarine") w = "marine";
                w[0] = char(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(w[0])));
                std::fprintf(f, "%.1f %.1f %s %s\n", x, z, w.c_str(), name.c_str());
                ++n;
            }
        }
        o = j.find('{', oe);
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return n;
}

struct Band {
    std::vector<uint8_t> px;
    int left = 0;
};

void fail(const std::string& why) {
    dlog("[-] maps: %s", why.c_str());
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    gSt.error = why;
}

void finish() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    gSt.busy = false;
    gSt.phase.clear();
}

void job(std::string id, bool topo, bool high) {
    const HRESULT co = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    struct CoGuard {
        HRESULT hr;
        ~CoGuard() {
            if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) CoUninitialize();
        }
    } coGuard{co};
    CreateDirectoryA(gDir.c_str(), nullptr);

    const Entry* e = find(id);
    const std::string xam = e ? e->xam : id;
    std::string version = e ? e->version : "";
    {
        const auto live = liveVersions();
        const auto it = live.find(xam);
        if (it != live.end()) version = it->second;
    }
    if (version.empty()) {
        fail(label(id) + " is not on the XAM map site");
        return finish();
    }

    Conn data(kDataHost);
    std::string j;
    int code = data.get("/dayz/json/" + xam + "/" + version + ".json", j);
    if (code != 200 && e && version != e->version) code = data.get("/dayz/json/" + xam + "/" + e->version + ".json", j);
    if (gCancel) return finish();
    if (code != 200) {
        fail(code < 0 ? "no connection to static.xam.nu - is the internet up?" : "map data not found (HTTP " + std::to_string(code) + ")");
        return finish();
    }
    const size_t ia = j.find("\"info\":{");
    const size_t ie = ia == std::string::npos ? ia : j.find('}', ia);
    const std::string tiles = jsonStr(j, "tiles", ia, ie), tilev = jsonStr(j, "tilev", ia, ie);
    std::string fmt = jsonStr(j, "format", ia, ie);
    if (fmt.empty()) fmt = "jpg";
    const float size = float(jsonNum(j, "size", ia, ie));
    if (ia == std::string::npos || tiles.empty() || tilev.empty() || size <= 0) {
        fail("map data for " + label(id) + " has no tile info");
        return finish();
    }

    const std::string names = gDir + id + "_names.txt";
    if (!fileExists(names)) {
        const int n = writeNames(j, size, names);
        dlog("[*] maps: %d place names for %s", n, id.c_str());
        if (!n) DeleteFileA(names.c_str());
    }
    if (FILE* f = nullptr; !fopen_s(&f, (gDir + id + ".size").c_str(), "w") && f) {
        std::fprintf(f, "%g\n", size);
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
        gSizes.erase(id);
    }
    j.clear();
    j.shrink_to_fit();

    const int zoom = high ? 6 : 5, N = 1 << zoom, W = kTile * N, total = N * N;
    const size_t stride = size_t(W) * 3;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
        gSt.phase = "Downloading";
        gSt.total = total;
    }
    dlog("[*] maps: %s %s %dx%d px from %s/%s (%s)", id.c_str(), topo ? "topographic" : "satellite", W, W, tiles.c_str(), tilev.c_str(),
         fmt.c_str());

    ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> wic;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&wic)))) {
        fail("Windows imaging (WIC) unavailable");
        return finish();
    }
    const std::string base = gDir + id + (topo ? "_topo" : "");
    const std::string part = base + ".jpg.part", out = base + ".jpg";
    ComPtr<IWICStream> stream;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> enc;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
    ComPtr<IPropertyBag2> props;
    bool okEnc = SUCCEEDED(wic->CreateStream(&stream)) && SUCCEEDED(stream->InitializeFromFilename(widen(part).c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE)) &&
                 SUCCEEDED(wic->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatJpeg, nullptr, &enc)) &&
                 SUCCEEDED(enc->Initialize(stream.Get(), WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)) && SUCCEEDED(enc->CreateNewFrame(&frame, &props));
    if (okEnc) {
        PROPBAG2 opt{};
        opt.pstrName = const_cast<LPOLESTR>(L"ImageQuality");
        VARIANT v;
        VariantInit(&v);
        v.vt = VT_R4;
        v.fltVal = 0.9f;
        props->Write(1, &opt, &v);
        WICPixelFormatGUID pf = GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppBGR;
        okEnc = SUCCEEDED(frame->Initialize(props.Get())) && SUCCEEDED(frame->SetSize(UINT(W), UINT(W))) &&
                SUCCEEDED(frame->SetPixelFormat(&pf)) && IsEqualGUID(pf, GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppBGR);
    }
    if (!okEnc) {
        frame.Reset();
        enc.Reset();
        stream.Reset();
        DeleteFileA(part.c_str());
        fail("cannot write " + out);
        return finish();
    }

    std::mutex mx;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Band>> bands(static_cast<size_t>(N));
    int written = 0;
    std::atomic<int> next{0};
    std::atomic<int> missing{0};
    std::atomic<bool> fatal{false};
    std::string fatalWhy;

    auto band = [&](int y) -> Band& {
        auto& b = bands[size_t(y)];
        if (!b) {
            b = std::make_unique<Band>();
            b->left = N;
            b->px.resize(stride * kTile);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < b->px.size(); i += 3) {
                b->px[i] = kMissB;
                b->px[i + 1] = kMissG;
                b->px[i + 2] = kMissR;
            }
        }
        return *b;
    };
    auto stop = [&](const std::string& why) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mx);
            if (!fatal) fatalWhy = why;
            fatal = true;
        }
        cv.notify_all();
    };

    auto worker = [&] {
        const HRESULT wco = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        {
            ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> f;
            CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&f));
            Conn c(kDataHost);
            std::string body;
            const std::string pre = "/dayz/maps/" + tiles + "/" + tilev + "/" + (topo ? "topographic/" : "satellite/") + std::to_string(zoom) + "/";
            for (;;) {
                const int t = next++;
                if (t >= total || gCancel || fatal) break;
                const int x = t % N, y = t / N;
                {
                    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(mx);
                    cv.wait(lk, [&] { return y < written + kRowsAhead || gCancel || fatal; });
                    if (gCancel || fatal) break;
                    band(y);
                }
                int st = -1;
                for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 4 && !gCancel; ++attempt) {
                    st = c.get(pre + std::to_string(x) + "/" + std::to_string(y) + "." + fmt, body);
                    if (st == 200 || st == 404 || st == 403) break;
                    Sleep(300 * (attempt + 1));
                }
                if (gCancel) break;
                bool landed = st == 404 || st == 403;
                if (st == 404 || st == 403) ++missing;
                if (st == 200 && f) {
                    ComPtr<IWICStream> ms;
                    ComPtr<IWICBitmapDecoder> dec;
                    ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameDecode> fr;
                    ComPtr<IWICFormatConverter> conv;
                    ComPtr<IWICBitmapScaler> sc;
                    UINT tw = 0, th = 0;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(f->CreateStream(&ms)) && SUCCEEDED(ms->InitializeFromMemory(reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(body.data()), DWORD(body.size()))) &&
                        SUCCEEDED(f->CreateDecoderFromStream(ms.Get(), nullptr, WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnDemand, &dec)) &&
                        SUCCEEDED(dec->GetFrame(0, &fr)) && SUCCEEDED(fr->GetSize(&tw, &th))) {
                        IWICBitmapSource* src = fr.Get();
                        if ((tw != kTile || th != kTile) && SUCCEEDED(f->CreateBitmapScaler(&sc)) &&
                            SUCCEEDED(sc->Initialize(fr.Get(), kTile, kTile, WICBitmapInterpolationModeFant)))
                            src = sc.Get();
                        if (SUCCEEDED(f->CreateFormatConverter(&conv)) &&
                            SUCCEEDED(conv->Initialize(src, GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppBGR, WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0.0, WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom))) {
                            uint8_t* dst;
                            {
                                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mx);
                                dst = band(y).px.data() + size_t(x) * kTile * 3;
                            }
                            const WICRect rc{0, 0, kTile, kTile};
                            landed = SUCCEEDED(conv->CopyPixels(&rc, UINT(stride), UINT(stride * (kTile - 1) + kTile * 3), dst));
                        }
                    }
                    if (!landed) {
                        stop(fmt == "webp" ? "Windows can't decode WebP - install \"WebP Image Extensions\" from the Microsoft Store"
                                           : "a map tile could not be decoded");
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!landed) {
                    stop(st < 0 ? "lost the connection to static.xam.nu" : "the map site refused a tile (HTTP " + std::to_string(st) + ")");
                    break;
                }
                ++gDone;
                bool rowDone;
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mx);
                    rowDone = --band(y).left == 0;
                }
                if (rowDone) cv.notify_all();
            }
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(wco)) CoUninitialize();
    };

    std::vector<std::thread> pool;
    for (int i = 0; i < kWorkers; ++i) pool.emplace_back(worker);

    bool okRows = true;
    for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
        std::unique_ptr<Band> b;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(mx);
            cv.wait(lk, [&] { return (bands[size_t(y)] && bands[size_t(y)]->left == 0) || gCancel || fatal; });
            if (gCancel || fatal) {
                okRows = false;
                break;
            }
            b = std::move(bands[size_t(y)]);
        }
        if (FAILED(frame->WritePixels(kTile, UINT(stride), UINT(b->px.size()), b->px.data()))) {
            stop("writing " + out + " failed (disk full?)");
            okRows = false;
            break;
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mx);
            written = y + 1;
        }
        cv.notify_all();
    }
    cv.notify_all();
    for (auto& t : pool) t.join();

    if (okRows && missing > total / 2) {
        okRows = false;
        fatalWhy = "the site has no " + std::string(topo ? "topographic" : "satellite") + " tiles for " + label(id);
    }
    if (okRows) {
        setPhase("Saving");
        okRows = SUCCEEDED(frame->Commit()) && SUCCEEDED(enc->Commit());
        if (!okRows) fatalWhy = "saving " + out + " failed";
    }
    frame.Reset();
    enc.Reset();
    props.Reset();
    stream.Reset();
    if (okRows) {
        okRows = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20 && !okRows; ++i) {
            okRows = MoveFileExA(part.c_str(), out.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED) != 0;
            if (!okRows) Sleep(250);
        }
        if (!okRows) fatalWhy = "could not replace " + out + " (in use?)";
    }
    if (!okRows) DeleteFileA(part.c_str());

    const double secs = double(GetTickCount64() - gT0) / 1000.0;
    if (okRows) {
        dlog("[+] maps: %s ready (%d tiles, %d empty, %.1f MB in %.0f s)", out.c_str(), total, missing.load(), double(gBytes) / 1048576.0, secs);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
        ++gSt.generation;
    } else if (gCancel) {
        dlog("[*] maps: %s download cancelled", id.c_str());
    } else {
        fail(fatalWhy.empty() ? "download failed" : fatalWhy);
    }
    finish();
}

}

const std::vector<Entry>& catalog() { return kCatalog; }

bool official(const std::string& id) { return id == "chernarusplus" || id == "livonia" || id == "sakhal" || id == "nasdara"; }

const Entry* find(const std::string& id) {
    for (const Entry& e : kCatalog)
        if (id == e.id) return &e;
    return nullptr;
}

std::string label(const std::string& id) {
    const Entry* e = find(id);
    return e ? e->label : id;
}

void setDir(const std::string& mapsDir) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    gDir = mapsDir;
    gSizes.clear();
}
#ifndef HIRSCHGANGWARE_NO_DIAG
void setLog(void (*fn)(const char*)) { gLog = fn; }
#endif

float savedSize(const std::string& id) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    if (gDir.empty()) return 0;
    const auto it = gSizes.find(id);
    if (it != gSizes.end()) return it->second;
    float v = 0;
    if (FILE* f = nullptr; !fopen_s(&f, (gDir + id + ".size").c_str(), "r") && f) {
        if (fscanf_s(f, "%f", &v) != 1 || v < 256 || v > 100000) v = 0;
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    gSizes[id] = v;
    return v;
}

bool start(const std::string& id, bool topo, bool high) {
    if (id.empty()) return false;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
        if (gSt.busy) return false;
        gSt.busy = true;
        gSt.id = id;
        gSt.topo = topo;
        gSt.phase = "Looking up";
        gSt.done = gSt.total = 0;
        gSt.error.clear();
    }
    gCancel = false;
    gDone = 0;
    gBytes = 0;
    gT0 = GetTickCount64();
    dlog("[*] maps: downloading %s (%s, %s)", id.c_str(), topo ? "topographic" : "satellite", high ? "16384 px" : "8192 px");
    try {
        std::thread(job, id, topo, high).detach();
    } catch (...) {
        fail("could not start the download thread");
        finish();
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void cancel() { gCancel = true; }

Status status() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(gMx);
    Status s = gSt;
    if (s.busy) {
        s.done = gDone;
        const double secs = double(GetTickCount64() - gT0) / 1000.0;
        s.mbps = secs > 0.5 ? double(gBytes) / 1048576.0 / secs : 0;
    }
    return s;
}

}
```

```cpp
#include "process.h"

#include <tlhelp32.h>

#include <cstring>

bool Process::readPtr(uintptr_t addr, uint32_t ptrSize, uint64_t& out) const {
    out = 0;
    if (ptrSize == 4) {
        uint32_t v = 0;
        if (!read(addr, v)) return false;
        out = v;
        return true;
    }
    return read(addr, out);
}

size_t Process::readMany(std::vector<ReadReq>& reqs) const {
    size_t n = 0;
    for (auto& r : reqs) n += (r.ok = read(r.addr, r.out, r.size)) ? 1 : 0;
    return n;
}

namespace {

class LocalProcess : public Process {
public:
    ~LocalProcess() override {
        if (h_) CloseHandle(h_);
    }

    bool attach(const std::string& exeName, std::string& err) override {
        HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            err = "CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(process) failed";
            return false;
        }
        PROCESSENTRY32 pe{};
        pe.dwSize = sizeof(pe);
        DWORD pid = 0;
        for (BOOL ok = Process32First(snap, &pe); ok; ok = Process32Next(snap, &pe)) {
            if (_stricmp(pe.szExeFile, exeName.c_str()) == 0) {
                pid = pe.th32ProcessID;
                break;
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(snap);
        if (!pid) {
            err = "process '" + exeName + "' is not running";
            return false;
        }

        if (h_) {
            CloseHandle(h_);
            h_ = nullptr;
        }
        h_ = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
        if (!h_) {
            err = "OpenProcess failed (error " + std::to_string(GetLastError()) +
                  "); try running as the same user / elevated";
            return false;
        }
        pid_ = pid;

        HANDLE msnap = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            msnap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, pid);
            if (msnap != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE || GetLastError() != ERROR_BAD_LENGTH) break;
            Sleep(50);
        }
        if (msnap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            err = "CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(module) failed (error " + std::to_string(GetLastError()) + ")";
            return false;
        }
        MODULEENTRY32 me{};
        me.dwSize = sizeof(me);
        bool found = false;
        for (BOOL ok = Module32First(msnap, &me); ok; ok = Module32Next(msnap, &me)) {
            if (_stricmp(me.szModule, exeName.c_str()) == 0) {
                mod_.name = me.szModule;
                mod_.base = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(me.modBaseAddr);
                mod_.size = me.modBaseSize;
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(msnap);
        if (!found) {
            err = "main module not found in process";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool read(uintptr_t addr, void* out, size_t size) const override {
        SIZE_T got = 0;
        return ReadProcessMemory(h_, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(addr), out, size, &got) && got == size;
    }

    bool readable(uintptr_t addr) const override {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
        if (!VirtualQueryEx(h_, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(addr), &mbi, sizeof(mbi))) return false;
        if (mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) return false;
        return !(mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD));
    }

    std::vector<Region> regions(uint64_t maxAddr) const override {
        std::vector<Region> out;
        uint64_t addr = 0;
        while (addr < maxAddr) {
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
            if (!VirtualQueryEx(h_, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr)), &mbi, sizeof(mbi))) break;
            const uint64_t base = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress);
            if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD))) {
                Region r;
                r.base = static_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
                r.size = mbi.RegionSize;
                r.protect = mbi.Protect;
                r.type = mbi.Type;
                out.push_back(r);
            }
            const uint64_t next = base + mbi.RegionSize;
            if (next <= addr) break;
            addr = next;
        }
        return out;
    }

    bool alive() const override {
        DWORD code = 0;
        return h_ && GetExitCodeProcess(h_, &code) && code == STILL_ACTIVE;
    }

private:
    HANDLE h_ = nullptr;
};

}

std::unique_ptr<Process> makeLocalProcess() { return std::make_unique<LocalProcess>(); }
```
