```cpp
#include "rtti.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace {

bool refToRva(const Image& img, uint32_t v, uint32_t& rva) {
    if (img.ptrSize == 8) {
        rva = v;
    } else {
        if (v < img.base) return false;
        rva = v - static_cast<uint32_t>(img.base);
    }
    return img.contains(rva);
}

}

bool rttiRef(const Image& img, uint64_t at, uint32_t& rva) {
    uint32_t v;
    return img.at(at, v) && refToRva(img, v, rva);
}

std::string rttiTypeName(const Image& img, uint32_t tdRva) {
    size_t p = tdRva + 2 * img.ptrSize;
    if (!img.contains(p, 5)) return {};
    const char* s = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&img.bytes[p]);
    size_t n = 0;
    while (p + n < img.bytes.size() && n < 128 && s[n]) ++n;
    std::string raw(s, n);
    if (raw.rfind(".?AV", 0) != 0 && raw.rfind(".?AU", 0) != 0) return {};
    raw = raw.substr(4);
    auto at = raw.find("@@");
    return at == std::string::npos ? raw : raw.substr(0, at);
}

bool findVTables(const Image& img, const std::string& cls, std::vector<VTableInfo>& out, std::string& err) {
    out.clear();

    uint32_t targetTd = 0;
    bool haveTd = false;
    for (const char* prefix : {".?AV", ".?AU"}) {
        const std::string mangled = prefix + cls + "@@";
        const auto it = std::search(img.bytes.begin(), img.bytes.end(), mangled.begin(), mangled.end());
        if (it != img.bytes.end()) {
            targetTd = static_cast<uint32_t>(it - img.bytes.begin()) - 2 * img.ptrSize;
            haveTd = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!haveTd) {
        err = "no RTTI for class '" + cls + "' in module";
        return false;
    }

    struct Col {
        uint32_t rva;
        std::string cls;
        bool exact;
    };
    std::vector<Col> cols;
    const uint32_t sigWanted = img.ptrSize == 8 ? 1 : 0;
    for (const auto& sec : img.sections) {
        if (sec.exec()) continue;
        const uint64_t hi = std::min<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(sec.rva) + sec.vsize, img.bytes.size());
        for (uint64_t loc = std::max<uint64_t>(sec.rva, 12); loc + 12 <= hi; loc += 4) {
            uint32_t sig = 0, offset = 0, cdOffset = 0;
            if (!img.at(loc - 12, sig) || sig != sigWanted) continue;
            if (!img.at(loc - 8, offset) || offset > 0x1000) continue;
            if (!img.at(loc - 4, cdOffset) || cdOffset > 0x1000) continue;
            uint32_t tdRva = 0, chdRva = 0;
            if (!rttiRef(img, loc, tdRva) || !rttiRef(img, loc + 4, chdRva)) continue;
            const std::string name = rttiTypeName(img, tdRva);
            if (name.empty()) continue;

            uint32_t chdSig = 0, nBases = 0;
            if (!img.at(chdRva, chdSig) || chdSig != 0) continue;
            if (!img.at(chdRva + 8ull, nBases) || nBases == 0 || nBases > 64) continue;
            uint32_t arrRva = 0;
            if (!rttiRef(img, chdRva + 12ull, arrRva)) continue;

            bool derives = false;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nBases && !derives; ++i) {
                uint32_t bcdRva = 0, baseTd = 0;
                if (!rttiRef(img, arrRva + 4ull * i, bcdRva)) break;
                if (!rttiRef(img, bcdRva, baseTd)) break;
                derives = baseTd == targetTd;
            }
            if (derives && offset == 0) cols.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(loc - 12), name, tdRva == targetTd});
        }
    }
    if (cols.empty()) {
        err = "class '" + cls + "' has RTTI but no polymorphic instances (no vtable)";
        return false;
    }

    for (const auto& col : cols) {
        const uint64_t colVa = static_cast<uint64_t>(img.base) + col.rva;
        for (const auto& sec : img.sections) {
            if (sec.exec()) continue;
            const uint64_t hi = std::min<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(sec.rva) + sec.vsize, img.bytes.size());
            for (uint64_t at = sec.rva; at + img.ptrSize <= hi; at += img.ptrSize) {
                uint64_t v = 0;
                if (img.ptrSize == 4) {
                    uint32_t v32;
                    img.at(at, v32);
                    v = v32;
                } else {
                    img.at(at, v);
                }
                if (v == colVa) {
                    VTableInfo vt;
                    vt.rva = static_cast<uint32_t>(at + img.ptrSize);
                    vt.cls = col.cls;
                    vt.exact = col.exact;
                    out.push_back(vt);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (out.empty()) {
        err = "found RTTI for '" + cls + "' but no vtable references it";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
```

```cpp
#include "speedtest.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "process.h"
#include "clock.h"
#include "telemetry.h"

namespace speed {

double quick(const Process& p, int iters) {
    tel::Suppress quiet;
    const uintptr_t base = p.module().base;
    const size_t pages = std::min<size_t>(p.module().size / 4096, 1024);
    if (!base || pages < 32) return 0;
    static uintptr_t poolBase = 0;
    static std::vector<uintptr_t> pool;
    std::vector<Process::ReadReq> rq;
    if (poolBase != base || pool.size() < 64) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> probe(pages * 8);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pages; ++i) rq.push_back({base + i * 4096, probe.data() + i * 8, 8});
        p.readMany(rq);
        pool.clear();
        for (const auto& r : rq)
            if (r.ok && pool.size() < 256) pool.push_back(r.addr);
        poolBase = base;
        if (pool.size() < 64) return 0;
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(pool.size() * 4096);
    rq.clear();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < pool.size(); ++i) rq.push_back({pool[i], buf.data() + i * 4096, 4096});
    double okBytes = 0;
    const uint64_t t0 = qpcUs();
    for (int it = 0; it < iters; ++it) {
        for (auto& r : rq) r.ok = false;
        p.readMany(rq);
        for (const auto& r : rq) okBytes += r.ok ? 4096.0 : 0.0;
    }
    const double us = double(qpcUs() - t0);
    const double mbps = us > 0 ? okBytes / us : 0;
    if (mbps > 0) gLinkMBps = mbps;
    return mbps;
}

}
```

```cpp
#include "telemetry.h"

#include "clock.h"

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <intrin.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace tel {
namespace {

constexpr int kHist = 50;
constexpr int kWindow = 10;

struct TimerAcc {
    std::atomic<uint64_t> n{0}, sum{0}, mx{0};
    std::atomic<uint32_t> h[kHist];
};
struct TimerSnap {
    uint64_t n = 0, sum = 0, mx = 0;
    uint32_t h[kHist] = {};
};
struct Second {
    double dt = 1;
    TimerSnap t[T_COUNT];
    uint64_t c[C_COUNT] = {};
    double cpuCore = 0;
};

struct State {
    TimerAcc timers[T_COUNT];
    std::atomic<uint64_t> counters[C_COUNT];

    std::deque<Second> ring;

    std::mutex discoverMx;
    int discoverReq = 0;
    std::string discoverName;

    std::thread sampler;
    std::mutex wakeMx;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    bool stopping = false;
    void (*logSink)(const char*) = nullptr;

    State() {
        for (auto& c : counters) c.store(0);
        for (auto& t : timers)
            for (auto& h : t.h) h.store(0);
    }
};

State& S() {
    static State* s = new State();
    return *s;
}

thread_local int tlSuppress = 0;

std::string fmt(const char* f, ...) {
    char buf[768];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, f);
    std::vsnprintf(buf, sizeof buf, f, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

int bucketOf(uint64_t us) {
    if (us < 2) return 0;
    unsigned long lg;
    _BitScanReverse64(&lg, us);
    const int b = 2 * int(lg) + int((us >> (lg - 1)) & 1);
    return std::min(b, kHist - 1);
}
double bucketUb(int b) {
    if (b <= 0) return 1;
    return (b & 1) ? std::ldexp(1.0, (b + 1) / 2) : 1.5 * std::ldexp(1.0, b / 2);
}

void atomicMax(std::atomic<uint64_t>& a, uint64_t v) {
    uint64_t m = a.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    while (v > m && !a.compare_exchange_weak(m, v, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {}
}

double pctMs(const TimerSnap& t, double p) {
    uint64_t total = 0;
    for (uint32_t h : t.h) total += h;
    if (!total) return 0;
    const uint64_t rank = std::max<uint64_t>(1, uint64_t(std::ceil(p * double(total))));
    uint64_t cum = 0;
    for (int b = 0; b < kHist; ++b) {
        cum += t.h[b];
        if (cum >= rank) return std::min(bucketUb(b), double(t.mx)) / 1000.0;
    }
    return double(t.mx) / 1000.0;
}
double avgMs(const TimerSnap& t) { return t.n ? double(t.sum) / double(t.n) / 1000.0 : 0; }
double maxMs(const TimerSnap& t) { return double(t.mx) / 1000.0; }

struct Agg {
    TimerSnap t[T_COUNT];
    uint64_t c[C_COUNT] = {};
    double secs = 0, cpuCore = 0;
    int n = 0;
};

void addSnap(TimerSnap& d, const TimerSnap& s) {
    d.n += s.n;
    d.sum += s.sum;
    d.mx = std::max(d.mx, s.mx);
    for (int i = 0; i < kHist; ++i) d.h[i] += s.h[i];
}

Agg aggregate(const std::deque<Second>& ring) {
    Agg a;
    for (const Second& s : ring) {
        for (int t = 0; t < T_COUNT; ++t) addSnap(a.t[t], s.t[t]);
        for (int c = 0; c < C_COUNT; ++c) a.c[c] += s.c[c];
        a.secs += s.dt;
        a.cpuCore += s.cpuCore;
        ++a.n;
    }
    if (a.n) a.cpuCore /= a.n;
    return a;
}

double filetimeToSec(const FILETIME& f) { return double((uint64_t(f.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | f.dwLowDateTime) / 1e7; }

void sampleLoop() {
    State& s = S();
    uint64_t prevC[C_COUNT] = {};
    FILETIME c0, e0, k0, u0;
    GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &c0, &e0, &k0, &u0);
    double prevProcCpu = filetimeToSec(k0) + filetimeToSec(u0);
    auto prevT = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto lastSink = prevT;

    for (;;) {
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(s.wakeMx);
            if (s.wake.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::seconds(1), [&] { return s.stopping; })) return;
        }
        const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const double dt = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - prevT).count();
        prevT = now;

        Second sec;
        sec.dt = dt;
        for (int t = 0; t < T_COUNT; ++t) {
            TimerAcc& a = s.timers[t];
            TimerSnap& d = sec.t[t];
            d.n = a.n.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            d.sum = a.sum.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            d.mx = a.mx.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            for (int i = 0; i < kHist; ++i) d.h[i] = a.h[i].exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < C_COUNT; ++c) {
            const uint64_t cur = s.counters[c].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            sec.c[c] = cur - prevC[c];
            prevC[c] = cur;
        }
        {
            FILETIME c, e, k, u;
            GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &c, &e, &k, &u);
            const double cpu = filetimeToSec(k) + filetimeToSec(u);
            sec.cpuCore = dt > 0 ? (cpu - prevProcCpu) / dt * 100.0 : 0;
            prevProcCpu = cpu;
        }

        s.ring.push_back(sec);
        if (int(s.ring.size()) > kWindow) s.ring.pop_front();

        if (s.logSink && now - lastSink >= std::chrono::seconds(10)) {
            lastSink = now;
            const Agg a = aggregate(s.ring);
            const double W = std::max(1.0, a.secs);
            const std::string line =
                fmt("[log] tel: %.0f fps, scan %.0f/s (avg %.1f ms), calls/s %.0f, call p50 %.2f p95 %.2f max %.1f ms, link busy %.0f%%, lock p95 %.2f ms, "
                    "snap age p95 %.0f ms, fail %.2f%%, cpu %.0f%%",
                    double(a.c[C_FRAMES]) / W, double(a.c[C_SCANS]) / W, avgMs(a.t[T_SCAN]), double(a.c[C_CALLS]) / W, pctMs(a.t[T_CALL], 0.5),
                    pctMs(a.t[T_CALL], 0.95), maxMs(a.t[T_CALL]),
                    std::min(1.0, double(a.t[T_DEVICE].sum + a.t[T_XLATE].sum + a.t[T_VIRT].sum) / 1e6 / W) * 100, pctMs(a.t[T_LOCK], 0.95),
                    pctMs(a.t[T_SNAPAGE], 0.95), a.c[C_REQS] ? 100.0 * double(a.c[C_REQS_FAIL]) / double(a.c[C_REQS]) : 0.0, a.cpuCore);
            s.logSink(line.c_str());
        }
    }
}

}

uint64_t nowUs() { return qpcUs(); }

void time(Timer t, uint64_t us) {
    if (tlSuppress) return;
    TimerAcc& a = S().timers[t];
    a.n.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    a.sum.fetch_add(us, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    a.h[bucketOf(us)].fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    atomicMax(a.mx, us);
}
void count(Counter c, uint64_t n) {
    if (tlSuppress) return;
    S().counters[c].fetch_add(n, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void call(const CallInfo& c) {
    if (tlSuppress) return;
    time(T_CALL, c.totalUs);
    if (c.single) {
        time(T_READ1, c.totalUs);
        count(C_SINGLES);
    }
    time(T_LOCK, c.lockUs);
    if (c.lockUs >= 100) count(C_LOCK_WAITS);
    count(C_CALLS);
    count(C_REQS, c.reqs);
    count(C_REQS_FAIL, c.reqs - c.reqsOk);
    count(C_BYTES, c.bytes);
    count(C_BYTES_OK, c.bytesOk);
    if (c.totalUs > 40000) count(C_STALLS);
}

Suppress::Suppress() { ++tlSuppress; }
Suppress::~Suppress() { --tlSuppress; }

void requestDiscover(const std::string& name) {
    State& s = S();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(s.discoverMx);
    s.discoverReq = 1;
    s.discoverName = name;
}
bool discoverRequested(std::string& name) {
    State& s = S();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(s.discoverMx);
    if (s.discoverReq != 1) return false;
    s.discoverReq = 0;
    name = s.discoverName;
    s.discoverName.clear();
    return true;
}

void start(void (*logSink)(const char*)) {
    State& s = S();
    if (s.sampler.joinable()) return;
    s.logSink = logSink;
    s.stopping = false;
    s.sampler = std::thread(sampleLoop);
}
void stop() {
    State& s = S();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(s.wakeMx);
        s.stopping = true;
    }
    s.wake.notify_all();
    if (s.sampler.joinable()) s.sampler.join();
}

}
```

```cpp
std::string trim(const std::string& s) {
    size_t a = 0, b = s.size();
    while (a < b && (unsigned char)s[a] <= ' ') ++a;
    while (b > a && (unsigned char)s[b - 1] <= ' ') --b;
    return s.substr(a, b - a);
}
std::string lower(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) c = char(std::tolower((unsigned char)c));
    return s;
}
int toInt(const std::string& s, int dflt) { return s.empty() ? dflt : std::atoi(s.c_str()); }
bool toBool(const std::string& s, bool dflt) {
    if (s.empty()) return dflt;
    const std::string v = lower(trim(s));
    return v == "1" || v == "true" || v == "yes" || v == "on";
}

    if (gSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    DWORD n = 0;

std::string subst(std::string s, const std::string& key, const std::string& val) {
    for (size_t p = s.find(key); p != std::string::npos; p = s.find(key, p + val.size())) s.replace(p, key.size(), val);
    return s;
}

void deviceSend(const std::string& cmd, int vk = 0) {
    if (cmd.empty()) return;
    std::string s = cmd;
    if (vk) {

        s = subst(s, "{vk}", b);

    if (gCfg.modeNet) {
        if (gSock != INVALID_SOCKET) sendto(gSock, s.c_str(), (int)s.size(), 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&gAddr), sizeof gAddr);
    } else {
        writeLine(s);
    }
}

void captureBox(int key, int hid) {
    if (gCapture && gCaptureArmed && gCfg.keyFromDevice && !remoteKeysReady() &&
        ((key >= 1 && key <= 5) || dma_keyboard::validKey(unsigned(key))))
        bindKey(key, hid, InputSource::Box);
}

// ---- input parsing (tolerant; raw lines are shown in the module window) ----
void parseToken(const std::string& rawName, const std::string& rawVal) {
    const std::string name = lower(trim(rawName));
    const std::string val = lower(trim(rawVal));
    if (name.empty()) return;
    const bool on = !(val.empty() || val == "0" || val == "up" || val == "release" || val == "off" || val == "false");

    int btn = 0;
    if (name.find("side1") != std::string::npos || name.find("x1") != std::string::npos || name.find("mouse4") != std::string::npos) btn = 4;
    else if (name.find("side2") != std::string::npos || name.find("x2") != std::string::npos || name.find("mouse5") != std::string::npos) btn = 5;
    else if (name.find("middle") != std::string::npos || name.find("mid") != std::string::npos) btn = 3;
    else if (name.find("left") != std::string::npos) btn = 1;
    else if (name.find("right") != std::string::npos) btn = 2;
    if (btn) {
        gBtn[btn] = on;
        if (on) captureBox(btn, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (name.find("key") != std::string::npos || name.find("vk") != std::string::npos) {
        std::string cs = val;
        if (cs.empty()) {
            const size_t po = name.find('('), pc = name.find(')');
            if (po != std::string::npos && pc > po) cs = name.substr(po + 1, pc - po - 1);
        }
        const int code = cs.empty() ? 0 : (int)std::strtol(cs.c_str(), nullptr, 0);
        if (code > 0) {
            if (!val.empty()) gKeyHeld = on;
            gKeyCode = code;
            if (on) captureBox(code, 0);
        }
    }
}

void parseLine(const std::string& line) {
    const std::string l = trim(line);
    if (l.empty()) return;
    size_t eq = l.find('=');
    const size_t colon = l.find(':');
    if (eq == std::string::npos || (colon != std::string::npos && colon < eq)) eq = colon;
    if (eq == std::string::npos) {
        bool digits = !l.empty();
        for (const char c : l)
            if (!std::isdigit((unsigned char)c)) digits = false;
        if (digits) {
            gKeyHeld = l != "0";
            gKeyCode = 0;
            return;
        }
        parseToken(l, std::string());
    } else {
        parseToken(l.substr(0, eq), l.substr(eq + 1));
    }
}

// ---- MAKCU binary protocol (frames: DE AD len:u16LE cmd payload) ----
struct KvPair {
    int hid, vk;
};
const KvPair kHidVk[] = {
    {0x04, 0x41}, {0x05, 0x42}, {0x06, 0x43}, {0x07, 0x44}, {0x08, 0x45}, {0x09, 0x46}, {0x0A, 0x47}, {0x0B, 0x48},
    {0x0C, 0x49}, {0x0D, 0x4A}, {0x0E, 0x4B}, {0x0F, 0x4C}, {0x10, 0x4D}, {0x11, 0x4E}, {0x12, 0x4F}, {0x13, 0x50},
    {0x14, 0x51}, {0x15, 0x52}, {0x16, 0x53}, {0x17, 0x54}, {0x18, 0x55}, {0x19, 0x56}, {0x1A, 0x57}, {0x1B, 0x58},
    {0x1C, 0x59}, {0x1D, 0x5A},
    {0x1E, 0x31}, {0x1F, 0x32}, {0x20, 0x33}, {0x21, 0x34}, {0x22, 0x35}, {0x23, 0x36}, {0x24, 0x37}, {0x25, 0x38},
    {0x26, 0x39}, {0x27, 0x30},
    {0x28, 0x0D}, {0x29, 0x1B}, {0x2A, 0x08}, {0x2B, 0x09}, {0x2C, 0x20}, {0x2D, 0xBD}, {0x2E, 0xBB}, {0x2F, 0xDB},
    {0x30, 0xDD}, {0x31, 0xDC}, {0x32, 0xDC}, {0x33, 0xBA}, {0x34, 0xDE}, {0x35, 0x60}, {0x36, 0xBC}, {0x37, 0xBE},
    {0x38, 0xBF}, {0x39, 0x14},
    {0x3A, 0x70}, {0x3B, 0x71}, {0x3C, 0x72}, {0x3D, 0x73}, {0x3E, 0x74}, {0x3F, 0x75}, {0x40, 0x76}, {0x41, 0x77},
    {0x42, 0x78}, {0x43, 0x79}, {0x44, 0x7A}, {0x45, 0x7B},
    {0x46, 0x7C}, {0x47, 0x7D}, {0x48, 0x7E}, {0x49, 0x7F}, {0x4A, 0x24}, {0x4B, 0x21}, {0x4C, 0x2D}, {0x4D, 0x23},
    {0x4E, 0x22}, {0x4F, 0x27}, {0x50, 0x25}, {0x51, 0x28}, {0x52, 0x26}, {0x53, 0x2E},
    {0xE0, 0x11}, {0xE1, 0x10}, {0xE2, 0x12}, {0xE3, 0x5B}, {0xE4, 0x5C}, {0xE5, 0x5B}, {0xE6, 0x5C}, {0xE7, 0x5B}};

int hidToVk(int hid) {
    for (const KvPair& p : kHidVk)
        if (p.hid == hid) return p.vk;
    return hid;
}
int vkToHid(int vk) {
    for (const KvPair& p : kHidVk)
        if (p.vk == vk) return p.hid;
    return 0;
}

void bindKey(int vk, int hid, InputSource source) {
    gCfg.key = vk;
    gCfg.keyHid = hid;
    gCfg.keySource = source;
    gWaitForBoundRelease = true;
    gCapture = false;
    gLive.note = "bound";
    gLastBindAt = GetTickCount64();
    gDirty = true;
    gDirtyAt = GetTickCount64();
}

void sendBytes(const uint8_t* b, int n) {
    if (gSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    DWORD w = 0;
    WriteFile(gSerial, b, (DWORD)n, &w, nullptr);
}

// INPUT_CHANGE (0x53) = [kind, id, state]; kind 1 mouse buttons, 2 keyboard HID usage
void handleFrame(uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t* pl, uint16_t len) {
    if (cmd != 0x53) tlog("[trg] frame cmd=0x%02X len=%u", cmd, unsigned(len));
    if (cmd != 0x53 || len != 3) return;
    const uint8_t kind = pl[0], id = pl[1], st = pl[2];
    if (id == 0xFF && st == 0xFF) {
        gStreamLost = true;
        tlog("[trg] input stream lost (kind %u)", kind);
        return;
    }
    gStreamLost = false;
    if (kind == 1) {
        if (id > 4) return;
        const int b = id + 1;  // 0..4 -> codes 1..5 (left..mouse5)
        gBtn[b] = st == 1;
        if (st == 1) captureBox(b, 0);
        tlog("[trg] box button %d %s", b, st ? "down" : "up");
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        gKeyHid = id;
        gKeyHeld = st == 1;
        if (st == 1) captureBox(hidToVk(id), id);
        tlog("[trg] box key hid 0x%02X %s", id, st ? "down" : "up");
    }
}


uint8_t gLastMask = 0xFF;
uint8_t gTail[4] = {};

// MAKCU pushes "km." + one control byte = physical button bitmask (bit0 L,1 R,2 M,3 M4,4 M5)
void maskReport(uint8_t m) {
    static const int b[5] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) gBtn[b[i]] = (m >> i) & 1;
    if (m != gLastMask) {
        gLastMask = m;
        tlog("[trg] box buttons mask 0x%02X", m);
    }
    if (gCapture && gCaptureArmed) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
            if ((m >> i) & 1) {
                captureBox(b[i], 0);
                break;
            }
    }
}

void textLineDone() {
    if (gRxLine.empty()) return;
    const std::string line = gRxLine;
    gRxLine.clear();
    gLive.lastRx = line;
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (line != gLastLoggedRx || now - gLastRxLog > 1500) {
        gLastLoggedRx = line;
        gLastRxLog = now;
        tlog("[trg] rx: %s", line.c_str());
    }
    if (gAwaitIdent) {
        gIdent = line;
        gAwaitIdent = false;
        tlog("[trg] box ident: %s", gIdent.c_str());
    }
    parseLine(line);
}

// byte stream: text lines AND MAKCU binary frames (DE AD lenLE16 cmd payload)
void feedBytes(const char* p, int n) {
    if (gCfg.showDebug && n > 0) {
        char hx[200];
        size_t at = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && i < 40 && at + 4 < sizeof hx; ++i)
            at += size_t(std::snprintf(hx + at, sizeof hx - at, "%02X ", (unsigned char)p[i]));
        if (at) hx[at - 1] = 0;
        tlog("[trg] rxraw: %s", hx);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const uint8_t c = uint8_t(p[i]);
        gTail[3] = gTail[2];
        gTail[2] = gTail[1];
        gTail[1] = gTail[0];
        gTail[0] = c;
        if (gTail[3] == 'k' && gTail[2] == 'm' && gTail[1] == '.' && c < 0x20) {
            maskReport(c);
            gRxLine.clear();
            continue;
        }
        switch (gRxState) {
            case 0:
                if (c == 0xDE) gRxState = 1;
                else if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') textLineDone();
                else if (gRxLine.size() < 240) gRxLine.push_back(char(c));
                break;
            case 1:
                if (c == 0xAD) {
                    gRxState = 2;
                } else {
                    gRxState = 0;
                    if (gRxLine.size() < 240) gRxLine.push_back(char(0xDE));
                    if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') textLineDone();
                    else if (gRxLine.size() < 240) gRxLine.push_back(char(c));
                }
                break;
            case 2:
                gFrameLen = c;
                gRxState = 3;
                break;
            case 3:
                gFrameLen |= uint16_t(c) << 8;
                if (gFrameLen > 80) gFrameLen = 80;
                gFrameGot = 0;
                gRxState = 4;
                break;
            case 4:
                gFrameCmd = c;
                if (gFrameLen == 0) {
                    handleFrame(gFrameCmd, gFrameBuf, 0);
                    gRxState = 0;
                } else {
                    gRxState = 5;
                }
                break;
            case 5:
                gFrameBuf[gFrameGot++] = c;
                if (gFrameGot >= gFrameLen) {
                    handleFrame(gFrameCmd, gFrameBuf, gFrameLen);
                    gRxState = 0;
                }
                break;
            default:
                gRxState = 0;
                break;
        }
    }
}

void devicePoll();

// ---- probe: step through candidate "give me your physical input" commands ----
struct ProbeStep {
    const char* label;
    const char* text;
    uint8_t bin[8];
    int len;
};
const ProbeStep kProbe[] = {
    {"text km.get_key(8)  [E hid]", "km.get_key(8)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.get_key(0x08)", "km.get_key(0x08)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.get_key(69) [E vk]", "km.get_key(69)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.key(8)", "km.key(8)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.keys()", "km.keys()", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(0,1,0)", "km.monitor(0,1,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(1,1,0)", "km.monitor(1,1,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(2,1,0)", "km.monitor(2,1,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(3,1,0)", "km.monitor(3,1,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(4,1,0)", "km.monitor(4,1,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(0,2,0)", "km.monitor(0,2,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(1,2,0)", "km.monitor(1,2,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(2,2,0)", "km.monitor(2,2,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(0,3,0)", "km.monitor(0,3,0)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.monitor(0,0,1)", "km.monitor(0,0,1)", {}, 0},
    {"text km.debug(1)", "km.debug(1)", {}, 0},
    {"bin INPUT_STREAM kbd", nullptr, {0xDE, 0xAD, 0x01, 0x00, 0x52, 0x02}, 6},
    {"text km.version()", "km.version()", {}, 0},
};
int gProbeIdx = -1;
ULONGLONG gProbeAt = 0;

void probeStep() {
    const int n = int(sizeof kProbe / sizeof kProbe[0]);
    if (gProbeIdx < 0) return;
    if (!connected()) return;
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (gProbeAt && now - gProbeAt < 600) return;
    gProbeAt = now;
    if (gProbeIdx >= n) {
        gProbeIdx = -1;
        tlog("[trg] probe done");
        return;
    }
    const ProbeStep& s = kProbe[gProbeIdx];
    tlog("[trg] probe %d/%d: %s", gProbeIdx + 1, n, s.label);
    if (s.text) {
        const std::string t = s.text;
        deviceSend(t);
    } else {
        sendBytes(s.bin, s.len);
    }
    devicePoll();
    ++gProbeIdx;
}


void devicePoll();

void sendStreams() {
    const uint8_t nl[2] = {'\r', '\n'};
    const uint8_t mouse[6] = {0xDE, 0xAD, 0x01, 0x00, 0x52, 0x01};
    const uint8_t kbd[6] = {0xDE, 0xAD, 0x01, 0x00, 0x52, 0x02};
    sendBytes(nl, 2);
    sendBytes(mouse, 6);
    devicePoll();
    sendBytes(kbd, 6);
    devicePoll();
    gLastStreamOn = GetTickCount64();
    gStreamLost = false;
    tlog("[trg] binary input streams enabled (mouse+keyboard)");
}

void devicePoll() {
    if (gCfg.modeNet ? gSock == INVALID_SOCKET : gSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 24; ++iter) {
        char buf[256];
        if (gCfg.modeNet) {
            int from = sizeof gAddr;
            const int n = recvfrom(gSock, buf, (int)sizeof buf - 1, 0, nullptr, &from);
            if (n <= 0) return;
            buf[n] = 0;
            feedBytes(buf, n);
        } else {
            DWORD got = 0;
            if (!ReadFile(gSerial, buf, (DWORD)sizeof buf - 1, &got, nullptr) || got == 0) return;
            buf[got] = 0;
            feedBytes(buf, (int)got);
        }
    }
}

std::vector<std::string> portsImpl() {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 64; ++i) {
        char name[16];
        std::snprintf(name, sizeof name, "COM%d", i);
        char target[256];
        if (QueryDosDeviceA(name, target, sizeof target)) out.push_back(name);
    }
    return out;
}

void closeDevice() {
    if (gSerial != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        CloseHandle(gSerial);
        gSerial = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
    if (gSock != INVALID_SOCKET) {
        closesocket(gSock);
        gSock = INVALID_SOCKET;
    }
}

DWORD gBaudUsed = 0;

// opens the port at one baud and checks whether the box answers (MAKCU runs 115200 or 4 Mbaud)
bool tryOpenSerial(DWORD baud) {
    const std::string path = "\\\\.\\" + gCfg.port;
    gSerial = CreateFileA(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr);
    if (gSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        setStatus("open " + gCfg.port + " failed");
        return false;
    }
    SetupComm(gSerial, 4096, 4096);
    DCB dcb{};
    dcb.DCBlength = sizeof dcb;
    if (GetCommState(gSerial, &dcb)) {
        dcb.BaudRate = baud;
        dcb.ByteSize = 8;
        dcb.Parity = NOPARITY;
        dcb.StopBits = ONESTOPBIT;
        dcb.fBinary = TRUE;
        dcb.fDtrControl = DTR_CONTROL_ENABLE;
        dcb.fRtsControl = RTS_CONTROL_ENABLE;
        SetCommState(gSerial, &dcb);
    }
    COMMTIMEOUTS to{};
    to.ReadIntervalTimeout = 1;
    to.ReadTotalTimeoutConstant = 1;
    to.WriteTotalTimeoutConstant = 3;
    SetCommTimeouts(gSerial, &to);
    PurgeComm(gSerial, PURGE_RXCLEAR | PURGE_TXCLEAR);
    gRxLine.clear();
    gRxState = 0;
    gIdent.clear();
    if (!gCfg.cmdConnect.empty()) {
        gAwaitIdent = true;
        deviceSend(gCfg.cmdConnect);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 25 && gIdent.empty(); ++i) {
        Sleep(10);
        devicePoll();
    }
    if (gIdent.empty()) {
        tlog("[trg] baud %lu: no answer", (unsigned long)baud);
        CloseHandle(gSerial);
        gSerial = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
        return false;
    }
    gBaudUsed = baud;
    setStatus("connected " + gCfg.port + " @ " + std::to_string(baud));
    tlog("[trg] baud %lu works (ident: %s)", (unsigned long)baud, gIdent.c_str());
    return true;
}

void openDevice() {
    closeDevice();
    if (gCfg.modeNet) {
        if (!gWsa) {
            WSADATA w{};
            if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &w) != 0) { setStatus("winsock failed"); return; }
            gWsa = true;
        }
        gSock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
        if (gSock == INVALID_SOCKET) { setStatus("socket failed"); return; }
        u_long nb = 1;
        ioctlsocket(gSock, FIONBIO, &nb);
        gAddr = sockaddr_in{};
        gAddr.sin_family = AF_INET;
        gAddr.sin_port = htons((u_short)gCfg.netPort);
        gAddr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr(gCfg.host.c_str());
        setStatus("connected (udp " + gCfg.host + ")");
    } else {
        if (gCfg.port.empty()) {
            const std::vector<std::string> ps = portsImpl();
            std::string all;
            for (const std::string& p : ps) all += (all.empty() ? "" : ", ") + p;
            tlog("[trg] COM ports present: %s", all.empty() ? "(none)" : all.c_str());
            if (ps.empty()) { setStatus("no COM port found"); return; }
            gCfg.port = ps.front();
        }
        const DWORD other = gCfg.baud == 4000000 ? 115200u : 4000000u;
        const DWORD list[2] = {gCfg.autoBaud ? 115200u : DWORD(gCfg.baud), gCfg.autoBaud ? 4000000u : other};
        bool ok = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 && !ok; ++i) ok = tryOpenSerial(list[i]);
        if (!ok) {
            setStatus("no answer on " + gCfg.port + " - other baud / USB3 port / box reset");
            return;
        }
    }
    if (gCfg.modeNet && !gCfg.cmdConnect.empty()) {
        gAwaitIdent = true;
        deviceSend(gCfg.cmdConnect);
        Sleep(30);
        devicePoll();
    }
    if (gCfg.useBinary && !gCfg.modeNet) sendStreams();
    if (gCfg.sendMonitor && !gCfg.cmdMonitor.empty()) deviceSend(gCfg.cmdMonitor);
    devicePoll();
    gLive.note = "connected";
}

}  // namespace

// ---- config ----
void load() {
    bool sawCmdMonitor = false;
    std::ifstream f(iniPath());
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(f, line)) {
        const std::string l = trim(line);
        if (l.empty() || l[0] == '#' || l[0] == '[') continue;
        const size_t eq = l.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;
        const std::string k = lower(trim(l.substr(0, eq)));
        const std::string v = trim(l.substr(eq + 1));
        if (k == "enabled") gCfg.enabled = toBool(v, gCfg.enabled);
        else if (k == "playersonly") gCfg.playersOnly = toBool(v, gCfg.playersOnly);
        else if (k == "animals") gCfg.animals = toBool(v, gCfg.animals);
        else if (k == "key") gCfg.key = toInt(v, gCfg.key);
        else if (k == "keysource") {
            if (v == "main") gCfg.keySource = InputSource::MainPc;
            else if (v == "second") gCfg.keySource = InputSource::SecondPc;
            else if (v == "box") gCfg.keySource = InputSource::Box;
        }
        else if (k == "keyfromdevice") gCfg.keyFromDevice = toBool(v, gCfg.keyFromDevice);
        else if (k == "keyfromlocal") gCfg.keyFromLocal = toBool(v, gCfg.keyFromLocal);
        else if (k == "keyremote") gCfg.keyRemote = toBool(v, gCfg.keyRemote);
        else if (k == "keyhid") gCfg.keyHid = toInt(v, gCfg.keyHid);
        else if (k == "usebinary") gCfg.useBinary = toBool(v, gCfg.useBinary);
        else if (k == "delayms") gCfg.delayMs = toInt(v, gCfg.delayMs);
        else if (k == "radiuspx") gCfg.radiusPx = toInt(v, gCfg.radiusPx);
        else if (k == "hitmask") gCfg.hitMask = (unsigned)toInt(v, (int)gCfg.hitMask);
        else if (k == "maxdistm") gCfg.maxDistM = toInt(v, gCfg.maxDistM);
        else if (k == "refirems") gCfg.refireMs = toInt(v, gCfg.refireMs);
        else if (k == "clickms") gCfg.clickMs = toInt(v, gCfg.clickMs);
        else if (k == "modenet") gCfg.modeNet = toBool(v, gCfg.modeNet);
        else if (k == "port") gCfg.port = v;
        else if (k == "baud") gCfg.baud = toInt(v, gCfg.baud);
        else if (k == "autobaud") gCfg.autoBaud = toBool(v, gCfg.autoBaud);
        else if (k == "host") gCfg.host = v;
        else if (k == "netport") gCfg.netPort = toInt(v, gCfg.netPort);
        else if (k == "sendmonitor") gCfg.sendMonitor = toBool(v, gCfg.sendMonitor);
        else if (k == "cmdconnect") gCfg.cmdConnect = v;
        else if (k == "cmdmonitor") { gCfg.cmdMonitor = v; sawCmdMonitor = true; }
        else if (k == "monitoridx") gCfg.monitorIdx = toInt(v, gCfg.monitorIdx);
        else if (k == "cmddown") gCfg.cmdDown = v;
        else if (k == "cmdup") gCfg.cmdUp = v;
        else if (k == "cmdkeypoll") gCfg.cmdKeyPoll = v;
        else if (k == "autoconnect") gCfg.autoConnect = toBool(v, gCfg.autoConnect);
        else if (k == "moduleopen") gCfg.moduleOpen = toBool(v, gCfg.moduleOpen);
        else if (k == "showdebug") gCfg.showDebug = toBool(v, gCfg.showDebug);
    }
    if (gCfg.delayMs < 0) gCfg.delayMs = 0;
    if (gCfg.radiusPx < 1) gCfg.radiusPx = 1;
    if (!sawCmdMonitor) gCfg.cmdMonitor = monitorPresetText(gCfg.monitorIdx);
    if (GetFileAttributesA(iniPath().c_str()) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) save();
}

void save() {
    std::ofstream f(iniPath(), std::ios::trunc);
    if (!f) return;
    f << "# HirschgangWare triggerbot - pure mouse box (KMBox / MAKCU / similar). Copy this file PC to PC.\n";
    f << "[Triggerbot]\n";
    f << "enabled=" << (gCfg.enabled ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "playersOnly=" << (gCfg.playersOnly ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "animals=" << (gCfg.animals ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "key=" << gCfg.key << "\n";
    switch (gCfg.keySource) {
        case InputSource::MainPc: f << "keySource=main\n"; break;
        case InputSource::SecondPc: f << "keySource=second\n"; break;
        case InputSource::Box: f << "keySource=box\n"; break;
        case InputSource::Legacy: break;
    }
    f << "keyFromDevice=" << (gCfg.keyFromDevice ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "keyFromLocal=" << (gCfg.keyFromLocal ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "keyRemote=" << (gCfg.keyRemote ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "keyHid=" << gCfg.keyHid << "\n";
    f << "useBinary=" << (gCfg.useBinary ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "delayMs=" << gCfg.delayMs << "\n";
    f << "radiusPx=" << gCfg.radiusPx << "\n";
    f << "hitMask=" << gCfg.hitMask << "\n";
    f << "maxDistM=" << gCfg.maxDistM << "\n";
    f << "refireMs=" << gCfg.refireMs << "\n";
    f << "clickMs=" << gCfg.clickMs << "\n";
    f << "modeNet=" << (gCfg.modeNet ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "port=" << gCfg.port << "\n";
    f << "baud=" << gCfg.baud << "\n";
    f << "autoBaud=" << (gCfg.autoBaud ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "host=" << gCfg.host << "\n";
    f << "netPort=" << gCfg.netPort << "\n";
    f << "sendMonitor=" << (gCfg.sendMonitor ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "monitorIdx=" << gCfg.monitorIdx << "\n";
    f << "cmdConnect=" << gCfg.cmdConnect << "\n";
    f << "cmdMonitor=" << gCfg.cmdMonitor << "\n";
    f << "cmdDown=" << gCfg.cmdDown << "\n";
    f << "cmdUp=" << gCfg.cmdUp << "\n";
    f << "cmdKeyPoll=" << gCfg.cmdKeyPoll << "\n";
    f << "autoConnect=" << (gCfg.autoConnect ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "moduleOpen=" << (gCfg.moduleOpen ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
    f << "showDebug=" << (gCfg.showDebug ? 1 : 0) << "\n";
}

int keyToVk(int key) {
    constexpr int buttons[]{0, VK_LBUTTON, VK_RBUTTON, VK_MBUTTON, VK_XBUTTON1, VK_XBUTTON2};
    if (key >= 1 && key <= 5) return buttons[key];
    return dma_keyboard::validKey(unsigned(key)) ? key : 0;
}

bool localKeyDown(int key) {
    const int vk = keyToVk(key);
    return vk && (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0;
}

bool deviceKeyDown(int key) {
    if (key >= 1 && key <= 5) return gBtn[key];
    if (gCfg.useBinary) return gKeyHeld && gCfg.keyHid != 0 && gKeyHid == gCfg.keyHid;
    return gKeyHeld && (gKeyCode == 0 || gKeyCode == key);
}

void pollKey() {
    if (boxInputEnabled() && !gCfg.cmdKeyPoll.empty()) deviceSend(gCfg.cmdKeyPoll, gCfg.key);
}

Config& cfg() { return gCfg; }
Live& live() { return gLive; }
const std::string& status() { return gStatus; }
bool connected() { return gSerial != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE || gSock != INVALID_SOCKET; }
bool capturing() { return gCapture; }
void setLog(void (*fn)(const char*)) { gLog = fn; }
const std::string& ident() { return gIdent; }
void sendRaw(const std::string& cmd) { if (!cmd.empty()) deviceSend(cmd); }
int monitorPresetCount() { return 7; }
const char* monitorPresetText(int i) {
    static const char* const t[7] = {"km.monitor(1,0,0)", "km.monitor(2,0,0)", "km.monitor(3,0,0)", "km.monitor(4,0,0)",
                                     "km.monitor(5,0,0)", "km.monitor(0,0,0)", "off (poll only)"};
    return (i >= 0 && i < 7) ? t[i] : "?";
}
void monitorPreset(int i) {
    if (i < 0 || i > 6) return;
    if (i == 6) {
        gCfg.cmdMonitor.clear();
        gCfg.sendMonitor = false;
        touch();
        return;
    }
    gCfg.cmdMonitor = monitorPresetText(i);
    gCfg.sendMonitor = true;
    gCfg.monitorIdx = i;
    gCfg.useBinary = false;
    touch();
    deviceSend(gCfg.cmdMonitor);
    tlog("[trg] sent monitor: %s", gCfg.cmdMonitor.c_str());
}
bool justBound() { return gLastBindAt != 0 && GetTickCount64() - gLastBindAt < 450; }
void startCapture() {
    gCapture = true;
    gCaptureArmed = false;
    gLive.note = "press a key or mouse button on either PC";
}
void stopCapture() { gCapture = false; gLive.note.clear(); }
void touch() { gDirty = true; gDirtyAt = GetTickCount64(); }
std::vector<std::string> listPorts() { return portsImpl(); }
void connectDevice() { openDevice(); }
void probeInput() {
    if (!connected()) {
        gLive.note = "connect the box first";
        return;
    }
    gProbeIdx = 0;
    gProbeAt = 0;
    tlog("[trg] probe start - press E on the MAIN pc repeatedly for ~12s");
}
bool probing() { return gProbeIdx >= 0; }
int baudUsed() { return int(gBaudUsed); }

namespace {

dma_keyboard::Sample (*gRemoteKeys)() = nullptr;
dma_keyboard::Sample gRemote;
dma_keyboard::Bitmap gRemoteInitiallyDown;
ULONGLONG gRemoteAt = 0;

bool usesRemote() {
    return gCfg.keySource == InputSource::MainPc ||
           (gCfg.keySource == InputSource::Legacy && gCfg.keyRemote);
}

bool remoteDown(int key) {
    const int vk = keyToVk(key);
    return gRemote.pid && vk && dma_keyboard::down(gRemote.bits, unsigned(vk));
}

bool remoteInitiallyDown(int key) {
    const int vk = keyToVk(key);
    return vk && dma_keyboard::down(gRemoteInitiallyDown, unsigned(vk));
}

void sampleRemote(ULONGLONG now) {
    if (!gRemoteKeys || (!gCapture && !usesRemote())) {
        gRemote = {};
        gRemoteAt = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (gRemoteAt && now - gRemoteAt < 8) return;
    gRemoteAt = now;
    const auto current = gRemoteKeys();
    if (current.pid != gRemote.pid) {
        gRemoteInitiallyDown = current.bits;
        tlog("[trg] PCIe keyboard %s", current.pid ? "connected" : "disconnected");
    } else {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < current.bits.size(); ++i)
            gRemoteInitiallyDown[i] &= current.bits[i];
    }
    gRemote = current;
}

template<class IsDown>
int firstBinding(IsDown down) {
    for (int key = 1; key < 255; ++key) {
        if (key == VK_SHIFT || key == VK_CONTROL || key == VK_MENU || !keyToVk(key)) continue;
        if (down(key)) return key;
    }
    return 0;
}

bool captureInputs() {
    if (!gCapture) return false;
    const int local = firstBinding(localKeyDown);
    if (!gCaptureArmed) {
        const int remote = firstBinding(remoteDown);
        const bool boxHeld = connected() && gCfg.keyFromDevice && !gRemote.pid &&
            (gKeyHeld || std::any_of(std::begin(gBtn) + 1, std::end(gBtn), [](bool held) { return held; }));
        gCaptureArmed = !local && !remote && !boxHeld;
    } else if (local) {
        bindKey(local, vkToHid(local), InputSource::SecondPc);
    } else {
        const int remote = firstBinding([](int key) {
            return remoteDown(key) && !remoteInitiallyDown(key);
        });
        if (remote) bindKey(remote, vkToHid(remote), InputSource::MainPc);
    }
    return true;
}

bool remoteMouseSettling(ULONGLONG now) {
    return usesRemote() && gCfg.key >= 1 && gCfg.key <= 5 &&
           (gDownAt || (gOutputReleasedAt && now - gOutputReleasedAt < 40));
}

bool boundDown() {
    if (usesRemote()) return remoteDown(gCfg.key) && !remoteInitiallyDown(gCfg.key);
    if (gCfg.keySource == InputSource::SecondPc) return localKeyDown(gCfg.key);
    return (gCfg.keySource == InputSource::Legacy && gCfg.keyFromLocal && localKeyDown(gCfg.key)) ||
           (connected() && boxInputEnabled() && deviceKeyDown(gCfg.key));
}

}  // namespace

void setRemoteKeys(dma_keyboard::Sample (*fn)()) { gRemoteKeys = fn; }

void pollInputs() {
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    const bool settling = remoteMouseSettling(now);
    if (!settling) sampleRemote(now);
    if (captureInputs()) {
        gLive.keyHeld = false;
        return;
    }
    const bool held = settling ? gRemote.pid && gLive.keyHeld : boundDown();
    if (gWaitForBoundRelease && !held) gWaitForBoundRelease = false;
    const bool activated = held && !gWaitForBoundRelease;
    if (activated && !gLive.keyHeld) {
        ++gLive.keyPresses;
        tlog("[trg] %s key=%d total=%llu", keySourceLabel(), gCfg.key,
             static_cast<unsigned long long>(gLive.keyPresses));
    }
    gLive.keyHeld = activated;
}

bool remoteKeysReady() { return gRemote.pid != 0; }

const char* keySourceLabel() {
    if (usesRemote()) return "Main PC";
    if (gCfg.keySource == InputSource::SecondPc) return "Second PC";
    if (gCfg.keySource == InputSource::Box) return "Box";
    return "Local / box";
}

void clickOnce() {
    if (!connected()) return;
    deviceSend(gCfg.cmdDown);
    gDownAt = GetTickCount64();
    ++gLive.clicks;
}
void disconnectDevice() {
    closeDevice();
    setStatus("disconnected");
    gLive.note.clear();
    if (gDownAt) gDownAt = 0;
}

const char* boneName(int i) {
    static const char* const n[16] = {"Head", "Neck",  "Spine", "Pelvis", "R.Shoulder", "R.Elbow", "R.Hand", "L.Shoulder",
                                      "L.Elbow", "L.Hand", "R.Hip", "R.Knee", "R.Foot", "L.Hip",     "L.Knee", "L.Foot"};
    return (i >= 0 && i < 16) ? n[i] : "?";
}

void update(const std::vector<Cand>& cands, float cx, float cy) {
    const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    probeStep();
    if (gDirty && now - gDirtyAt > 600) {
        gDirty = false;
        save();
    }
    if (!connected()) {
        gLive.target = false;
        if (gCfg.autoConnect && now - gLastRetry > 1500) {
            gLastRetry = now;
            openDevice();
        }
        return;
    }
    static ULONGLONG lastPoll = 0, lastKeyPoll = 0;
    if (now - lastPoll >= 3) {
        lastPoll = now;
        devicePoll();
    }
    if (now - lastKeyPoll >= 50) {
        lastKeyPoll = now;
        pollKey();
    }
    if (!probing() && gCfg.useBinary && !gCfg.modeNet && (gStreamLost || now - gLastStreamOn > 10000)) sendStreams();

    if (gDownAt && now - gDownAt >= (ULONGLONG)std::max(2, gCfg.clickMs)) {
        deviceSend(gCfg.cmdUp);
        gDownAt = 0;
        gOutputReleasedAt = now;
    }

    const float rad = float(std::max(1, gCfg.radiusPx));
    const Cand* best = nullptr;
    float bestD = 1e9f;
    for (const Cand& c : cands) {
        if (!(gCfg.hitMask & (1u << c.bone))) continue;
        if (c.kind != 1) {
            if (gCfg.playersOnly) continue;
            if (c.kind != 2 && c.kind != 3) continue;
            if (c.kind == 3 && !gCfg.animals) continue;
        }
        if (gCfg.maxDistM > 0 && c.dist > float(gCfg.maxDistM)) continue;
        const float dx = c.x - cx, dy = c.y - cy;
        const float dd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dd > rad) continue;
        if (dd < bestD) {
            bestD = dd;
            best = &c;
        }
    }

    if (!gCfg.enabled || !best) {
        gHaveArmed = false;
        gArmedId = 0;
        gLive.target = false;
        gLive.bone = -1;
        gLive.heldMs = 0;
        return;
    }
    gLive.target = true;
    gLive.dist = best->dist;
    gLive.px = bestD;
    gLive.bone = best->bone;
    if (!gHaveArmed || gArmedId != best->id) {
        gHaveArmed = true;
        gArmedId = best->id;
        gArmedAt = now;
    }
    gLive.heldMs = int(now - gArmedAt);
    if (!gLive.keyHeld || gDownAt || remoteMouseSettling(now)) return;
    if (now - gArmedAt < (ULONGLONG)gCfg.delayMs) return;
    if (gLastShot && now - gLastShot < (ULONGLONG)std::max(1, gCfg.refireMs)) return;
    deviceSend(gCfg.cmdDown);
    gDownAt = now;
    gLastShot = now;
    ++gLive.clicks;
}

}  // namespace trigger
```

```h
#pragma once
// Pure mouse-box triggerbot (KMBox / MAKCU / similar). No game memory writes:
// bones + camera are read over DMA, the decision is made here, and the click is
// sent to the little USB box which sits in-line with the gaming PC's mouse.
// The box also reports the physical mouse/keyboard, so the trigger key is the
// one on the *gaming* keyboard (works PC to PC). Device config lives in trigger.ini.
#include "keyboard_bitmap.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace trigger {

// hitbox bits, order matches the DayZ joint enum used by the ESP
enum Hit : unsigned {
    H_Head = 1u << 0, H_Neck = 1u << 1, H_Spine = 1u << 2, H_Pelvis = 1u << 3,
    H_RSh = 1u << 4, H_REl = 1u << 5, H_RHand = 1u << 6,
    H_LSh = 1u << 7, H_LEl = 1u << 8, H_LHand = 1u << 9,
    H_RHip = 1u << 10, H_RKnee = 1u << 11, H_RFoot = 1u << 12,
    H_LHip = 1u << 13, H_LKnee = 1u << 14, H_LFoot = 1u << 15,
    H_All = 0xFFFFu,
};

struct Cand {
    float x = 0, y = 0;
    float dist = 0;
    int bone = 0;
    int kind = 0;  // 1 survivor, 2 infected, 3 animal, 4 vehicle
    bool isFriend = false;
    uint64_t id = 0;
};

enum class InputSource { Legacy, MainPc, SecondPc, Box };

struct Config {
    bool enabled = false;
    bool playersOnly = true;
    bool animals = false;
    int key = 2;  // 1..5 mouse buttons, else key code (2 = right mouse default)
    InputSource keySource = InputSource::Legacy;
    bool keyFromDevice = true;
    bool keyFromLocal = true;  // also accept the key on THIS pc (both PCs work)
    bool keyRemote = true;     // exclusive input from the target Windows session over PCIe
    int keyHid = 0;            // HID usage of the bound key (for the box side), 0 = unknown
    bool useBinary = true;     // MAKCU: use the binary input stream frames (DE AD ... 52)
    int delayMs = 50;    // dwell time before the shot
    int radiusPx = 15;   // hit radius around the crosshair
    unsigned hitMask = H_Head | H_Neck | H_Spine | H_Pelvis;
    int maxDistM = 150;
    int refireMs = 60;
    int clickMs = 25;    // how long the synthetic button stays down
    bool modeNet = false;
    std::string port;
    int baud = 115200;
    bool autoBaud = true;  // try 115200 and 4 M and keep whichever answers
    std::string host = "192.168.4.1";
    int netPort = 8888;
    bool sendMonitor = true;
    int monitorIdx = 3;
    std::string cmdConnect = "km.version()";
    std::string cmdMonitor = "km.monitor(4,0,0)";
    std::string cmdDown = "km.left(1)";
    std::string cmdUp = "km.left(0)";
    std::string cmdKeyPoll = "km.get_key({vk})";
    bool autoConnect = true;
    bool moduleOpen = false;
    bool showDebug = false;
};

struct Live {
    bool target = false;
    float dist = 0;
    float px = 0;
    int bone = -1;
    bool keyHeld = false;
    uint64_t keyPresses = 0;
    int clicks = 0;
    int heldMs = 0;
    std::string note;
    std::string lastRx;
};

Config& cfg();
Live& live();
const std::string& status();
bool connected();
bool capturing();
int baudUsed();  // 0 while not connected, else the baud that worked
void probeInput();  // step through candidate enable-commands, logging all raw replies
bool probing();
bool justBound();  // a bind happened <450ms ago (so a stop-click does not restart it)
void startCapture();
void stopCapture();

void load();
void save();
void touch();  // request a debounced save

std::vector<std::string> listPorts();
void connectDevice();
void disconnectDevice();
void clickOnce();  // one test click through the box

// cands = every visible hitbox of every target (overlay pixels), cx/cy = crosshair
void update(const std::vector<Cand>& cands, float cx, float cy);

void setLog(void (*fn)(const char*));
void setRemoteKeys(dma_keyboard::Sample (*fn)());
void pollInputs();
bool remoteKeysReady();

const std::string& ident();
void sendRaw(const std::string& cmd);
int monitorPresetCount();

void monitorPreset(int i);

const char* boneName(int i);

}  // namespace trigger
```

```cpp
#include "ui.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

namespace ui {

Fonts fonts;

void init() {
    fonts.sans = std::make_unique<FontFamily>(L"Segoe UI");
    fonts.mono = std::make_unique<FontFamily>(L"Consolas");
    fonts.title = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.sans.get(), 22.0f, FontStyleBold, UnitPixel);
    fonts.sub = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.sans.get(), 12.0f, FontStyleRegular, UnitPixel);
    fonts.btn = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.sans.get(), 13.0f, FontStyleBold, UnitPixel);
    fonts.body = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.sans.get(), 14.0f, FontStyleRegular, UnitPixel);
    fonts.caption = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.sans.get(), 12.0f, FontStyleRegular, UnitPixel);
    fonts.monoSmall = std::make_unique<Font>(fonts.mono.get(), 12.0f, FontStyleRegular, UnitPixel);

    fonts.semiFam = std::make_unique<FontFamily>(L"Segoe UI Semibold");
    const bool semiOk = fonts.semiFam->IsAvailable();
    const FontFamily* sf = semiOk ? fonts.semiFam.get() : fonts.sans.get();
    const int style = semiOk ? FontStyleRegular : FontStyleBold;
    fonts.semi = std::make_unique<Font>(sf, 13.0f, style, UnitPixel);
    fonts.heading = std::make_unique<Font>(sf, 22.0f, style, UnitPixel);
    fonts.micro = std::make_unique<Font>(sf, 10.5f, style, UnitPixel);
}

void shutdown() { fonts = Fonts{}; }

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) return {};
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring w(n, 0);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, &w[0], n);
    w.resize(n - 1);
    return w;
}

void roundedRect(GraphicsPath& p, RectF r, float rad) {
    const float d = rad * 2;
    p.AddArc(r.X, r.Y, d, d, 180, 90);
    p.AddArc(r.X + r.Width - d, r.Y, d, d, 270, 90);
    p.AddArc(r.X + r.Width - d, r.Y + r.Height - d, d, d, 0, 90);
    p.AddArc(r.X, r.Y + r.Height - d, d, d, 90, 90);
    p.CloseFigure();
}

void fillRR(Graphics& g, Brush& b, RectF r, float rad) {
    GraphicsPath p;
    roundedRect(p, r, rad);
    g.FillPath(&b, &p);
}

void strokeRR(Graphics& g, Color c, RectF r, float rad, float w) {
    GraphicsPath p;
    roundedRect(p, r, rad);
    Pen pen(c, w);
    g.DrawPath(&pen, &p);
}

void text(Graphics& g, const std::string& s, const Font& f, RectF r, Color c, StringAlignment h, StringAlignment v, bool ellipsis) {
    StringFormat sf;
    sf.SetAlignment(h);
    sf.SetLineAlignment(v);
    sf.SetFormatFlags(StringFormatFlagsNoWrap);
    if (ellipsis) sf.SetTrimming(StringTrimmingEllipsisCharacter);
    SolidBrush b(c);
    const std::wstring w = widen(s);
    g.DrawString(w.c_str(), -1, &f, r, &sf, &b);
}

void button(Graphics& g, const std::string& label, RectF r, bool active, bool hot, bool pressed, Color fillActive, Color fillHot) {
    Color fill = active ? (pressed ? kAccentLo : hot ? fillHot : fillActive) : (hot ? kTabHot : kTabIdle);
    SolidBrush b(fill);
    fillRR(g, b, r, 8);
    if (!active) strokeRR(g, kBorder, r, 8);
    text(g, label, *fonts.btn, r, active ? kWhite : kDim);
}

}
```

```h
// leechcore.h : external header of the LeechCore library.
//
// LeechCore is a library which abstracts away reading and writing to various
// software and hardware acquisition sources. Sources ranges from memory dump
// files to driver backed live memory to hardware (FPGA) DMA backed memory.
//
// LeechCore built-in device support may be extended with external plugin
// device drivers placed as .dll or .so files in the same folder as LeechCore.
//
// For more information please consult the LeechCore information on Github:
// - README: https://github.com/ufrisk/LeechCore
// - GUIDE:  https://github.com/ufrisk/LeechCore/wiki
//
// (c) Ulf Frisk, 2020-2026
// Author: Ulf Frisk, pcileech@frizk.net
//
// Header Version: 2.23
//

#ifndef __LEECHCORE_H__
#define __LEECHCORE_H__
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif /* __cplusplus */

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// OS COMPATIBILITY BELOW:
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#ifdef _WIN32

#include <Windows.h>
#define EXPORTED_FUNCTION                   __declspec(dllexport)
typedef unsigned __int64                    QWORD, *PQWORD;

#endif /* _WIN32 */
#if defined(LINUX) || defined(MACOS)

#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#define EXPORTED_FUNCTION                   __attribute__((visibility("default")))
typedef void                                VOID, *PVOID, *HANDLE, **PHANDLE, *HMODULE;
typedef long long unsigned int              QWORD, *PQWORD, ULONG64, *PULONG64;
typedef size_t                              SIZE_T, *PSIZE_T;

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Create and Close LeechCore devices:
// It's possible to create multiple LeechCore devices in parallel and also of
// different types if the underlying device will allow this. LeechCore will
// automatically take care of and abstract away any hardware/software issues
// with regards to the underlying devices.
//
// For more information about supported devices please check out the LeechCore
// guide at: https://github.com/ufrisk/LeechCore/wiki
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#define LC_CONFIG_VERSION                       0xc0fd0002
#define LC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO_VERSION             0xc0fe0002

#define LC_CONFIG_PRINTF_ENABLED                0x01
#define LC_CONFIG_PRINTF_V                      0x02
#define LC_CONFIG_PRINTF_VV                     0x04
#define LC_CONFIG_PRINTF_VVV                    0x08

typedef struct LC_CONFIG {
    // below are set by caller
    DWORD dwVersion;                        // must equal LC_CREATE_VERSION
    DWORD dwPrintfVerbosity;                // printf verbosity according to LC_PRINTF_*
    CHAR szDevice[MAX_PATH];                // device configuration - see wiki for additional info.
    CHAR szRemote[MAX_PATH];                // remote configuration - see wiki for additional info.
    _Check_return_opt_ int(*pfn_printf_opt)(_In_z_ _Printf_format_string_ char const *const _Format, ...);
    // below are set by caller, updated by LeecCore
    QWORD paMax;                            // max physical address (disables any max address auto-detect).
    // below are set by LeechCore
    BOOL fVolatile;
    BOOL fWritable;
    BOOL fRemote;
    BOOL fRemoteDisableCompress;
    CHAR szDeviceName[MAX_PATH];            // device name - such as 'fpga' or 'file'.
} LC_CONFIG, *PLC_CONFIG;

typedef struct tdLC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO {
    DWORD dwVersion;                        // must equal LC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO_VERSION
    DWORD cbStruct;
    DWORD _FutureUse[16];
    BOOL fUserInputRequest;
    DWORD cwszUserText;
    WCHAR wszUserText[];
} LC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO, *PLC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO, **PPLC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO;

/*
* Create a new LeechCore device according to the supplied configuration.
* CALLER LcMemFree: ppLcCreateErrorInfo
* -- pLcCreateConfig
* -- ppLcCreateErrorInfo = ptr to receive function allocated struct with error
*       information upon function failure. This info may contain a user message
*       requesting user action as an example. Any returned struct should be
*       free'd by a call to LcMemFree().
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return != NULL)
HANDLE LcCreate(
    _Inout_ PLC_CONFIG pLcCreateConfig
);

EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return != NULL)
HANDLE LcCreateEx(
    _Inout_ PLC_CONFIG pLcCreateConfig,
    _Out_opt_ PPLC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO ppLcCreateErrorInfo
);

/*
* Close a LeechCore handle and free any resources no longer needed.
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION
VOID LcClose(
    _In_opt_ _Post_ptr_invalid_ HANDLE hLC
);



//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Read and Write memory from underlying device either using contiguous method
// or more recommended scatter method.
//
// The MEM_SCATTER struct allows reading and writing of discontiguous memory
// chunks which must adhere to the following rules:
// - maximum size = 0x1000 (4096) bytes = recommended size.
// - minimum size = 2 DWORDs (8 bytes).
// - must be DWORD (4 byte) aligned.
// - must never cross 0x1000 page boundary.
// - max value of iStack = MEM_SCATTER_STACK_SIZE - 2.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#define MEM_SCATTER_VERSION                 0xc0fe0002
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_SIZE              12

typedef struct tdMEM_SCATTER {
    DWORD version;                          // MEM_SCATTER_VERSION
    BOOL f;                                 // TRUE = success data in pb, FALSE = fail or not yet read.
    QWORD qwA;                              // address of memory to read
    union {
        PBYTE pb;                           // buffer to hold memory contents
        QWORD _Filler;
    };
    DWORD cb;                               // size of buffer to hold memory contents.
    DWORD iStack;                           // internal stack pointer
    QWORD vStack[MEM_SCATTER_STACK_SIZE];   // internal stack
} MEM_SCATTER, *PMEM_SCATTER, **PPMEM_SCATTER;

#define MEM_SCATTER_ADDR_INVALID            ((QWORD)-1)
#define MEM_SCATTER_ADDR_ISINVALID(pMEM)    (pMEM->qwA == (QWORD)-1)
#define MEM_SCATTER_ADDR_ISVALID(pMEM)      (pMEM->qwA != (QWORD)-1)
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_PUSH(pMEM, v)     (pMEM->vStack[pMEM->iStack++] = (QWORD)(v))
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_PEEK(pMEM, i)     (pMEM->vStack[pMEM->iStack - i])
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_SET(pMEM, i, v)   (pMEM->vStack[pMEM->iStack - i] = (QWORD)(v))
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_ADD(pMEM, i, v)   (pMEM->vStack[pMEM->iStack - i] += (QWORD)(v))
#define MEM_SCATTER_STACK_POP(pMEM)         (pMEM->vStack[--pMEM->iStack])

/*
* Free LeechCore allocated memory such as memory allocated by the
* LcAllocScatter / LcCommand functions.
* -- pv
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION
VOID LcMemFree(
    _Frees_ptr_opt_ PVOID pv
);

/*
* Allocate and pre-initialize empty MEMs including a 0x1000 buffer for each
* pMEM. The result should be freed by LcFree when its no longer needed.
* The 0x1000-sized per-MEM memory buffers are contigious between MEMs in order.
* -- cMEMs
* -- pppMEMs = pointer to receive ppMEMs
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcAllocScatter1(
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Out_ PPMEM_SCATTER *pppMEMs
);

/*
* Allocate and pre-initialize empty MEMs excluding the 0x1000 buffer which
* will be accounted towards the pbData buffer in a contiguous way.
* The result should be freed by LcFree when its no longer needed.
* -- cbData = size of pbData (must be cMEMs * 0x1000)
* -- pbData = buffer used for MEM.pb
* -- cMEMs
* -- pppMEMs = pointer to receive ppMEMs
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcAllocScatter2(
    _In_ DWORD cbData,
    _Inout_updates_opt_(cbData) PBYTE pbData,
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Out_ PPMEM_SCATTER *pppMEMs
);

/*
* Allocate and pre-initialize empty MEMs excluding the 0x1000 buffer which
* will be accounted towards the pbData buffer in a contiguous way.
* -- pbDataFirstPage = optional buffer of first page
* -- pbDataLastPage = optional buffer of last page
* -- cbData = size of pbData
* -- pbData = buffer used for MEM.pb except first/last if exists
* -- cMEMs
* -- pppMEMs = pointer to receive ppMEMs
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcAllocScatter3(
    _Inout_updates_opt_(0x1000) PBYTE pbDataFirstPage,
    _Inout_updates_opt_(0x1000) PBYTE pbDataLastPage,
    _In_ DWORD cbData,
    _Inout_updates_opt_(cbData) PBYTE pbData,
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Out_ PPMEM_SCATTER *pppMEMs
);

/*
* Read memory in a scattered non-contiguous way. This is recommended for reads.
* -- hLC
* -- cMEMs
* -- ppMEMs
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION
VOID LcReadScatter(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Inout_ PPMEM_SCATTER ppMEMs
);

/*
* Read memory in a contiguous way. Note that if multiple memory segments are
* to be read LcReadScatter() may be more efficient.
* -- hLC,
* -- pa
* -- cb
* -- pb
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcRead(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ QWORD pa,
    _In_ DWORD cb,
    _Out_writes_(cb) PBYTE pb
);

/*
* Per-page result returned by LcReadScatterEx(). Numeric values are ABI-stable.
* NOT_ISSUED means the backend rejected the page locally and did not send a
* request to the target.
*/
typedef DWORD LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT, *PLC_READ_PAGE_RESULT;
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_NONE                    0x00
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_SUCCESS                 0x01
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_SUCCESS_AFTER_RETRY     0x02
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST     0x03
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_COMPLETER_ABORT         0x04
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_NO_COMPLETION           0x05
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_PARTIAL_COMPLETION      0x06
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_TRANSPORT_ERROR         0x07
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_PROTOCOL_ERROR          0x08
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_UNSPECIFIED_ERROR       0x09
#define LC_READ_PAGE_RESULT_NOT_ISSUED              0x0A

/*
* Read memory in a scattered non-contiguous way and return a typed result for
* every page. The function-level result reports argument/setup/dispatch status;
* individual page success remains in MEM_SCATTER.f and pResults.
* -- hLC
* -- cMEMs
* -- ppMEMs
* -- pResults
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcReadScatterEx(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Inout_ PPMEM_SCATTER ppMEMs,
    _Out_writes_(cMEMs) PLC_READ_PAGE_RESULT pResults
);

/*
* Write memory in a scattered non-contiguous way.
* -- hLC
* -- cMEMs
* -- ppMEMs
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION
VOID LcWriteScatter(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ DWORD cMEMs,
    _Inout_ PPMEM_SCATTER ppMEMs
);

/*
* Write memory in a contiguous way.
* -- hLC
* -- pa
* -- cb
* -- pb
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcWrite(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ QWORD pa,
    _In_ DWORD cb,
    _In_reads_(cb) PBYTE pb
);

EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)

    _In_ QWORD fOption,
    _Out_ PQWORD pqwValue
);

/*
* Get an option as defined by LC_OPT_*. (W option).
* -- hLC
* -- fOption = LC_OPT_*
* -- cbData
* -- pbData
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcSetOption(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ QWORD fOption,
    _In_ QWORD qwValue
);

/*
* Execute a command and retrieve a result (if any) at the same time.
* NB! If *ppbDataOut contains a memory allocation on exit this should be free'd
*     by calling LcMemFree().
* CALLER LcFreeMem: *ppbDataOut
* -- hLC
* -- fCommand = LC_CMD_*
* -- cbDataIn
* -- pbDataIn
* -- ppbDataOut
* -- pcbDataOut
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL LcCommand(
    _In_ HANDLE hLC,
    _In_ QWORD fCommand,
    _In_ DWORD cbDataIn,
    _In_reads_opt_(cbDataIn) PBYTE pbDataIn,
    _Out_opt_ PBYTE *ppbDataOut,
    _Out_opt_ PDWORD pcbDataOut
);

    DWORD _FutureUse;

    BYTE pb[0];
} LC_CMD_AGENT_VFS_RSP, *PLC_CMD_AGENT_VFS_RSP;

/*
* TLP structure to be used with LC_CMD_FPGA_TLP_WRITE_MULTIPLE.
*/
typedef struct tdLC_TLP {
    DWORD cb;
    DWORD _Reserved1;
    PBYTE pb;
} LC_TLP, *PLC_TLP;

/*
* Custom FPGA callback function called when a TLP is received.
* Callback function set by command LC_CMD_FPGA_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK.
* User-defined context is set by command: LC_CMD_FPGA_TLP_CONTEXT.
*/
typedef VOID(*PLC_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(
    _In_opt_ PVOID ctx,
    _In_ DWORD cbTlp,
    _In_ PBYTE pbTlp,
    _In_opt_ DWORD cbInfo,
    _In_opt_ LPSTR szInfo
);

#define LC_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK_DISABLE        (PLC_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(NULL)
#define LC_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK_DUMMY          (PLC_TLP_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(-1)



//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// VMM (VM) LOOPBACK SUPPORT:
// Functionality is used to create a VMM loopback device which is used by VMM
// to read and write memory to/from a virtual machine. See VMM for an example.
// Struct is passed in the 'hlcvmm' parameter to LcCreate() and will be copied.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#define LC_VMM_VERSION                          0x1eef0001

typedef struct tdLC_VMM {
    DWORD dwVersion;
    HANDLE hVMM;
    HANDLE hVMMVM;
    PVOID pfnVMMDLL_ConfigGet;
    PVOID pfnVMMDLL_VmMemReadScatter;
    PVOID pfnVMMDLL_VmMemWriteScatter;
} LC_VMM, *PLC_VMM;



//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PCIE BAR SUPPORT:
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

typedef struct tdLC_BAR {
    BOOL fValid;
    BOOL fIO;
    BOOL f64Bit;
    BOOL fPrefetchable;
    DWORD _Filler[3];
    DWORD iBar;
    QWORD pa;
    QWORD cb;
} LC_BAR, *PLC_BAR;

typedef struct tdLC_BAR_REQUEST {
    PVOID ctx;              // user context (set by command LC_CMD_FPGA_BAR_CONTEXT)
    PLC_BAR pBar;           // BAR info
    BYTE bTag;              // TLP tag (0-255)
    BYTE bFirstBE;          // First byte enable (0-3) [relevant for writes]
    BYTE bLastBE;           // Last byte enable (0-3) [relevant for writes]
    BYTE _Filler;
    BOOL f64;               // 64-bit bar access (false = 32-bit)
    BOOL fRead;             // BAR read request, called function should update pbData with read data and set fReadReply = TRUE on success.
    BOOL fReadReply;        // Read success - should be updated by called function upon read success (after updating pbData).
    BOOL fWrite;            // BAR write request (no reply should be sent, check byte-enables bFirstBE/bLastBE)
    DWORD cbData;           // number of bytes to read/write
    QWORD oData;            // data offset in BAR.
    BYTE pbData[4096];      // bytes to write or read data (to be updated by called function).
} LC_BAR_REQUEST, *PLC_BAR_REQUEST;

/*
* Custom FPGA callback function to be called when BAR read/write is received.
* Callback function set by command LC_CMD_FPGA_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK.
* User-defined context is set by command: LC_CMD_FPGA_BAR_CONTEXT.
* Read reply is sent by updating pbData with read data and fReadReply = TRUE.
* To return Unsupported Request (UR) set fReadReply = FALSE on a MRd request.
*/
typedef VOID(*PLC_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(_Inout_ PLC_BAR_REQUEST pBarRequest);

#define LC_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK_DISABLE        (PLC_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(NULL)
#define LC_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK_ZEROBAR        (PLC_BAR_FUNCTION_CALLBACK)(-1)


#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif /* __cplusplus */
#endif /* __LEECHCORE_H__ */
```

```h
/*
* Initialize VMM.DLL with command line parameters. For a more detailed info
* about the parameters please see github wiki for MemProcFS and LeechCore.
* NB! LeechCore initialization parameters are _also_ valid to this function.
* Important parameters are:
*    -printf = show printf style outputs.
*    -v -vv -vvv = extra verbosity levels.
*    -device = device as on format for LeechCore - please see leechcore.h or
*              Github documentation for additional information. Some values
*              are: <file>, fpga, usb3380, hvsavedstate, totalmeltdown, pmem
*    -remote = remote LeechCore instance - please see leechcore.h or Github
*              documentation for additional information.
*    -norefresh = disable background refreshes (even if backing memory is
*              volatile memory).
*    -memmap = specify a physical memory map given by file or specify 'auto'.
*              example: -memmap c:\\temp\\my_custom_memory_map.txt
*              example: -memmap auto
*    -pagefile[0-9] = page file(s) to use in addition to physical memory.
*              Normally pagefile.sys have index 0 and swapfile.sys index 1.
*              Page files are in constant flux - do not use if time diff
*              between memory dump and page files are more than few minutes.
*              Example: 'pagefile0 swapfile.sys'
*    -disable-python = prevent the python plugin sub-system from loading.
*    -disable-symbolserver = disable symbol server until user change.
*              This parameter will take precedence over registry settings.
*    -disable-symbols = disable symbol lookups from .pdb files.
*    -disable-infodb = disable the infodb and any symbol lookups via it.
*    -waitinitialize = Wait for initialization to complete before returning.
*              Normal use is that some initialization is done asynchronously
*              and may not be completed when initialization call is completed.
*              This includes virtual memory compression, registry and more.
*              Example: '-waitinitialize'
*    -userinteract = allow vmm.dll to, on the console, query the user for
*              information such as, but not limited to, leechcore device options.
*              Default: user interaction = disabled.
*    -vm       = virtual machine (VM) parsing.
*    -vm-basic = virtual machine (VM) parsing (physical memory only).
*    -vm-nested = virtual machine (VM) parsing (including nested VMs).
*    -forensic-yara-rules = perfom a forensic yara scan with specified rules.
*              Full path to source or compiled yara rules should be specified.
*              Example: -forensic-yara-rules "C:\Temp\my_yara_rules.yar"
*    -forensic = start a forensic scan of the physical memory immediately after
*              startup if possible. Allowed parameter values range from 0-4.
*              Note! forensic mode is not available for live memory.
*              1 = forensic mode with in-memory sqlite database.
*              2 = forensic mode with temp sqlite database deleted upon exit.
*              3 = forensic mode with temp sqlite database remaining upon exit.
*              4 = forensic mode with static named sqlite database (vmm.sqlite3).
*              Example -forensic 4
*
* -- argc
* -- argv
* -- ppLcErrorInfo = optional pointer to receive a function allocated memory of
*              struct LC_CONFIG_ERRORINFO with extended error information upon
*              failure. Any memory received should be free'd by caller by
*              calling LcMemFree().
* -- return = VMM_HANDLE on success for usage in subsequent API calls. NULL=fail.
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return != NULL)

EXPORTED_FUNCTION NTSTATUS VMMDLL_UtilVfsReadFile_FromDWORD(_In_ DWORD dwValue, _Out_writes_to_(cb, *pcbRead) PBYTE pb, _In_ DWORD cb, _Out_ PDWORD pcbRead, _In_ ULONG64 cbOffset, _In_ BOOL fPrefix);
EXPORTED_FUNCTION NTSTATUS VMMDLL_UtilVfsReadFile_FromBOOL(_In_ BOOL fValue, _Out_writes_to_(cb, *pcbRead) PBYTE pb, _In_ DWORD cb, _Out_ PDWORD pcbRead, _In_ ULONG64 cbOffset);
EXPORTED_FUNCTION NTSTATUS VMMDLL_UtilVfsWriteFile_BOOL(_Inout_ PBOOL pfTarget, _In_reads_(cb) PBYTE pb, _In_ DWORD cb, _Out_ PDWORD pcbWrite, _In_ ULONG64 cbOffset);
EXPORTED_FUNCTION NTSTATUS VMMDLL_UtilVfsWriteFile_DWORD(_Inout_ PDWORD pdwTarget, _In_reads_(cb) PBYTE pb, _In_ DWORD cb, _Out_ PDWORD pcbWrite, _In_ ULONG64 cbOffset, _In_ DWORD dwMinAllow);



//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PLUGIN MANAGER FUNCTIONALITY BELOW:
// Function and structures to initialize and use MemProcFS plugin functionality.
// The plugin manager is started by a call to function:
// VMM_VfsInitializePlugins. Each built-in plugin and external plugin of which
// the DLL name matches m_*.dll will receive a call to its InitializeVmmPlugin
// function. The plugin/module may decide to call pfnPluginManager_Register to
// register plugins in the form of different names one or more times.
// Example of registration function in a plugin DLL below: 
// 'VOID InitializeVmmPlugin(_In_ VMM_HANDLE H, _In_ PVMM_PLUGIN_REGINFO pRegInfo)'
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
* Initialize all potential plugins, both built-in and external, that maps into
* MemProcFS. Please note that plugins are not loaded by default - they have to
* be explicitly loaded by calling this function. They will be unloaded on a
* general close of the vmm dll.
* -- hVMM
* -- return
*/
EXPORTED_FUNCTION _Success_(return)
BOOL VMMDLL_InitializePlugins(_In_ VMM_HANDLE hVMM);

#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_CONTEXT_MAGIC                 0xc0ffee663df9301c
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_CONTEXT_VERSION               5
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_REGINFO_MAGIC                 0xc0ffee663df9301d
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_REGINFO_VERSION               18
#define VMMDLL_FORENSIC_JSONDATA_VERSION            0xc0ee0002
#define VMMDLL_FORENSIC_INGEST_VIRTMEM_VERSION      0xc0dd0001
#define VMMDLL_FORENSIC_INGEST_OBJECT_VERSION       0xc0de0001

#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_VERBOSITYCHANGE        0x01
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_REFRESH_FAST           0x05    // refresh fast event   - at partial process refresh.
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_REFRESH_MEDIUM         0x02    // refresh medium event - at full process refresh.
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_REFRESH_SLOW           0x04    // refresh slow event   - at registry refresh.

#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_FORENSIC_INIT          0x01000100
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_FORENSIC_INIT_COMPLETE 0x01000200
#define VMMDLL_PLUGIN_NOTIFY_VM_ATTACH_DETACH       0x01000400
```
