`tools/keyboard_probe.cpp`:

```cpp
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 4200 4201)
#include "../src/keyboard_resolver.h"
#pragma warning(pop)

#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace {

using namespace dma_keyboard;

struct Vmm : Reader {
    HMODULE dll = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_Close) close = nullptr;
    decltype(&VMMDLL_ProcessGetProcAddressU) exportAddress = nullptr;

    template<class Fn>
    Fn load(const char* name) const {
        const auto fn = reinterpret_cast<Fn>(GetProcAddress(dll, name));
        if (!fn) throw std::runtime_error(name);
        return fn;
    }

    void open(const wchar_t* path) {
        dll = LoadLibraryExW(path, nullptr, LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH);
        if (!dll) throw std::runtime_error("Could not load vmm.dll. Pass its absolute path.");
        close = load<decltype(close)>("VMMDLL_Close");
        read = load<decltype(read)>("VMMDLL_MemReadEx");
        module = load<decltype(module)>("VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU");
        processes = load<decltype(processes)>("VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll");
        free = load<decltype(free)>("VMMDLL_MemFree");
        exportAddress = load<decltype(exportAddress)>("VMMDLL_ProcessGetProcAddressU");
        registry = load<decltype(registry)>("VMMDLL_WinReg_QueryValueExU");
        const auto initialize = load<decltype(&VMMDLL_Initialize)>("VMMDLL_Initialize");
        LPCSTR args[]{"", "-device", "fpga", "-waitinitialize"};
        handle = initialize(DWORD(std::size(args)), args);
        if (!handle) throw std::runtime_error("FPGA initialization failed. Close other DMA clients and check the link.");
    }

    ~Vmm() {
        if (handle) close(handle);
        if (dll) FreeLibrary(dll);
    }

};

bool phase(const Vmm& vmm, DWORD pid, uint64_t address, const char* prompt, unsigned expected, bool localControl = false) {
    std::printf("\n%s\nPress Enter on the second PC, wait for GO, then follow the instruction for 8 seconds.\n", prompt);
    std::string line;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) throw std::runtime_error("Interactive verification cancelled.");
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(700));
    Bitmap previous{};
    if (!vmm.exact(pid, address, previous)) throw std::runtime_error("Baseline read failed.");
    for (unsigned vk = 8; vk < 255; ++vk)
        if (down(previous, vk)) throw std::runtime_error("Baseline contains a held keyboard VK.");
    std::puts("GO");
    std::fflush(stdout);
    unsigned rises = 0, falls = 0, unexpected = 0, mouseChanges = 0, localRises = 0, localFalls = 0;
    bool localWasDown = false;
    const auto stop = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(8);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < stop) {
        Bitmap current{};
        if (!vmm.exact(pid, address, current)) throw std::runtime_error("Read lost during verification.");
        for (unsigned vk = 1; vk < 255; ++vk) {
            const bool now = down(current, vk);
            if (now == down(previous, vk)) continue;
            if (vk == 1 || vk == 2 || vk == 4 || vk == 5 || vk == 6) ++mouseChanges;
            if (vk >= 8 && vk != expected) ++unexpected;
            if (vk == expected) (now ? rises : falls)++;
        }
        previous = current;
        if (localControl) {
            const bool localDown = (GetAsyncKeyState('E') & 0x8000) != 0;
            if (localDown != localWasDown) (localDown ? localRises : localFalls)++;
            localWasDown = localDown;
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(8));
    }
    const unsigned required = expected ? 2 : 0;
    if (localControl) std::printf("Local E control: rises=%u falls=%u\n", localRises, localFalls);
    const bool passed = rises == required && falls == required && unexpected == 0 &&
                        (!localControl || (localRises == 2 && localFalls == 2));
    std::printf("rises=%u falls=%u unrelated keyboard edges=%u mouse edges=%u: %s\n",
                rises, falls, unexpected, mouseChanges, passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
    return passed;
}

}  // namespace

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv) try {
    if (argc < 2 || argc > 4 || (argc == 4 && wcscmp(argv[3], L"--verify") != 0)) {
        std::puts("Usage: keyboard_probe.exe <absolute path to vmm.dll> [target session, default 1] [--verify]");
        return 1;
    }
    const DWORD session = argc >= 3 ? std::stoul(argv[2]) : 1;
    Vmm vmm;
    vmm.open(argv[1]);
    const auto [build, revision] = vmm.version();
    std::printf("Target Windows: %lu.%lu\n", build, revision);
    const auto candidate = resolve(vmm, session, true);
    const auto [reader, address] = candidate;
    const uint64_t oldExport = vmm.exportAddress(vmm.handle, reader, "win32kbase.sys", "gafAsyncKeyState");
    std::printf("Legacy export: 0x%llx\n", oldExport);
    std::printf("Candidate 0x%llx: complete 64-byte read; input unverified.\n", address);
    if (argc != 4) return 0;
    bool ok = phase(vmm, reader, address, "Idle on both PCs.", 0);
    ok &= phase(vmm, reader, address, "Tap E twice on the main keyboard, holding briefly each time.", 'E');
    ok &= phase(vmm, reader, address, "Tap W twice on the main keyboard, holding briefly each time.", 'W');
    ok &= phase(vmm, reader, address, "Move and click the main PC mouse repeatedly.", 0);
    ok &= phase(vmm, reader, address, "Tap E twice on the second PC keyboard, holding briefly each time.", 0, true);
    std::puts(ok ? "Observed the expected aggregate keyboard edges. Physical device identity remains unavailable."
                 : "Candidate failed controlled input verification.");
    return ok ? 0 : 3;
} catch (const std::exception& error) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", error.what());
    return 2;
}

```

`tools/keyprobe.cpp`:

```cpp
// keyprobe.cpp - standalone DMA keyboard locator/verifier for gafAsyncKeyState.
// Ground truth comes from the MAKCU/box (km.left/right/middle). Symbol independent.
//
// Build: tools\build_keyprobe.bat   (produces tools\keyprobe.exe)
// Usage: keyprobe.exe [probe|scan|scanall|env|ekey|find] [--dll DIR] [--port COM3] [--module win32kbase.sys] [--ctx N]
//   find   = automatic read-only discriminator: idle-stability vs. box pulses (no human needed)
//   phases = human-guided read-only E/W test (beeps): counts beeps 1..6 = idle/E/release/W/release/move
//   e      = SUPER SIMPLE: only key E by sound - HIGH beep = press+HOLD E, LOW beep = release (3 rounds)
//   e2     = 1 sound, then tap E quickly several times; matches "2 values + many changes" (no human timing)
//   burst  = AUTOMATIC: box toggles LMB/RMB/MMB; pattern+geometry finds array base & layout (no human at all)
//   chain  = follow our session-slot fallback chain (csrss -> win32ksgd/win32k +0x3110) and burst a window there
//
// The DMA card + COM port must be free (no Ickza.exe / MemProcFS running).
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 4200 4201 4324)
#include <vmmdll.h>
#pragma warning(pop)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ logging
static FILE* gLog = nullptr;
static void lg(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char b[2048];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    _vsnprintf_s(b, sizeof b, _TRUNCATE, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    std::printf("%s\n", b);
    std::fflush(stdout);
    if (gLog) {
        std::fprintf(gLog, "%s\n", b);
        std::fflush(gLog);
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ vmm.dll
#define FN(ret, name, ...) typedef ret(*Pfn_##name)(__VA_ARGS__); static Pfn_##name g##name = nullptr;
FN(VMM_HANDLE, VMMDLL_Initialize, DWORD, LPCSTR*)
FN(VOID, VMMDLL_Close, VMM_HANDLE)
FN(VOID, VMMDLL_MemFree, PVOID)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_MemReadEx, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, ULONG64, PBYTE, DWORD, PDWORD, ULONG64)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_PidList, VMM_HANDLE, PDWORD, PSIZE_T)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, PVMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION, PSIZE_T)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll, VMM_HANDLE, PVMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION*, PDWORD)
FN(QWORD, VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, LPCSTR)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, LPCSTR, PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY*, DWORD)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULE*, DWORD)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, LPCSTR, PVMMDLL_MAP_EAT*)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_PdbLoad, VMM_HANDLE, DWORD, ULONG64, LPSTR)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress, VMM_HANDLE, LPCSTR, LPCSTR, PQWORD)
FN(BOOL, VMMDLL_ConfigGet, VMM_HANDLE, ULONG64, PULONG64)
#undef FN

// merge the loaded pointers into the API names used below (header declares them as functions,
// so a same-named variable would clash - these macros redirect every call site to the pointer)
#define VMMDLL_Initialize gVMMDLL_Initialize
#define VMMDLL_Close gVMMDLL_Close
#define VMMDLL_MemFree gVMMDLL_MemFree
#define VMMDLL_MemReadEx gVMMDLL_MemReadEx
#define VMMDLL_PidList gVMMDLL_PidList
#define VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation gVMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation
#define VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll gVMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll
#define VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU gVMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU
#define VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU gVMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU
#define VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU gVMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU
#define VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU gVMMDLL_Map_GetEATU
#define VMMDLL_PdbLoad gVMMDLL_PdbLoad
#define VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress gVMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress
#define VMMDLL_ConfigGet gVMMDLL_ConfigGet

static HMODULE gDll = nullptr;
static VMM_HANDLE gVmm = nullptr;

static bool loadVmm(const std::string& dir) {
    const char* cands[] = {"\\vmm.dll", "\\dma\\vmm.dll"};
    std::string tried;
    for (const char* c : cands) {
        std::string p = dir + c;
        if (GetFileAttributesA(p.c_str()) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
            tried += p + " ";
            continue;
        }
        gDll = LoadLibraryExA(p.c_str(), nullptr, LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH);
        if (gDll) {
            lg("[ok] loaded %s", p.c_str());
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!gDll) gDll = LoadLibraryA("vmm.dll");
    if (!gDll) {
        lg("[!!] vmm.dll not found (tried %s)", tried.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    auto sym = [&](const char* n) { return reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(gDll, n)); };
    VMMDLL_Initialize = (Pfn_VMMDLL_Initialize)sym("VMMDLL_Initialize");
    VMMDLL_Close = (Pfn_VMMDLL_Close)sym("VMMDLL_Close");
    VMMDLL_MemFree = (Pfn_VMMDLL_MemFree)sym("VMMDLL_MemFree");
    VMMDLL_MemReadEx = (Pfn_VMMDLL_MemReadEx)sym("VMMDLL_MemReadEx");
    VMMDLL_PidList = (Pfn_VMMDLL_PidList)sym("VMMDLL_PidList");
    VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation = (Pfn_VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation)sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation");
    VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll = (Pfn_VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll)sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll");
    VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU = (Pfn_VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU)sym("VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU");
    VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU = (Pfn_VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU)sym("VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU");
    VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU = (Pfn_VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU)sym("VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleU");
    VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU = (Pfn_VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU)sym("VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU");
    VMMDLL_PdbLoad = (Pfn_VMMDLL_PdbLoad)sym("VMMDLL_PdbLoad");
    VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress = (Pfn_VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress)sym("VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress");
    VMMDLL_ConfigGet = (Pfn_VMMDLL_ConfigGet)sym("VMMDLL_ConfigGet");
    if (!VMMDLL_Initialize || !VMMDLL_MemReadEx || !VMMDLL_PidList) {
        lg("[!!] vmm.dll missing required exports");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ memory
static const ULONG64 FL = VMMDLL_FLAG_NOCACHE;

static bool rd(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 va, void* out, DWORD cb, bool zeropad = false) {
    DWORD got = 0;
    ULONG64 f = FL | (zeropad ? VMMDLL_FLAG_ZEROPAD_ON_FAIL : 0);
    return VMMDLL_MemReadEx(gVmm, ctx, va, (PBYTE)out, cb, &got, f) && got == cb;
}
static std::string hx(const uint8_t* p, int n) {
    std::string s;
    char b[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%02X", p[i]);
        s += b;
    }
    return s;
}
static uint64_t modBase(DWORD ctx, const char* name) {
    if (!VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU) return 0;
    return VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU(gVmm, ctx, name);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ serial (MAKCU)
class Serial {
public:
    HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    bool open(const char* port) {
        std::string p = "\\\\.\\" + std::string(port);
        h = CreateFileA(p.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            lg("[!!] can't open %s (err %lu) - is the box in use?", p.c_str(), GetLastError());
            return false;
        }
        DCB dcb{};
        dcb.DCBlength = sizeof dcb;
        if (!GetCommState(h, &dcb)) return false;
        dcb.BaudRate = 115200;
        dcb.ByteSize = 8;
        dcb.Parity = NOPARITY;
        dcb.StopBits = ONESTOPBIT;
        dcb.fBinary = TRUE;
        dcb.fDtrControl = DTR_CONTROL_ENABLE;
        dcb.fRtsControl = RTS_CONTROL_ENABLE;
        SetCommState(h, &dcb);
        COMMTIMEOUTS to{};
        to.ReadIntervalTimeout = 10;
        to.ReadTotalTimeoutConstant = 40;
        to.WriteTotalTimeoutConstant = 60;
        SetCommTimeouts(h, &to);
        PurgeComm(h, PURGE_RXCLEAR | PURGE_TXCLEAR);
        return true;
    }
    void send(const char* s) {
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
        DWORD w = 0;
        WriteFile(h, s, (DWORD)std::strlen(s), &w, nullptr);
    }
    std::string drain() {
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return {};
        std::string out;
        char b[512];
        DWORD r = 0;
        while (ReadFile(h, b, sizeof b, &r, nullptr) && r) out.append(b, r);
        return out;
    }
    void close() {
        if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            send("km.left(0)\r\n");            // never leave a button hanging
            Sleep(70);
            send("km.left(0)\r\n");
            Sleep(70);
            CloseHandle(h);
            h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
        }
    }
};
static Serial gBox;

static const int DWELL = 150;  // ms after each box command (>=90ms avoids stale reads)

// ground-truth capture: 128 bytes at ctx:va for each phase
struct Samples {
    std::vector<uint8_t> idle, lmb, rmbb, mmbb, idle2;
    bool ok = false;
};
static bool grab(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 va, size_t n, Samples& s) {
    s.idle.assign(n, 0);
    s.lmb.assign(n, 0);
    s.rmbb.assign(n, 0);
    s.mmbb.assign(n, 0);
    s.idle2.assign(n, 0);
    if (!rd(ctx, va, s.idle.data(), (DWORD)n, true)) return false;
    gBox.send("km.left(1)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    rd(ctx, va, s.lmb.data(), (DWORD)n, true);
    gBox.send("km.left(0)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    rd(ctx, va, s.idle2.data(), (DWORD)n, true);
    gBox.send("km.right(1)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    rd(ctx, va, s.rmbb.data(), (DWORD)n, true);
    gBox.send("km.right(0)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    gBox.send("km.middle(1)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    rd(ctx, va, s.mmbb.data(), (DWORD)n, true);
    gBox.send("km.middle(0)\r\n");
    Sleep(DWELL);
    return true;
}
static inline int bit(const std::vector<uint8_t>& v, int o, int b) { return (v[o] >> b) & 1; }
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ PE export + pdb
static bool eatRva(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 base, const char* want, ULONG64& rva) {
    uint8_t dos[0x40];
    if (!rd(ctx, base, dos, sizeof dos)) return false;
    if (dos[0] != 'M' || dos[1] != 'Z') return false;
    uint32_t pe = 0;
    std::memcpy(&pe, dos + 0x3C, 4);
    if (pe < 0x40 || pe > 0x1000) return false;
    uint8_t nt[0x110];
    if (!rd(ctx, base + pe, nt, sizeof nt)) return false;
    if (nt[0] != 'P' || nt[1] != 'E') return false;
    uint32_t expRva = 0, expSz = 0;
    std::memcpy(&expRva, nt + 0x88, 4);
    std::memcpy(&expSz, nt + 0x8C, 4);
    if (!expRva || expRva > 0x100000) return false;
    uint8_t ed[0x28];
    if (!rd(ctx, base + expRva, ed, sizeof ed)) return false;
    uint32_t nNames = 0, aFuncs = 0, aNames = 0, aOrds = 0;
    std::memcpy(&nNames, ed + 0x18, 4);
    std::memcpy(&aFuncs, ed + 0x1C, 4);
    std::memcpy(&aNames, ed + 0x20, 4);
    std::memcpy(&aOrds, ed + 0x24, 4);
    if (!nNames || nNames > 0x20000) return false;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nNames; ++i) {
        uint32_t nr = 0;
        if (!rd(ctx, base + aNames + i * 4, &nr, 4)) continue;
        char nm[128] = {};
        rd(ctx, base + nr, nm, sizeof nm - 1);
        if (std::strstr(nm, want)) {
            uint16_t ord = 0;
            if (!rd(ctx, base + aOrds + i * 2, &ord, 2)) continue;
            uint32_t fr = 0;
            if (!rd(ctx, base + aFuncs + ord * 4, &fr, 4)) continue;
            rva = fr;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
static bool pdbRva(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 base, const char* sym, ULONG64& rva, std::string& mod) {
    if (!VMMDLL_PdbLoad || !VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress) return false;
    char m[MAX_PATH] = {};
    if (!VMMDLL_PdbLoad(gVmm, ctx, base, m)) return false;
    QWORD va = 0;
    if (!VMMDLL_PdbSymbolAddress(gVmm, m, sym, &va) || va <= base) return false;
    mod = m;
    rva = va - base;
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ image + layouts
struct Layout {
    const char* name;
    int o1, b1, o2, b2, o4, b4;  // relative (byte,bit) for VK_LBUTTON(1), VK_RBUTTON(2), VK_MBUTTON(4)
    const char* map;             // human formula
};
static const Layout LAY[] = {
    {"twoBitLow", 0, 2, 0, 4, 1, 0, "byte=(vk*2)/8 bit=(vk%4)*2   [win32k gafAsyncKeyState]"},
    {"twoBitHigh", 0, 3, 0, 5, 1, 1, "byte=(vk*2)/8 bit=(vk%4)*2+1"},
    {"oneBit", 0, 1, 0, 2, 0, 4, "byte=vk/8 bit=vk%8 (1 bit/key)"},
    {"perKeyHi", 1, 7, 2, 7, 4, 7, "byte=vk bit=7 (0x80, 1 byte/key)"},
    {"perKeyLo", 1, 0, 2, 0, 4, 0, "byte=vk bit=0"},
    {"stride2Hi", 2, 7, 4, 7, 8, 7, "byte=vk*2 bit=7"},
    {"perByteBit", 1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 4, "byte=vk bit=vk%8"},
};

// vk -> (byte,bit) formulas per layout hypothesis (used to identify the layout from 2 pressed keys)
static int f_twoBitByte(int vk) { return vk / 4; }
static int f_twoBitBit(int vk) { return (vk % 4) * 2; }
static int f_twoBitHiBit(int vk) { return (vk % 4) * 2 + 1; }
static int f_oneBitByte(int vk) { return vk / 8; }
static int f_oneBitBit(int vk) { return vk % 8; }
static int f_perKeyByte(int vk) { return vk; }
static int f_stride2Byte(int vk) { return vk * 2; }
static int f_seven(int) { return 7; }
static int f_zero(int) { return 0; }
static int f_perByteBit(int vk) { return vk % 8; }

struct LayoutF {
    const char* name;
    int (*bytefn)(int);
    int (*bitfn)(int);
    const char* map;
};
static const LayoutF LAYF[] = {
    {"twoBitLow", f_twoBitByte, f_twoBitBit, "byte=(vk*2)/8 bit=(vk%4)*2"},
    {"twoBitHigh", f_twoBitByte, f_twoBitHiBit, "byte=(vk*2)/8 bit=(vk%4)*2+1"},
    {"oneBit", f_oneBitByte, f_oneBitBit, "byte=vk/8 bit=vk%8"},
    {"perKeyHi", f_perKeyByte, f_seven, "byte=vk bit=7 (0x80/byte)"},
    {"perKeyLo", f_perKeyByte, f_zero, "byte=vk bit=0"},
    {"stride2Hi", f_stride2Byte, f_seven, "byte=vk*2 bit=7"},
    {"perByteBit", f_perKeyByte, f_perByteBit, "byte=vk bit=vk%8"},
};

static bool readImg(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 base, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    out.assign(size, 0);
    bool any = false;
    for (size_t o = 0; o < size; o += 0x8000) {
        DWORD n = (DWORD)std::min<size_t>(0x8000, size - o);
        DWORD got = 0;
        if (VMMDLL_MemReadEx(gVmm, ctx, base + o, out.data() + o, n, &got, FL) && got) any = true;
    }
    return any;
}

// differential scan of a whole image; finds offsets where a box pulse is tracked 1:1
static bool scanImage(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 base, size_t size, const char* tag) {
    lg("scan %s ctx=0x%lX base=0x%llX size=0x%zX ...", tag, (unsigned long)ctx, (unsigned long long)base, size);
    std::vector<uint8_t> A, B, C, D, E;
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, A)) { lg("  read failed"); return false; }
    gBox.send("km.left(1)\r\n");   Sleep(DWELL); readImg(ctx, base, size, B);
    gBox.send("km.left(0)\r\n");   Sleep(DWELL); readImg(ctx, base, size, C);
    gBox.send("km.right(1)\r\n");  Sleep(DWELL); readImg(ctx, base, size, D);
    gBox.send("km.right(0)\r\n");  Sleep(DWELL);
    gBox.send("km.middle(1)\r\n"); Sleep(DWELL); readImg(ctx, base, size, E);
    gBox.send("km.middle(0)\r\n"); Sleep(DWELL);

    {  // coverage: prove the big reads are real (not mostly zeros)
        size_t nzA = 0, dAB = 0, dAC = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (A[i]) ++nzA;
            if (A[i] != B[i]) ++dAB;
            if (A[i] != C[i]) ++dAC;
        }
        lg("  coverage nzA=%zu/%zu diffAB=%zu diffAC=%zu", nzA, size, dAB, dAC);
    }
    {  // every byte that changed with any pulse (idle=A, LMB=B, idle=C, RMB=D, MMB=E)
        int shown = 0;
        size_t firstOff = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (A[i] == B[i] && A[i] == C[i] && A[i] == D[i] && A[i] == E[i]) continue;
            if (!shown) firstOff = i;
            if (shown < 200) lg("  D %06zX A=%02X LMB=%02X idle2=%02X RMB=%02X MMB=%02X", i, A[i], B[i], C[i], D[i], E[i]);
            ++shown;
        }
        lg("  changed bytes total=%d (first off 0x%zX)", shown, firstOff);
        if (shown) {
            size_t lo = firstOff > 32 ? firstOff - 32 : 0;
            lg("  context A @0x%zX: %s", lo, hx(A.data() + lo, 96).c_str());
            lg("  context B @0x%zX: %s", lo, hx(B.data() + lo, 96).c_str());
        }
    }
    {  // layout-free: bytes with a bit tracking LMB(0-1-0) + RMB(0-1) + MMB(0-1) in one byte
        int shown = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size && shown < 30; ++i) {
            int lb = -1, rb = -1, mb = -1, nlb = 0, nrb = 0, nmb = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b) {
                if (!bit(A, (int)i, b) && bit(B, (int)i, b) && !bit(C, (int)i, b)) { lb = b; ++nlb; }
                if (!bit(A, (int)i, b) && bit(D, (int)i, b)) { rb = b; ++nrb; }
                if (!bit(A, (int)i, b) && bit(E, (int)i, b)) { mb = b; ++nmb; }
            }
            if (nlb && nrb && nmb) {
                lg("  RAW off=0x%zX LMBbit=%d(n%d) RMBbit=%d(n%d) MMBbit=%d(n%d)", i, lb, nlb, rb, nrb, mb, nmb);
                ++shown;
            }
        }
    }

    struct Hit { size_t off; int lay; };
    std::vector<Hit> hits;
    for (size_t o = 0; o + 16 < size; ++o) {
        for (int li = 0; li < (int)(sizeof LAY / sizeof LAY[0]); ++li) {
            const Layout& L = LAY[li];
            size_t p1 = o + L.o1, p2 = o + L.o2, p4 = o + L.o4;
            if (p4 >= size) continue;
            if (!bit(A, (int)p1, L.b1) && bit(B, (int)p1, L.b1) && !bit(C, (int)p1, L.b1) &&
                !bit(A, (int)p2, L.b2) && bit(D, (int)p2, L.b2) && !bit(A, (int)p4, L.b4) && bit(E, (int)p4, L.b4)) {
                hits.push_back({o, li});
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    lg("  raw hits=%zu", hits.size());
    bool confirmed = false;
    int lim = (int)std::min<size_t>(hits.size(), 8);
    for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
        const Layout& L = LAY[hits[i].lay];
        ULONG64 va = base + hits[i].off;
        Samples s;
        if (!grab(ctx, va, 32, s)) { lg("  hit va=0x%llX unreadable", (unsigned long long)va); continue; }
        // confirm the exact triples once more (fresh pattern)
        bool ok1 = !bit(s.idle, L.o1, L.b1) && bit(s.lmb, L.o1, L.b1) && !bit(s.idle2, L.o1, L.b1);
        bool ok2 = !bit(s.idle, L.o2, L.b2) && bit(s.rmbb, L.o2, L.b2);
        bool ok4 = !bit(s.idle, L.o4, L.b4) && bit(s.mmbb, L.o4, L.b4);
        if (ok1 && ok2 && ok4) confirmed = true;
        lg("  %s %-10s array=0x%llX (off 0x%zX) confirm=%d%d%d :: %s", (ok1 && ok2 && ok4) ? "CONFIRM" : "reject ", L.name,
           (unsigned long long)va, hits[i].off, ok1 ? 1 : 0, ok2 ? 1 : 0, ok4 ? 1 : 0, L.map);
        if (ok1) lg("      idle=%s", hx(s.idle.data(), 16).c_str());
    }
    if (hits.empty()) lg("  no layout match found");
    return confirmed;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ processes / ctxs
struct Proc {
    DWORD pid;
    std::string name;
    DWORD session;
};
static std::vector<Proc> enumProcs() {
    std::vector<Proc> out;
    if (VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll) {
        PVMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION all = nullptr;
        DWORD n = 0;
        if (VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformationAll(gVmm, &all, &n) && all && n) {
            for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; ++i) out.push_back({all[i].dwPID, all[i].szName, all[i].win.dwSessionId});
            VMMDLL_MemFree(all);
            return out;
        }
    }
    SIZE_T n = 0;
    if (!VMMDLL_PidList(gVmm, nullptr, &n) || !n) return out;
    std::vector<DWORD> pids(n);
    SIZE_T n2 = n;
    if (!VMMDLL_PidList(gVmm, pids.data(), &n2)) return out;
    pids.resize(n2);
    for (DWORD p : pids) {
        VMMDLL_PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
        SIZE_T cb = sizeof pi;
        if (VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation && VMMDLL_ProcessGetInformation(gVmm, p, &pi, &cb) && pi.szName[0]) {
            out.push_back({p, pi.szName, pi.win.dwSessionId});
        } else {
            out.push_back({p, "?", 0});
        }
    }
    return out;
}
static bool interesting(const std::string& n) { return n == "csrss.exe" || n == "winlogon.exe" || n == "DayZ_x64.exe" || n == "System"; }

static void testCandidate(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 va, const char* tag) {
    Samples s;
    if (!grab(ctx, va, 128, s)) {
        lg("  %-28s ctx=0x%-4lX va=0x%llX  UNREADABLE", tag, (unsigned long)ctx, (unsigned long long)va);
        return;
    }
    std::string lmb, rmb, mmb;
    for (int o = 0; o < 128; ++o)
        for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b) {
            char t[24];
            if (!bit(s.idle, o, b) && bit(s.lmb, o, b) && !bit(s.idle2, o, b)) {
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "b%d.%d ", o, b);
                lmb += t;
            }
            if (!bit(s.idle, o, b) && bit(s.rmbb, o, b)) {
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "b%d.%d ", o, b);
                rmb += t;
            }
            if (!bit(s.idle, o, b) && bit(s.mmbb, o, b)) {
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "b%d.%d ", o, b);
                mmb += t;
            }
        }
    lg("  %-28s ctx=0x%-4lX va=0x%llX  LMB[%s] RMB[%s] MMB[%s]", tag, (unsigned long)ctx, (unsigned long long)va, lmb.c_str(), rmb.c_str(),
       mmb.c_str());
    if (!lmb.empty()) lg("      idle=%s", hx(s.idle.data(), 32).c_str());
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ session space probe
static void sessionProbe(const std::vector<Proc>& procs) {
    lg("--- session-space readability (8-byte probes) ---");
    const ULONG64 addrs[] = {0xFFFFF90000000000ull, 0xFFFFF90000001000ull, 0xFFFFF90080000000ull, 0xFFFFF90080001000ull,
                             0xFFFFF98000000000ull, 0xFFFFF98000001000ull, 0xFFFFF98080000000ull, 0xFFFFF98080001000ull,
                             0xFFFFF97FFFFF0000ull, 0xFFFFFA8000000000ull};
    std::vector<DWORD> ctxs = {4};
    for (const auto& p : procs)
        if (interesting(p.name)) ctxs.push_back(p.pid);
    for (DWORD c : ctxs) {
        std::string line;
        for (ULONG64 a : addrs) {
            uint8_t b[8] = {};
            char t[40];
            if (rd(c, a, b, 8))
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, " %llX=%s", (unsigned long long)a, hx(b, 4).c_str());
            else
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, " %llX=-", (unsigned long long)a);
            line += t;
        }
        lg("  ctx=0x%lX%s", (unsigned long)c, line.c_str());
    }
}

static std::vector<DWORD> buildCtxs(const std::vector<Proc>& procs) {
    std::vector<DWORD> v;
    auto add = [&](DWORD x) {
        if (std::find(v.begin(), v.end(), x) == v.end()) v.push_back(x);
    };
    add(4);
    add(4 | VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY);
    for (const auto& p : procs)
        if (interesting(p.name)) {
            add(p.pid);
            add(p.pid | VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY);
        }
    return v;
}

static std::string exeDir() {
    char b[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, b, MAX_PATH);
    std::string s = b;
    return s.substr(0, s.find_last_of("\\/"));
}

static void doProbe(const std::vector<Proc>& procs, bool pulses) {
    ULONG64 v = 0;
    if (VMMDLL_ConfigGet) {
        if (VMMDLL_ConfigGet(gVmm, VMMDLL_OPT_WIN_VERSION_BUILD, &v)) lg("target windows build: %llu", v);
        if (VMMDLL_ConfigGet(gVmm, VMMDLL_OPT_CONFIG_VMM_VERSION_MAJOR, &v)) lg("vmm version: %llu", v);
    }
    lg("--- interesting processes (pid session name) ---");
    for (const auto& p : procs)
        if (interesting(p.name)) lg("  pid=0x%-6lX session=%-3lu %s", (unsigned long)p.pid, (unsigned long)p.session, p.name.c_str());
    sessionProbe(procs);

    const char* mods[] = {"win32kbase.sys", "win32kfull.sys", "win32k.sys", "win32ksgd.sys"};
    lg("--- win32k* module bases per ctx (MZ present?) ---");
    std::vector<DWORD> ctxs = buildCtxs(procs);
    for (DWORD c : ctxs) {
        for (const char* m : mods) {
            uint64_t b = modBase(c, m);
            if (!b) continue;
            uint16_t mz = 0;
            bool ok = rd(c, b, &mz, 2);
            lg("  ctx=0x%-9lX %-14s base=0x%llX read=%d mz=%04X", (unsigned long)c, m, (unsigned long long)b, ok ? 1 : 0, mz);
        }
    }

    lg("--- rva resolution via PDB + export (ctx 4) ---");
    uint64_t rvaKb = 0, rvaKf = 0;
    const ULONG64 baseKb = modBase(4, "win32kbase.sys"), baseKf = modBase(4, "win32kfull.sys");
    if (!pulses) return;
    std::string mod;
    if (baseKb) {
        if (pdbRva(4, baseKb, "gafAsyncKeyState", rvaKb, mod)) lg("  PDB win32kbase(%s) gafAsyncKeyState rva=0x%llX va=0x%llX", mod.c_str(), rvaKb, baseKb + rvaKb);
        else lg("  PDB win32kbase resolve FAILED");
        uint64_t e = 0;
        if (eatRva(4, baseKb, "gafAsyncKeyState", e)) lg("  EAT win32kbase(own parser) rva=0x%llX va=0x%llX", e, baseKb + e);
        else lg("  EAT win32kbase(own parser) FAILED");
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU) {
            PVMMDLL_MAP_EAT eat = nullptr;
            if (VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU(gVmm, 4, "win32kbase.sys", &eat) && eat) {
                lg("  VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU win32kbase: cMap=%lu names=%lu funcs=%lu vaBase=0x%llX", eat->cMap, eat->cNumberOfNames,
                   eat->cNumberOfFunctions, eat->vaModuleBase);
                VMMDLL_MemFree(eat);
            } else lg("  VMMDLL_Map_GetEATU win32kbase FAILED");
        }
    }
    if (baseKf && pdbRva(4, baseKf, "gafAsyncKeyState", rvaKf, mod)) lg("  PDB win32kfull(%s) rva=0x%llX va=0x%llX", mod.c_str(), rvaKf, baseKf + rvaKf);

    lg("--- ground-truth candidate tests (box pulses on the MAIN pc) ---");
    for (DWORD c : ctxs) {
        uint64_t b = modBase(c, "win32kbase.sys");
        if (b && rvaKb) testCandidate(c, b + rvaKb, "win32kbase+pdb");
        b = modBase(c, "win32kfull.sys");
        if (b && rvaKf) testCandidate(c, b + rvaKf, "win32kfull+pdb");
    }
    testCandidate(4, baseKb + 0x2AE7CD, "win32kbase+0x2AE7CD");
    testCandidate(4, baseKb + 0x2AE2D0, "win32kbase+0x2AE2D0");
}

static bool scanOne(DWORD ctx, const char* module) {
    uint64_t base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) { lg("scan %s ctx=0x%lX: no base", module, (unsigned long)ctx); return false; }
    uint32_t size = 0x400000;
    if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
            if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
            VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
        }
    }
    return scanImage(ctx, base, size, module);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ read-only key-signature search (no box input)
struct Bitc {
    size_t off;
    int bit;
};

static std::vector<Bitc> pressBits(DWORD ctx, ULONG64 base, size_t size, int vk, int rounds) {
    std::unordered_map<size_t, uint8_t> acc;
    bool first = true;
    for (int r = 0; r < rounds; ++r) {
        lg("  Runde %d/%d  Taste 0x%02X: 1 PIEB = DRUECKEN und HALTEN, 2 PIEPS = LOSLASSEN", r + 1, rounds, vk);
        MessageBeep(MB_ICONASTERISK);
        Beep(1100, 300);
        Sleep(1200);
        std::vector<uint8_t> H1, H2, R1, R2;
        readImg(ctx, base, size, H1);
        readImg(ctx, base, size, H2);
        MessageBeep(MB_ICONHAND);
        Beep(650, 130);
        Beep(650, 130);
        Sleep(1200);
        readImg(ctx, base, size, R1);
        readImg(ctx, base, size, R2);
        if (first) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                uint8_t m = H1[i] & H2[i] & ~R1[i] & ~R2[i];
                if (m) acc[i] = m;
            }
            first = false;
        } else {
            for (auto it = acc.begin(); it != acc.end();) {
                uint8_t m = H1[it->first] & H2[it->first] & ~R1[it->first] & ~R2[it->first];
                it->second &= m;
                if (!it->second)
                    it = acc.erase(it);
                else
                    ++it;
            }
        }
        lg("    Runde %d: %zu Kandidatenbytes uebrig", r + 1, acc.size());
        if (acc.empty()) break;
    }
    std::vector<Bitc> out;
    for (auto& kv : acc)
        for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b)
            if (kv.second & (1u << b)) out.push_back({kv.first, b});
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const Bitc& a, const Bitc& b) { return a.off < b.off || (a.off == b.off && a.bit < b.bit); });
    return out;
}

static void doEKey(DWORD ctx, const char* module, int k1, int k2, int rounds) {
    uint64_t base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) {
        lg("ekey: kein Base fuer %s in ctx 0x%lX", module, (unsigned long)ctx);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t size = 0x400000;
    if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
            if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
            VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
        }
    }
    lg("=== EKEY read-only: ctx=0x%lX %s base=0x%llX size=0x%X  (NUR auslesen, kein Box-Input) ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module,
       (unsigned long long)base, size);
    lg("=== Du drueckst nur Tasten am Main-PC: 1 PIEB = DRUECKEN+HALTEN, 2 PIEPS = LOSLASSEN ===");

    auto b1 = pressBits(ctx, base, size, k1, rounds);
    lg("  Taste 0x%02X: %zu stabile Bit(s)", k1, b1.size());
    for (const auto& c : b1) lg("    off=0x%zX bit=%d va=0x%llX", c.off, c.bit, (unsigned long long)(base + c.off));

    auto b2 = pressBits(ctx, base, size, k2, rounds);
    lg("  Taste 0x%02X: %zu stabile Bit(s)", k2, b2.size());
    for (const auto& c : b2) lg("    off=0x%zX bit=%d va=0x%llX", c.off, c.bit, (unsigned long long)(base + c.off));

    bool any = false;
    for (const auto& L : LAYF) {
        for (const auto& e : b1) {
            if (e.bit != L.bitfn(k1)) continue;
            int64_t x = (int64_t)e.off - L.bytefn(k1);
            int64_t wOff = x + L.bytefn(k2);
            int wBit = L.bitfn(k2);
            for (const auto& w : b2)
                if ((int64_t)w.off == wOff && w.bit == wBit) {
                    lg("MATCH layout=%s  arrayBase=0x%llX  ctx=0x%lX  module=%s  :: %s", L.name, (unsigned long long)(base + x),
                       (unsigned long)ctx, module, L.map);
                    lg("   -> E(0x45) va=0x%llX bit=%d   W(0x57) va=0x%llX bit=%d", (unsigned long long)(base + x + L.bytefn(0x45)),
                       L.bitfn(0x45), (unsigned long long)(base + x + L.bytefn(0x57)), L.bitfn(0x57));
                    any = true;
                }
        }
    }
    if (!any) lg("KEIN Layout-Match - Kandidaten oben pruefen");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ automatic finder (read-only + box pulses)
// Discriminates counters/timers (unstable while idle) from a key bitmap (stable while idle, reacts to a press).
// Ground truth = MAKCU pulses on the MAIN pc -> no human needed. Read-only: only VMMDLL_MemReadEx.
static void doFind(DWORD ctx, const char* module) {
    const ULONG64 base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) { lg("find: no base for %s in ctx 0x%lX", module, (unsigned long)ctx); return; }
    uint32_t size = 0x400000;
    if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
            if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
            VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
        }
    }
    lg("=== FIND read-only: ctx=0x%lX %s base=0x%llX size=0x%X ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module, (unsigned long long)base, size);
    std::vector<uint8_t> A, B;
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, A)) { lg("read A failed"); return; }
    Sleep(250);
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, B)) { lg("read B failed"); return; }
    std::vector<uint8_t> stable(size);
    size_t nUn = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        stable[i] = A[i] == B[i];
        if (!stable[i]) ++nUn;
    }
    lg("idle-stability: %zu of %zu bytes stable, %zu unstable (counters/timers/timestamps)", size - nUn, size, nUn);
    {
        std::string s;
        size_t shown = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size && shown < 24; ++i)
            if (!stable[i]) {
                char t[24];
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%zX ", i);
                s += t;
                ++shown;
            }
        lg("  first unstable offsets: %s", s.c_str());
    }

    struct Hit {
        size_t off;
        uint8_t mask;
        bool reverts;
    };
    static const char* pcmd[3] = {"km.left", "km.right", "km.middle"};
    static const char* pname[3] = {"LMB", "RMB", "MMB"};
    std::vector<Hit> hits[3];
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; ++p) {
        char down[32], up[32];
        std::snprintf(down, sizeof down, "%s(1)\r\n", pcmd[p]);
        std::snprintf(up, sizeof up, "%s(0)\r\n", pcmd[p]);
        gBox.send(down);
        Sleep(DWELL);
        std::vector<uint8_t> P;
        if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, P)) { lg("read P(%s) failed", pname[p]); continue; }
        gBox.send(up);
        Sleep(DWELL * 2);
        std::vector<uint8_t> R;
        if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, R)) { lg("read R(%s) failed", pname[p]); continue; }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (!stable[i]) continue;  // counters are excluded by definition
            const uint8_t d = (uint8_t)(B[i] ^ P[i]);
            if (d) hits[p].push_back({i, d, R[i] == B[i]});
        }
        std::string s;
        size_t rev = 0;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < hits[p].size(); ++k) {
            if (hits[p][k].reverts) ++rev;
            if (k < 16) {
                char t[40];
                std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%zX:%02X>%02X%s ", hits[p][k].off, B[hits[p][k].off], (uint8_t)(B[hits[p][k].off] ^ hits[p][k].mask),
                              hits[p][k].reverts ? "(rev)" : "");
                s += t;
            }
        }
        lg("%s: %zu stable bytes changed, %zu revert -> %s", pname[p], hits[p].size(), rev, s.c_str());
    }

    bool any = false;
    for (const Layout& L : LAY) {
        const int off[3] = {L.o1, L.o2, L.o4};
        const int bts[3] = {L.b1, L.b2, L.b4};
        for (const Hit& h1 : hits[0]) {
            if (!(h1.mask & (1u << bts[0]))) continue;
            const int64_t delta = (int64_t)h1.off - off[0];
            bool ok = true;
            for (int p = 1; p < 3 && ok; ++p) {
                bool found = false;
                for (const Hit& h : hits[p])
                    if ((int64_t)h.off - off[p] == delta && (h.mask & (1u << bts[p]))) { found = true; break; }
                if (!found) ok = false;
            }
            if (ok) {
                lg("MATCH layout=%s arrayBase=0x%llX ctx=0x%lX %s | %s", L.name, (unsigned long long)(base + delta), (unsigned long)ctx, module, L.map);
                any = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!any) lg("no layout match from LMB/RMB/MMB on stable bytes");

    ULONG64 rva = 0;
    std::string mod;
    if (pdbRva(ctx, base, "gafAsyncKeyState", rva, mod)) {
        Samples s;
        if (grab(ctx, base + rva, 192, s)) {
            int n = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 192; ++i)
                if (s.idle[i] != s.lmb[i] || s.idle[i] != s.rmbb[i] || s.idle[i] != s.mmbb[i]) {
                    lg("  pdb-window off=0x%zX idle=%02X lmb=%02X rmb=%02X mmb=%02X", i, s.idle[i], s.lmb[i], s.rmbb[i], s.mmbb[i]);
                    ++n;
                }
            lg("pdb window (base+rva, 192 bytes): %d bytes react to the pulses", n);
        }
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ human-guided read-only phases (E vs W)
// Beeps = clock: 1=idle, 2=HOLD E, 3=release, 4=HOLD W, 5=release, 6=MOVE MOUSE.
// Only offsets that change during a press phase and NOT during idle/release/move are candidates.
static void doPhases(DWORD ctx, const char* module, ULONG64 va, size_t win, int stepMs) {
    const ULONG64 base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) { lg("phases: no base for %s", module); return; }
    if (!va) {
        ULONG64 rva = 0;
        std::string mod;
        if (!pdbRva(ctx, base, "gafAsyncKeyState", rva, mod)) { lg("phases: no pdb rva and no --va"); return; }
        va = base + rva;
    }
    const ULONG64 start = (va - win / 2) & ~(ULONG64)0xF;
    lg("=== PHASES read-only (BOX untouched) ctx=0x%lX %s window=0x%llX+0x%zX step=%dms ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module,
       (unsigned long long)start, win, stepMs);
    lg("=== BEEPS ZAEHLEN: 1=idle | 2=E HALTEN | 3=loslassen | 4=W HALTEN | 5=loslassen | 6=MAUS BEWEGEN ===");
    const int nph = 6;
    const int dur[nph] = {2500, 3500, 2500, 3500, 2500, 3500};
    std::vector<uint8_t> snap(win), cur(win);
    std::vector<unsigned> phaseMask(win, 0), bitMask(win, 0);
    for (int p = 0; p < nph; ++p) {
        for (int b = 0; b <= p; ++b) {
            Beep(900, 80);
            Sleep(110);
        }
        Sleep(200);
        if (!rd(ctx, start, snap.data(), (DWORD)win, true)) { lg("phase %d read failed", p + 1); return; }
        const ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
        while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < (ULONGLONG)dur[p]) {
            if (rd(ctx, start, cur.data(), (DWORD)win, true)) {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < win; ++i) {
                    const uint8_t d = (uint8_t)(snap[i] ^ cur[i]);
                    if (d) {
                        phaseMask[i] |= (1u << p);
                        bitMask[i] |= d;
                    }
                }
            }
            Sleep(stepMs);
        }
    }
    Beep(600, 400);
    std::vector<size_t> ce, cw;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < win; ++i) {
        const unsigned m = phaseMask[i];
        if (!m) continue;
        const unsigned noise = (1u << 0) | (1u << 2) | (1u << 4) | (1u << 5);  // idle / release / mouse move
        if ((m & (1u << 1)) && !(m & noise)) ce.push_back(i);
        if ((m & (1u << 3)) && !(m & noise)) cw.push_back(i);
    }
    lg("candidates: %zu for E, %zu for W (changed only in the press phase, not in idle/release/move)", ce.size(), cw.size());
    {
        std::string s;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < ce.size() && k < 14; ++k) {
            char t[32];
            std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%zX(b%02X) ", ce[k], (unsigned)bitMask[ce[k]]);
            s += t;
        }
        lg("  E offsets: %s", s.c_str());
        s.clear();
        for (size_t k = 0; k < cw.size() && k < 14; ++k) {
            char t[32];
            std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%zX(b%02X) ", cw[k], (unsigned)bitMask[cw[k]]);
            s += t;
        }
        lg("  W offsets: %s", s.c_str());
    }
    if (ce.empty() && cw.empty()) lg("VERDICT: no reaction in this window (array not here - or the keys were not pressed)");
    for (const LayoutF& L : LAYF) {
        for (size_t a : ce) {
            if (!(bitMask[a] & (1u << L.bitfn(0x45)))) continue;
            for (size_t b : cw) {
                if (!(bitMask[b] & (1u << L.bitfn(0x57)))) continue;
                if ((int64_t)a - L.bytefn(0x45) != (int64_t)b - L.bytefn(0x57)) continue;
                const int64_t st = (int64_t)a - L.bytefn(0x45);
                lg("MATCH layout=%s arrayBase=0x%llX (%s) ctx=0x%lX %s", L.name, (unsigned long long)(start + st), L.map,
                   (unsigned long)ctx, module);
            }
        }
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ SUPER SIMPLE: find ONE key (E) by sound
// HOCH = E druecken und HALTEN | TIEF = LOSLASSEN.  Read-only, Box unberuehrt.
static void doFindE(DWORD ctx, const char* module, int rounds) {
    const ULONG64 base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) { lg("e: no base %s", module); return; }
    uint32_t size = 0x400000;
    if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
            if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
            VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
        }
    }
    lg("=== E-TEST (read-only, Box unberuehrt) ctx=0x%lX %s, %d Runden ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module, rounds);
    lg("=== ABLAUF: 8x COUNTDOWN -> je Runde: HOHER Piep = E am GAMING-PC HALTEN (Box klickt automatisch mit), TIEFER Piep = E LOSLASSEN");
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        Beep(900, 120);
        Sleep(880);
    }
    Sleep(600);
    std::vector<uint8_t> A, B;
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, A)) { lg("read A failed"); return; }
    Sleep(250);
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, B)) { lg("read B failed"); return; }
    std::vector<uint8_t> stableS(size);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) stableS[i] = A[i] == B[i];

    std::vector<uint8_t> holdSeen(size), relSeen(size), heldVal(size);
    std::vector<uint8_t> holdOK(size, 0), relOK(size, 0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> cur(size);
    const size_t kArrive = 0x2AE2D0;  // known reactive field on this target (last-input timestamp, 4 bytes)
    int arriveRounds = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < rounds; ++r) {
        std::memset(holdSeen.data(), 0, size);
        std::memset(relSeen.data(), 0, size);
        Beep(1300, 300);
        gBox.send("km.left(1)\r\n");  // box clicks too -> proves the read/input path (arrival proof)
        ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
        size_t changes = 0;
        while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < 2500) {
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur))
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                    if (stableS[i] && cur[i] != A[i]) {
                        holdSeen[i] = 1;
                        heldVal[i] = cur[i];
                        ++changes;
                    }
            Sleep(20);
        }
        size_t distinct = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) distinct += holdSeen[i] ? 1 : 0;
        bool arrived = false;
        for (size_t k = kArrive; k < kArrive + 4 && k < size; ++k)
            if (holdSeen[k]) arrived = true;
        if (arrived) ++arriveRounds;
        Beep(700, 300);
        gBox.send("km.left(0)\r\n");
        t0 = GetTickCount64();
        while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < 2500) {
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur))
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                    if (stableS[i] && cur[i] == A[i]) relSeen[i] = 1;
            Sleep(20);
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (holdSeen[i]) ++holdOK[i];
            if (relSeen[i]) ++relOK[i];
        }
        lg("Runde %d/%d: %zu Bytes reagierten beim HALTEN (%zu Messpunkte, 0 = E nicht gedrueckt)", r + 1, rounds, distinct, changes);
    }

    struct Row {
        size_t off;
        int h, r;
    };
    std::vector<Row> rows;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        if (stableS[i] && holdOK[i] > 0) rows.push_back({i, holdOK[i], relOK[i]});
    std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](const Row& a, const Row& b) { return a.h != b.h ? a.h > b.h : a.r > b.r; });
    lg("Bytes, die waehrend HALTEN reagiert haben: %zu (Top 16):", rows.size());
    for (size_t k = 0; k < rows.size() && k < 16; ++k)
        lg("  +0x%zX  halten=%d/%d loslassen=%d/%d  idle=%02X gehalten=%02X diff=%02X", rows[k].off, rows[k].h, rounds, rows[k].r, rounds,
           A[rows[k].off], heldVal[rows[k].off], (uint8_t)(A[rows[k].off] ^ heldVal[rows[k].off]));
    if (rows.empty()) lg("  -> keine Reaktion beim Halten: wurde E wirklich am GAMING-PC gedrueckt?");
    lg("INPUT-ANKUNFT am Ziel (bekanntes Reaktionsfeld +0x%zX): %d/%d Runden%s", kArrive, arriveRounds, rounds,
       arriveRounds ? "" : "   <-- deine Tasten kamen NICHT am Ziel an (Tastatur am FALSCHEN PC?)");

    const int need = rounds > 1 ? rounds - 1 : 1;  // tolerant: one missed round is ok
    size_t nCand = 0;
    int bestBit = -1, bestLayout = -1;
    size_t bestOff = 0;
    for (const Row& rw : rows) {
        if (rw.h < need || rw.r < need) continue;
        ++nCand;
        const size_t i = rw.off;
        for (size_t li = 0; li < sizeof(LAYF) / sizeof(LAYF[0]); ++li) {
            const LayoutF& L = LAYF[li];
            const int b = L.bitfn(0x45);
            if (!((heldVal[i] >> b) & 1)) continue;
            lg("MATCH layout=%s  E-Byte=+0x%zX Bit=%d  arrayBase=0x%llX  (%s)", L.name, i, b, (unsigned long long)(base + (int64_t)i - L.bytefn(0x45)),
               L.map);
            if (bestBit < 0) {
                bestBit = b;
                bestOff = i;
                bestLayout = (int)li;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!nCand) {
        lg("ERGEBNIS: E NICHT gefunden - Pieps verpasst? nochmal laufen lassen.");
        return;
    }
    if (bestBit < 0) {
        lg("ERGEBNIS: %zu Kandidaten, aber kein Layout passt zu E - Log schicken.", nCand);
        return;
    }
    lg("VALIDIERUNG: nochmal hoher/tiefer Piep ...");
    Beep(1300, 300);
    Sleep(700);
    std::vector<uint8_t> v(size);
    bool hi = false, lo = false;
    if (readImg(ctx, base, size, v)) hi = ((v[bestOff] >> bestBit) & 1) == 1;
    Beep(700, 300);
    Sleep(700);
    if (readImg(ctx, base, size, v)) lo = ((v[bestOff] >> bestBit) & 1) == 0;
    lg("ERGEBNIS: layout=%s arrayBase=0x%llX E-Byte=+0x%zX Bit=%d | beim Halten 1: %s, nach Loslassen 0: %s -> %s",
       LAYF[bestLayout].name, (unsigned long long)(base + (int64_t)bestOff - LAYF[bestLayout].bytefn(0x45)), bestOff, bestBit,
       hi ? "ja" : "NEIN", lo ? "ja" : "NEIN", (hi && lo) ? "E GEFUNDEN + BESTAETIGT" : "noch nicht stabil - nochmal");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ TAP TEST: 1 sound, tap E fast several times
// Criterion: a tapped key byte toggles between exactly TWO values many times.
// A counter/timer takes many DIFFERENT values, a timestamp does not return.
static void doTapE(DWORD ctx, const char* module, int rounds) {
    const ULONG64 base = modBase(ctx, module);
    if (!base) { lg("e2: no base %s", module); return; }
    uint32_t size = 0x400000;
    if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
        PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
            if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
            VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
        }
    }
    lg("=== E-TIPP-TEST (read-only) ctx=0x%lX %s, %d Fenster ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module, rounds);
    lg("=== gleich: 1 LANGER HELLER Piep = E SCHNELL MEHRMALS TIPPEN (10 s), danach kurzer tiefer Piep = Stop ===");
    std::vector<uint8_t> A, cur;
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, A)) { lg("read A failed"); return; }
    std::vector<uint16_t> trans(size, 0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> idle(size), alt(size), seenAlt(size, 0), third(size, 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) idle[i] = A[i];
    for (int r = 0; r < rounds; ++r) {
        Beep(1600, 800);
        std::vector<uint8_t> last(size);
        std::memcpy(last.data(), A.data(), size);
        const ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
        size_t samples = 0;
        while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < 10000) {
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur)) {
                ++samples;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                    if (cur[i] != last[i]) {
                        if (trans[i] < 60000) ++trans[i];
                        if (!seenAlt[i]) {
                            seenAlt[i] = 1;
                            alt[i] = cur[i];
                        } else if (cur[i] != alt[i] && !third[i]) {
                            third[i] = 1;
                        }
                        last[i] = cur[i];
                    }
            }
            Sleep(5);
        }
        Beep(700, 400);
        lg("Fenster %d/%d fertig (%zu Messpunkte)", r + 1, rounds, samples);
    }
    struct Row {
        size_t off;
        int t;
        uint8_t a, b;
    };
    std::vector<Row> rows;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        if (trans[i] >= 4 && !third[i] && seenAlt[i]) rows.push_back({i, trans[i], idle[i], alt[i]});
    std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](const Row& x, const Row& y) { return x.t > y.t; });
    lg("Bytes mit vielen Wechseln und nur 2 Werten (= getippte Taste): %zu (Top 16):", rows.size());
    for (size_t k = 0; k < rows.size() && k < 16; ++k)
        lg("  +0x%zX  wechsel=%d  idle=%02X tippen=%02X", rows[k].off, rows[k].t, rows[k].a, rows[k].b);
    if (rows.empty()) lg("  -> nichts gefunden: kam der E-Tipp wirklich am Ziel an? (Tastatur am Gaming-PC)");

    int bestBit = -1, bestLayout = -1;
    size_t bestOff = 0;
    for (const Row& rw : rows) {
        for (size_t li = 0; li < sizeof(LAYF) / sizeof(LAYF[0]); ++li) {
            const LayoutF& L = LAYF[li];
            const int b = L.bitfn(0x45);
            if (!((rw.b >> b) & 1)) continue;
            lg("MATCH layout=%s  E-Byte=+0x%zX Bit=%d  arrayBase=0x%llX  (%s)", L.name, rw.off, b,
               (unsigned long long)(base + (int64_t)rw.off - L.bytefn(0x45)), L.map);
            if (bestBit < 0) {
                bestBit = b;
                bestOff = rw.off;
                bestLayout = (int)li;
            }
        }
    }
    if (bestBit < 0) {
        lg("ERGEBNIS: kein Layout-Treffer fuer E.");
        return;
    }
    lg("VALIDIERUNG: 1 langer Piep = nochmal E schnell tippen (10 s) ...");
    Beep(1600, 800);
    {
        ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
        int flips = 0;
        uint8_t st = ((readImg(ctx, base, size, cur)) && ((cur[bestOff] >> bestBit) & 1)) ? 1 : 0;
        while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < 10000) {
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur)) {
                const uint8_t s = (uint8_t)((cur[bestOff] >> bestBit) & 1);
                if (s != st) {
                    ++flips;
                    st = s;
                }
            }
            Sleep(5);
        }
        Beep(700, 400);
        lg("ERGEBNIS: layout=%s arrayBase=0x%llX E-Byte=+0x%zX Bit=%d | %d Wechsel in 10 s -> %s", LAYF[bestLayout].name,
           (unsigned long long)(base + (int64_t)bestOff - LAYF[bestLayout].bytefn(0x45)), bestOff, bestBit, flips,
           flips >= 4 ? "E GEFUNDEN + BESTAETIGT" : "noch nicht stabil - nochmal");
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ BURST: automatic structure finder (no human timing)
// Box toggles LMB/RMB/MMB (VKs 1/2/4 in the same array). A key byte shows exactly TWO values and MANY
// transitions; counters/timestamps show many different values. Geometry (byte distances) identifies layout+base.
static void doBurst(DWORD ctx, const char* module, ULONG64 vaOverride, size_t winOverride, int toggles) {
    ULONG64 base = vaOverride;
    uint32_t size = (uint32_t)(winOverride ? winOverride : 0x400000);
    if (!base) {
        base = modBase(ctx, module);
        if (!base) { lg("burst: no base for %s", module); return; }
        if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU) {
            PVMMDLL_MAP_MODULEENTRY e = nullptr;
            if (VMMDLL_Map_GetModuleFromNameU(gVmm, ctx, module, &e, 0) && e) {
                if (e->cbImageSize) size = e->cbImageSize;
                VMMDLL_MemFree(e);
            }
        }
    }
    lg("=== BURST auto (kein Mensch) ctx=0x%lX %s size=0x%X toggles=%d ===", (unsigned long)ctx, module, size, toggles);
    std::vector<uint8_t> A, B;
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, A)) { lg("read A failed"); return; }
    Sleep(250);
    if (!readImg(ctx, base, size, B)) { lg("read B failed"); return; }
    std::vector<uint8_t> stable(size);
    size_t nUn = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        stable[i] = A[i] == B[i];
        if (!stable[i]) ++nUn;
    }
    lg("idle-stabilität: %zu von %zu stabil (%zu instabil)", size - nUn, size, nUn);

    static const char* pname[3] = {"LMB(VK1)", "RMB(VK2)", "MMB(VK4)"};
    static const char* pcmd[3] = {"km.left", "km.right", "km.middle"};
    struct Cand {
        size_t off;
        int trans;
        uint8_t down;
    };
    std::vector<Cand> cand[3];
    for (int p = 0; p < 3; ++p) {
        char dn[32], up[32];
        std::snprintf(dn, sizeof dn, "%s(1)\r\n", pcmd[p]);
        std::snprintf(up, sizeof up, "%s(0)\r\n", pcmd[p]);
        std::vector<uint16_t> trans(size, 0);
        std::vector<uint8_t> a2(size, 0), down(size, 0), cur(size);
        std::vector<uint8_t> last(size);
        std::memcpy(last.data(), A.data(), size);
        int seen = 0;
        for (int t = 0; t < toggles; ++t) {
            gBox.send(dn);
            Sleep(90);
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur)) {
                ++seen;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                    if (cur[i] != last[i]) {
                        if (trans[i] < 60000) ++trans[i];
                        if (down[i] == A[i]) down[i] = cur[i];      // remember the pressed value
                        if (a2[i] == 0 && cur[i] != A[i] && cur[i] != down[i]) a2[i] = cur[i];  // 3rd value?
                        last[i] = cur[i];
                    }
            }
            gBox.send(up);
            Sleep(90);
            if (readImg(ctx, base, size, cur)) {
                ++seen;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                    if (cur[i] != last[i]) {
                        if (trans[i] < 60000) ++trans[i];
                        if (down[i] == A[i]) down[i] = cur[i];
                        if (a2[i] == 0 && cur[i] != A[i] && cur[i] != down[i]) a2[i] = cur[i];
                        last[i] = cur[i];
                    }
            }
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
            if (stable[i] && trans[i] >= toggles * 2 - 1 && down[i] != A[i] && last[i] == A[i])
                cand[p].push_back({i, trans[i], down[i]});
        std::sort(cand[p].begin(), cand[p].end(), [](const Cand& x, const Cand& y) { return x.trans > y.trans; });
        std::string s;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < cand[p].size() && k < 8; ++k) {
            char t[48];
            std::snprintf(t, sizeof t, "+0x%zX(w=%d,%02X>%02X) ", cand[p][k].off, cand[p][k].trans, A[cand[p][k].off], cand[p][k].down);
            s += t;
        }
        lg("%s: %zu Kandidaten (2 Werte, viele Wechsel, kehrt zurueck) nach %d Messpunkten: %s", pname[p], cand[p].size(), seen, s.c_str());
    }

    bool any = false;
    for (const LayoutF& L : LAYF) {
        for (const Cand& c1 : cand[0]) {
            const int b1 = L.bitfn(0x01);
            if (!((c1.down >> b1) & 1)) continue;
            const int64_t st = (int64_t)c1.off - L.bytefn(0x01);
            bool ok = true;
            for (int p = 1; p < 3 && ok; ++p) {
                const int vk = p == 1 ? 0x02 : 0x04;
                const int bp = L.bitfn(vk);
                bool found = false;
                for (const Cand& c : cand[p])
                    if ((int64_t)c.off - L.bytefn(vk) == st && ((c.down >> bp) & 1)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                if (!found) ok = false;
            }
            if (ok) {
                lg("MATCH layout=%s  arrayBase=0x%llX  E-Byte=+0x%llX  (%s)", L.name, (unsigned long long)(base + st),
                   (unsigned long long)(st + L.bytefn(0x45)), L.map);
                any = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!any) lg("kein Layout-Match -> Adresse in diesem Modul/Ctx nicht gefunden");
}

static bool kernelVa(ULONG64 a) { return a >= 0xFFFF000000000000ull; }

// Follow our project's own session-slot fallback chain (csrss -> win32ksgd.sys +0x3110 -> ptr -> ptr -> ptr)
// and BURST a window at the final pointer, so a wrong tail offset no longer matters.
static void doChain(const std::vector<Proc>& procs) {
    const char* mods[2] = {"win32ksgd.sys", "win32k.sys"};
    lg("=== CHAIN read-only: Session-Slot-Kette (unsere Code-Werte +0x3110 / +0x3690) ===");
    for (const auto& p : procs) {
        if (p.name != "csrss.exe") continue;
        for (const char* m : mods) {
            const ULONG64 b = modBase(p.pid, m);
            if (!b) { lg("  pid=0x%lX %s: kein Base", (unsigned long)p.pid, m); continue; }
            ULONG64 q1 = 0, q2 = 0, q3 = 0;
            if (!rd(p.pid, b + 0x3110, &q1, 8) || !kernelVa(q1)) { lg("  pid=0x%lX %s base=0x%llX +0x3110 -> 0x%llX (kein Kernelzeiger)", (unsigned long)p.pid, m, (unsigned long long)b, (unsigned long long)q1); continue; }
            if (!rd(p.pid, q1, &q2, 8) || !kernelVa(q2)) { lg("  pid=0x%lX %s q1=0x%llX -> 0x%llX (kein Kernelzeiger)", (unsigned long)p.pid, m, (unsigned long long)q1, (unsigned long long)q2); continue; }
            if (!rd(p.pid, q2, &q3, 8) || !kernelVa(q3)) { lg("  pid=0x%lX %s q2=0x%llX -> 0x%llX (kein Kernelzeiger)", (unsigned long)p.pid, m, (unsigned long long)q2, (unsigned long long)q3); continue; }
            lg("  KETTE OK pid=0x%lX %s: base=0x%llX -> 0x%llX -> 0x%llX -> 0x%llX ; unser Array-Tail waere 0x%llX", (unsigned long)p.pid, m,
               (unsigned long long)b, (unsigned long long)q1, (unsigned long long)q2, (unsigned long long)q3, (unsigned long long)(q3 + 0x3690));
            doBurst(p.pid, "", q3, 0x20000, 3);
        }
    }
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::string mode = "probe", port = "COM3", dllDir = exeDir(), module = "win32kbase.sys";
    DWORD onlyCtx = (DWORD)-1;
    int rounds = 3, key1 = 0x45, key2 = 0x57;
    ULONG64 phaseVa = 0;
    size_t phaseWin = 0x2000;
    int phaseStep = 60;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string a = argv[i];
        if (a == "probe" || a == "scan" || a == "scanall" || a == "env" || a == "ekey" || a == "find" || a == "phases" || a == "e" || a == "e2" ||
            a == "burst" || a == "chain")
            mode = a;
        else if (a == "--va" && i + 1 < argc) phaseVa = strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 0);
        else if (a == "--win" && i + 1 < argc) phaseWin = (size_t)strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 0);
        else if (a == "--step" && i + 1 < argc) phaseStep = atoi(argv[++i]);
        else if (a == "--port" && i + 1 < argc) port = argv[++i];
        else if (a == "--dll" && i + 1 < argc) dllDir = argv[++i];
        else if (a == "--module" && i + 1 < argc) module = argv[++i];
        else if (a == "--ctx" && i + 1 < argc) onlyCtx = (DWORD)strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 0);
        else if (a == "--rounds" && i + 1 < argc) rounds = atoi(argv[++i]);
        else if (a == "--key1" && i + 1 < argc) key1 = (int)strtol(argv[++i], nullptr, 0);
        else if (a == "--key2" && i + 1 < argc) key2 = (int)strtol(argv[++i], nullptr, 0);
    }
    std::string logPath = exeDir() + "\\keyprobe.log";
    gLog = _fsopen(logPath.c_str(), "w", _SH_DENYNO);
    lg("keyprobe mode=%s port=%s dll=%s module=%s", mode.c_str(), port.c_str(), dllDir.c_str(), module.c_str());

    if (!loadVmm(dllDir)) return 2;
    LPCSTR av[] = {"", "-device", "fpga", "-waitinitialize"};
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 6 && !gVmm; ++attempt) {
        if (attempt) {
            lg("[..] VMM init retry %d ...", attempt);
            Sleep(1500);
        }
        gVmm = VMMDLL_Initialize(4, av);
    }
    if (!gVmm) { lg("[!!] VMMDLL_Initialize failed after retries (card busy / needs power cycle?)"); return 3; }
    lg("[ok] VMM initialized");

    if (mode != "ekey") {  // ekey = strictly read-only, never touch the box
        if (!gBox.open(port.c_str())) lg("[!!] box not opened - pulse tests will be meaningless");
        else {
            gBox.send("km.version()\r\n");
            Sleep(120);
            std::string r = gBox.drain();
            std::string ident;
            for (char ch : r)
                if (ch >= 32 && ch < 127) ident += ch;
            lg("[box] reply: %s", ident.c_str());
        }
    } else {
        lg("[ekey] box untouched (no km.* commands)");
    }

    std::vector<Proc> procs = enumProcs();
    lg("processes: %zu", procs.size());

    if (mode == "scanall") {
        // ordered, de-duplicated scan contexts: system first, then session-1 host processes
        std::vector<DWORD> ctxs;
        auto add = [&](DWORD x) {
            if (x && std::find(ctxs.begin(), ctxs.end(), x) == ctxs.end()) ctxs.push_back(x);
        };
        add(4);
        add(4 | VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY);
        const char* order[] = {"csrss.exe", "winlogon.exe", "DayZ_x64.exe"};
        for (const char* nm : order)
            for (const auto& p : procs)
                if (p.name == nm) {
                    add(p.pid);
                    add(p.pid | VMMDLL_PID_PROCESS_WITH_KERNELMEMORY);
                }
        const char* ms[] = {"win32kbase.sys", "win32kfull.sys", "win32k.sys"};
        for (const char* m : ms) {
            for (DWORD c : ctxs) {
                if (scanOne(c, m)) {
                    lg(">>> %s : confirmed in ctx 0x%lX - stop scanning this module", m, (unsigned long)c);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    } else if (mode == "scan") {
        if (onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1)
            scanOne(4, module.c_str());
        else
            scanOne(onlyCtx, module.c_str());
    } else if (mode == "e2") {
        doTapE(onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1 ? 0x80000548u : onlyCtx, module.c_str(), rounds < 2 ? 3 : rounds);
    } else if (mode == "burst") {
        DWORD c = onlyCtx;
        if (c == (DWORD)-1) {
            for (const auto& p : procs)
                if (p.name == "winlogon.exe") {
                    c = p.pid;
                    break;
                }
            if (c == (DWORD)-1) c = 4;
        }
        doBurst(c, module.c_str(), 0, 0, rounds < 5 ? 5 : rounds);
    } else if (mode == "chain") {
        doChain(procs);
    } else if (mode == "e") {
        doFindE(onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1 ? 0x80000548u : onlyCtx, module.c_str(), rounds < 1 ? 3 : rounds);
    } else if (mode == "phases") {
        doPhases(onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1 ? 0x80000548u : onlyCtx, module.c_str(), phaseVa, phaseWin, phaseStep);
    } else if (mode == "find") {
        doFind(onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1 ? 4 : onlyCtx, module.c_str());
    } else if (mode == "env") {
        doProbe(procs, false);
    } else if (mode == "ekey") {
        doEKey(onlyCtx == (DWORD)-1 ? 4 : onlyCtx, module.c_str(), key1, key2, rounds);
    } else {
        doProbe(procs, true);
    }

    lg("done.");
    gBox.close();
    if (gVmm) VMMDLL_Close(gVmm);
    if (gLog) std::fclose(gLog);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// label_test.cpp - offline check of the trigger-key label logic (no DMA, no GUI).
// Same formula as src/radar.cpp keyLabel(): scan code in bits 16-23, extended bit 24, Pause special case.
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

// VKs whose scan code is extended (E0 prefix); GetKeyNameText needs bit 24 set for these.
static bool vkExtended(int vk) {
    switch (vk) {
        case VK_RCONTROL: case VK_RMENU: case VK_INSERT: case VK_DELETE: case VK_HOME: case VK_END:
        case VK_PRIOR: case VK_NEXT: case VK_LEFT: case VK_RIGHT: case VK_UP: case VK_DOWN:
        case VK_NUMLOCK: case VK_DIVIDE: case VK_SNAPSHOT: case VK_APPS: case VK_LWIN: case VK_RWIN:
        case VK_VOLUME_MUTE: case VK_VOLUME_DOWN: case VK_VOLUME_UP:
        case VK_MEDIA_NEXT_TRACK: case VK_MEDIA_PREV_TRACK: case VK_MEDIA_STOP: case VK_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE:
        case VK_BROWSER_BACK: case VK_BROWSER_FORWARD: case VK_BROWSER_REFRESH: case VK_BROWSER_STOP:
        case VK_BROWSER_SEARCH: case VK_BROWSER_FAVORITES: case VK_BROWSER_HOME:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

static void label(char* out, size_t n, int k) {
    if (k >= 1 && k <= 5) {
        static const char* const m[6] = {"", "Left mouse", "Right mouse", "Middle mouse", "Mouse 4", "Mouse 5"};
        std::snprintf(out, n, "%s", m[k]);
        return;
    }
    if (k <= 0) {
        std::snprintf(out, n, "none");
        return;
    }
    char nm[48] = {};
    UINT sc = MapVirtualKeyA((UINT)k, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC_EX);
    if (k == VK_PAUSE) sc = 0x45;
    if (sc) {
        LONG lp = LONG(sc & 0xFF) << 16;
        if ((sc >> 8) == 0xE0 || vkExtended(k)) lp |= 1L << 24;
        if (GetKeyNameTextA(lp, nm, (int)sizeof nm) > 0 && nm[0]) {
            std::snprintf(out, n, "%s (0x%02X)", nm, k);
            return;
        }
    }
    std::snprintf(out, n, "code 0x%02X (%d)", k, k);
}

struct Case {
    int vk;
    const char* a;  // akzeptierte Namen (deutsche ODER englische Systemsprache)
    const char* b;
};

int main() {
    const Case cases[] = {
        {0x45, "E", ""},          {0x57, "W", ""},        {0x10, "UMSCHALT", "SHIFT"}, {0x0D, "EINGABE", "ENTER"},
        {0x09, "TAB", ""},        {0x13, "PAUSE", ""},    {0x20, "LEER", "SPACE"},     {0x25, "LINKS", "LEFT"},
        {0x2D, "EINFG", "INSERT"},{0x60, "0", ""},        {1, "Left mouse", ""},       {4, "Mouse 4", ""},
    };
    int bad = 0;
    for (const Case& c : cases) {
        char b[64] = {};
        label(b, sizeof b, c.vk);
        const bool ok = std::strstr(b, c.a) != nullptr || (c.b[0] && std::strstr(b, c.b) != nullptr);
        if (!ok) ++bad;
        std::printf("%-6s vk=0x%02X -> \"%s\"\n", ok ? "OK" : "FEHLER", (unsigned)c.vk, b);
    }
    std::printf("\n%d von %d fehlerhaft\n", bad, (int)(sizeof cases / sizeof cases[0]));
    return bad ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`tools/lanbridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// lanbridge.cpp - tiny LAN bridge: serves the ChatGPT prompt in the local network and saves the answer back.
// Build: tools\build_lanbridge.bat      Run: tools\lanbridge.exe [promptfile] [port]
// No dependencies, Winsock only. Answer appended to tools\bridge_reply.txt (+ *_latest.txt).
#define _WINSOCK_DEPRECATED_NO_WARNINGS
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

static std::string gReport;
static const char* gReplyPath = "bridge_reply.txt";
static const char* gLatestPath = "bridge_reply_latest.txt";

static std::string loadFile(const std::string& p) {
    FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, p.c_str(), "rb") || !f) return "(Datei nicht gefunden: " + p + ")";
    std::string out;
    char buf[4096];
    size_t n;
    while ((n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) out.append(buf, n);
    fclose(f);
    return out;
}
static void appendFile(const std::string& p, const std::string& s) {
    FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, p.c_str(), "ab") || !f) return;
    fwrite(s.data(), 1, s.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
}
static void writeFile(const std::string& p, const std::string& s) {
    FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, p.c_str(), "wb") || !f) return;
    fwrite(s.data(), 1, s.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
}
static std::string urldecode(const std::string& in) {
    std::string o;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < in.size(); ++i) {
        if (in[i] == '+') o += ' ';
        else if (in[i] == '%' && i + 2 < in.size()) {
            char t[3] = {in[i + 1], in[i + 2], 0};
            o += (char)strtol(t, nullptr, 16);
            i += 2;
        } else o += in[i];
    }
    return o;
}
static std::string htmlEscape(const std::string& s) {
    std::string o;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '&') o += "&amp;";
        else if (c == '<') o += "&lt;";
        else if (c == '>') o += "&gt;";
        else o += c;
    }
    return o;
}
static void sendAll(SOCKET s, const std::string& body, const char* ctype) {
    char hdr[512];
    std::snprintf(hdr, sizeof hdr,
                  "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: %s; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", ctype,
                  (int)body.size());
    send(s, hdr, (int)std::strlen(hdr), 0);
    if (!body.empty()) send(s, body.data(), (int)body.size(), 0);
}

static std::string page(const std::string& note) {
    std::string h;
    h += "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>Ickza LAN-Bridge</title>"
         "<style>body{font-family:Segoe UI,Arial;margin:16px;background:#14161a;color:#e6e6e6}"
         "pre{background:#0d0f12;padding:12px;border:1px solid #2a2f37;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:50vh;overflow:auto}"
         "textarea{width:100%;height:26vh;background:#0d0f12;color:#e6e6e6;border:1px solid #2a2f37;font-family:Consolas,monospace}"
         "button{background:#2d7d46;color:#fff;border:0;padding:10px 18px;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px;cursor:pointer}"
         "a{color:#7cc4ff}</style></head><body>";
    h += "<h2>Ickza LAN-Bridge &mdash; Prompt an ChatGPT</h2>";
    if (!note.empty()) h += "<p style=\"color:#8ee27a\">" + htmlEscape(note) + "</p>";
    h += "<p>1) Text kopieren &rarr; 2) bei ChatGPT am Main-PC einf&uuml;gen &rarr; 3) Antwort unten einf&uuml;gen und speichern.<br>"
         "<a href=\"/raw\">Prompt als Reintext</a> &middot; <a href=\"/replyraw\">gespeicherte Antwort ansehen</a></p>";
    h += "<pre>" + htmlEscape(gReport) + "</pre>";
    h += "<form method=\"POST\" action=\"/reply\"><b>Antwort von ChatGPT:</b><br>"
         "<textarea name=\"answer\" placeholder=\"Antwort hier einfuegen...\"></textarea><br>"
         "<button type=\"submit\">Antwort speichern</button></form>";
    h += "</body></html>";
    return h;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const std::string promptFile = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "..\\docs\\CHATGPT_PROMPT.md";
    const int port = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 8099;
    gReport = loadFile(promptFile);

    WSADATA w{};
    if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &w) != 0) { std::printf("WSAStartup failed\n"); return 1; }
    SOCKET srv = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (srv == INVALID_SOCKET) { std::printf("socket failed\n"); return 1; }
    BOOL yes = TRUE;
    setsockopt(srv, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, (char*)&yes, sizeof yes);
    sockaddr_in a{};
    a.sin_family = AF_INET;
    a.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
    a.sin_port = htons((u_short)port);
    if (bind(srv, (sockaddr*)&a, sizeof a) != 0) { std::printf("bind auf Port %d fehlgeschlagen\n", port); return 1; }
    listen(srv, 8);

    char host[256] = {};
    gethostname(host, sizeof host - 1);
    std::printf("=== LAN-Bridge laeuft ===\n");
    std::printf("Prompt: %s (%zu Bytes)\n", promptFile.c_str(), gReport.size());
    std::printf("Antwort -> %s\\%s\n", "tools", gReplyPath);
    struct hostent* he = gethostbyname(host);
    if (he)
        for (int i = 0; he->h_addr_list[i]; ++i) {
            in_addr in;
            std::memcpy(&in, he->h_addr_list[i], 4);
            std::printf("  URL am MAIN-PC:  http://%s:%d/\n", inet_ntoa(in), port);
        }
    std::printf("(Firewall beim ersten Start erlauben!)\n");
    std::fflush(stdout);

    for (;;) {
        sockaddr_in cli{};
        int cl = sizeof cli;
        SOCKET c = accept(srv, (sockaddr*)&cli, &cl);
        if (c == INVALID_SOCKET) continue;

        std::string req;
        char buf[4096];
        int n = recv(c, buf, sizeof buf, 0);
        if (n > 0) req.append(buf, n);
        size_t clen = 0;
        const size_t p = req.find("Content-Length:");
        if (p != std::string::npos) clen = (size_t)atoi(req.c_str() + p + 15);
        const size_t hdrEnd = req.find("\r\n\r\n");
        if (hdrEnd != std::string::npos && clen)
            while (req.size() < hdrEnd + 4 + clen) {
                n = recv(c, buf, sizeof buf, 0);
                if (n <= 0) break;
                req.append(buf, n);
            }

        const bool isPost = req.rfind("POST", 0) == 0;
        if (isPost && req.rfind("POST /reply", 0) == 0 && hdrEnd != std::string::npos) {
            const std::string body = req.substr(hdrEnd + 4);
            std::string answer;
            const size_t k = body.find("answer=");
            if (k != std::string::npos) {
                std::string val = body.substr(k + 7);
                const size_t amp = val.find('&');
                if (amp != std::string::npos) val.resize(amp);
                answer = urldecode(val);
            }
            SYSTEMTIME st{};
            GetLocalTime(&st);
            char head[128];
            std::snprintf(head, sizeof head, "\n\n===== Antwort von ChatGPT  %04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d =====\n", st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay,
                          st.wHour, st.wMinute);
            appendFile(gReplyPath, std::string(head) + answer + "\n");
            writeFile(gLatestPath, answer + "\n");
            std::printf("[%02d:%02d] Antwort gespeichert: %zu Zeichen -> %s\n", st.wHour, st.wMinute, answer.size(), gReplyPath);
            std::fflush(stdout);
            sendAll(c, page("Antwort gespeichert - danke! Jetzt an Codex zurueckgeben."), "text/html");
        } else if (req.rfind("GET /raw", 0) == 0) {
            sendAll(c, gReport, "text/plain");
        } else if (req.rfind("GET /replyraw", 0) == 0) {
            sendAll(c, loadFile(gLatestPath), "text/plain");
        } else {
            sendAll(c, page(""), "text/html");
        }
        closesocket(c);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/t.bat`:

```bat
@echo off
setlocal
echo dp0=[%~dp0]
set "VSWHERE=%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
echo VSW=[%VSWHERE%]
if not exist "%VSWHERE%" (echo vswhere not found & exit /b 1)
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in (`"%VSWHERE%" -latest -products * -property installationPath`) do set "VSROOT=%%i"
echo VSROOT=[%VSROOT%]
if not defined VSROOT (echo Visual Studio not found & exit /b 1)
echo OK
exit /b 0

```
